vocabulary.definition: 脑血管疾病（CeVD）是糖尿病大血管病变在脑血管系统的表现，包括缺血性脑卒中（占 75-80%，是最常见的类 型）、出血性脑卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）。糖尿病使卒中风险增加 2-4 倍，且预后比非糖尿病患者更差 （残疾和死亡率更高）。糖尿病患者的卒中预防：①严格控糖（HbA1c<7%）；②强化降压（目标<130/80 mmHg， 首选ACEI/ARB）；③他汀类降脂（LDL-C<1.8 mmol/L，如合并ASCVD）；④抗血小板治疗（阿司匹林或氯吡格 雷）；⑤SGLT-2i 和 GLP-1RA（有卒中降低证据）；⑥生活方式干预（戒烟、减重、运动、低盐低脂饮食）。急 性卒中处理：溶栓（rt-PA，时间窗 4.5 小时）、取栓（机械取栓，时间窗 6-24 小时）和神经保护，糖尿病患者需 注意血糖控制（避免低血糖）。
vocabulary.example_english: Diabetes is a major risk factor for ischemic stroke; strict control of blood pressure and lipids is essential for primary prevention.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 糖尿病是缺血性脑卒中的主要危险因素；严格控制血压和血脂对一级预防至关重要。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 外周动脉疾病（PAD）是糖尿病大血管病变在下肢动脉系统的表现，由动脉粥样硬化引起下肢动脉狭窄或闭塞， 导致下肢缺血、间歇性跛行、静息痛、溃疡和坏疽，是糖尿病足和下肢截肢的重要病因。糖尿病患者 PAD 患病率 约20-30%，且多无症状（因神经病变掩盖疼痛），确诊时多为晚期。筛查：踝臂指数（ABI）≤0.90诊断PAD（糖 尿病患者中如 ABI>1.30提示动脉钙化，需测趾臂指数 TBI）。管理：①严格控糖、降压（<130/80）、降脂（他汀， LDL-C<1.8）；②抗血小板治疗（阿司匹林）；③戒烟（最重要的干预之一）；④结构化运动（步行康复训练）； ⑤血运重建（血管成形术/支架或旁路手术）；⑥足部护理和定期随访。PAD是截肢的“前哨”，必须重视！
vocabulary.example_english: Peripheral arterial disease in diabetic patients often presents as asymptomatic or atypical symptoms due to neuropathy; regular ABI screening is recommended.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 糖尿病患者的PAD因神经病变常无症状或症状不典型；建议定期进行ABI筛查。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 糖尿病肾脏疾病（DKD）是糖尿病肾病（DN）的最新命名，强调糖尿病所致的肾脏损害（包括结构和功能），涵 盖从微量白蛋白尿到 ESRD的全程。DKD的诊断基于持续性白蛋白尿（UACR≥30 mg/g）和/或 eGFR进行性下降 （<60 mL/min/1.73m²），并排除其他肾脏疾病。DKD 分期（根据 eGFR 和 UACR）：G1（≥90，正常或升高） →G2（60-89，轻度降低）→G3a（45-59，轻中度）→G3b（30-44，中重度）→G4（15-29，重度）→G5（<15， ESRD），结合白蛋白尿分级（A1：<30，A2：30-300，A3：>300）。DKD综合管理：①严格控糖（HbA1c<7%）； ②强化降压（目标<130/80，首选ACEI/ARB，即使血压正常也推荐用于A2/A3以降低尿蛋白）；③SGLT-2抑制剂 （恩格列净、达格列净、卡格列净）有独立肾脏保护作用（DAPA-CKD、EMPA-KIDNEY 等）；④控制血脂（他 汀）；⑤限制蛋白摄入（0.8g/kg/天，已有明显肾衰者）；⑥评估和管理贫血、钙磷代谢紊乱等DKD并发症。
vocabulary.example_english: Diabetic kidney disease is diagnosed by persistent albuminuria and/or reduced eGFR; SGLT-2 inhibitors have demonstrated renal protection.
vocabulary.example_chinese: DKD通过持续性白蛋白尿和/或eGFR下降诊断；SGLT-2抑制剂已证实有肾脏保护作用。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 终末期肾病（ESRD）是慢性肾脏病（CKD）的第 5 期，eGFR<15 mL/min/1.73m²，肾脏功能严重不足不能维持生 命，需要肾脏替代治疗（透析或肾移植）。糖尿病是 ESRD的主要原因（占全球透析患者的 30-50%），尤其 2型 糖尿病的蛋白尿性肾损害。ESRD的表现：尿毒症症状（乏力、恶心呕吐、食欲减退、瘙痒、贫血）、容量过负荷 （水肿、高血压、心衰）、电解质紊乱（高钾血症、高磷血症、低钙血症）和代谢性酸中毒。管理：①肾脏替代 治疗（血液透析、腹膜透析或肾移植）；②控制液体容量（透析和利尿剂）；③纠正电解质（低磷饮食、磷结合 剂、活性维生素 D）；④纠正贫血（ESA 和铁剂）；⑤控制心血管风险。DKD 患者应尽早转诊至肾内科 （eGFR<30或UACR>300时）。
vocabulary.example_english: End-stage renal disease is the final stage of diabetic kidney disease, requiring renal replacement therapy for survival.
vocabulary.example_chinese: ESRD是DKD的终末阶段，需要肾脏替代治疗以维持生命。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 糖尿病视力丧失（VL）是糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）、白内障（早发和加速）、新生血管性青光眼等糖尿病眼部并 发症的最终结果，是成人致盲的主要原因之一。糖尿病视力丧失的病理机制：①增殖性 DR（PDR）的新生血管破 裂→玻璃体出血；②牵拉性视网膜脱离；③新生血管性青光眼；④黄斑水肿（DME，中心视力损害）。筛查和预 防：①定期眼底筛查（T1DM发病5年内、T2DM确诊时，之后每年复查）；②严格控糖（延缓 DR进展的基石）； ③控制血压、血脂；④激光光凝（PDR）；⑤抗 VEGF治疗（DME和 PDR）；⑥玻璃体切除术（晚期）。可预防 的视力丧失是糖尿病最“令人遗憾”的并发症（一旦发生，不可逆）。
vocabulary.example_english: Diabetic retinopathy remains a leading cause of preventable vision loss; regular screening and anti-VEGF therapy reduce blindness risk.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 糖尿病视网膜病变仍是可预防性视力丧失的主要原因；定期筛查和抗VEGF治疗可降低失明风险。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 截肢是糖尿病足和严重下肢缺血的最终治疗手段，即手术切除缺血、感染或坏死的肢体或足部部分。糖尿病是非 创伤性下肢截肢的首要原因（约占50-70%），全球每30秒有1例糖尿病相关截肢。截肢的常见路径：神经病变→ 感觉丧失→足部溃疡→感染→缺血→坏疽→截肢。预防是核心：①每日足部检查和护理（每天洗脚、检查有无破 损、穿合适鞋袜）；②定期足部筛查（每年足部感觉+ABI+足部皮肤检查）；③及时处理足部问题（不要自行处 理鸡眼、甲沟炎，由专业足病医师处理）；④控糖、控压、戒烟、降脂；⑤教育患者和家属（“看、洗、干、润、 穿、动”六步法）。截肢后5年死亡率高达50%，预防远胜于治疗！
vocabulary.example_english: Most diabetic amputations are preventable through regular foot care, glycemic control, and prompt treatment of infections.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 大多数糖尿病截肢可通过定期足部护理、血糖控制和及时治疗感染来预防。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 激素撤药综合征是长期（>2-3 周）大剂量糖皮质激素（泼尼松等效>20mg/日）治疗后突然停药或过快减量引起的 一系列症状和肾上腺危象风险的临床状态。机制：①外源性糖皮质激素长期抑制 HPA 轴→肾上腺皮质萎缩 →ACTH和皮质醇分泌不足；②突然停药后皮质醇严重缺乏→肾上腺危象（严重者）；③炎症反跳（原发疾病复发 或加重）。临床表现：①轻度撤药：乏力、肌痛、关节痛、恶心、食欲下降、体位性低血压；②重度撤药：肾上 腺危象（休克、低血糖、意识障碍）。预防和处理：①逐渐减量（减量速度根据用药剂量和疗程个体化，一般每 周减5-10%或每2-4周减2.5-5mg泼尼松）；②减量过程中监测HPA轴功能（ACTH兴奋试验）；③应激时增加剂 量（“应激剂量”）；④患者教育（不可自行停药）。
vocabulary.example_english: Steroid withdrawal syndrome can be avoided by gradual dose reduction; abrupt discontinuation after prolonged therapy may precipitate adrenal crisis.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 激素撤药综合征可通过逐渐减量来避免；长期治疗后突然停药可能诱发肾上腺危象。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.chinese: 双膦酸盐相关颌骨坏死
vocabulary.definition: 双膦酸盐相关颌骨坏死（BRONJ）是双膦酸盐类（静脉剂型风险最高，口服剂型罕见）和 RANKL 抑制剂（地舒 单抗）的罕见但严重不良反应，表现为颌骨暴露不愈合（≥8 周），可伴有疼痛、肿胀、感染、牙齿松动和骨坏死。 高危因素：静脉双膦酸盐（尤其是肿瘤治疗，每月给药，风险 1-10%）、持续用药时间>3 年、牙科手术（拔牙、 种植牙）、口腔感染和牙周病。预防：①开始治疗前完成全面口腔检查和必要的牙科治疗（拔牙等）；②治疗期 间定期口腔检查；③避免侵入性牙科操作；④良好的口腔卫生。处理：①停用双膦酸盐（与肿瘤科/内分泌科协 商）；②抗生素和口腔冲洗；③保守清创；④高压氧治疗（部分患者）；⑤外科手术（严重者）。BRONJ 重在预 防（“用药前查牙”原则）。
vocabulary.example_english: Bisphosphonate-related osteonecrosis of the jaw is a serious complication of intravenous bisphosphonate therapy, preventable by dental evaluation before treatment initiation.
vocabulary.example_chinese: BRONJ是静脉双膦酸盐治疗的严重并发症，在开始治疗前进行牙科评估可预防。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 非典型股骨骨折（AFF）是长期（>3-5年）双膦酸盐和地舒单抗治疗的罕见不良反应，表现为股骨转子下或股骨干 的横断性或短斜形骨折，无明显创伤史（或低能量创伤），常伴有前驱症状（大腿疼痛、酸痛、乏力持续数周至 数月），双侧性（约 50%）。影像学特征：股骨外侧皮质增厚、局部骨膜反应（“乌鸦脚”征）和横断骨折线。 机制：长期抑制骨转换导致骨微损伤无法修复，骨强度下降→应力性骨折。管理：①立即停用抗骨吸收药物；② 骨科手术（髓内钉固定是首选，因愈合慢）；③补充钙和维生素D；④监测对侧股骨（50%双侧性）。AFF是双膦 酸盐的罕见并发症（发生率<1/10,000 患者年），但一旦发生后果严重，治疗前需评估风险（用药时间>5 年可考虑 “药物假期”）。
vocabulary.example_english: Atypical femoral fracture is a rare complication of long-term bisphosphonate use, often preceded by prodromal thigh pain; a drug holiday may be considered after 5 years of therapy.
vocabulary.example_chinese: AFF是长期双膦酸盐治疗的罕见并发症，常有前驱大腿痛；用药5年后可考虑“药物假期”。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 肿瘤复发是内分泌恶性肿瘤（如分化型甲状腺癌 DTC、肾上腺皮质癌 ACC、嗜铬细胞瘤、甲状旁腺癌、神经内分 泌肿瘤 NET 等）治疗后肿瘤再次出现的临床事件。DTC 复发监测依靠 Tg（甲状腺球蛋白，最关键）和颈部超声 （术后第 1、3、6个月，后每 6-12个月）。复发风险分层（ATA动态风险分层）：极低危（Tg<0.2，颈部超声阴 性）→低危（Tg<1.0，无影像学异常）→中危（Tg 1-10，影像可疑）→高危（Tg>10，影像学阳性或 Tg 持续上 升）。复发的处理：①手术再切除（局部复发）；②放射性碘治疗（DTC 远处转移）；③局部消融（射频消融、 乙醇注射）；④观察（低危稳定者）。ACC 复发率高（5 年复发率约 50-70%），术后需定期随访（影像+功能检 查）。所有内分泌恶性肿瘤患者均需终身随访。
vocabulary.example_english: Tumor recurrence in differentiated thyroid cancer is detected by rising Tg levels and/or suspicious ultrasound findings; lifelong surveillance is required.
vocabulary.example_chinese: DTC肿瘤复发通过Tg升高和/或可疑超声表现检测；需要终身随访。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 转移是恶性肿瘤细胞从原发灶经血液、淋巴或直接播散至远处器官形成继发肿瘤的过程，是内分泌恶性肿瘤预后 不良的标志。常见转移途径：①淋巴转移（DTC 颈部淋巴结转移最常见，PTC 转移率 30-50%）；②血行转移 （FTC 和 ACC 常转移至肺和骨；嗜铬细胞瘤可转移至肝、肺、骨；MTC 可转移至纵隔、肝、骨）。DTC 转移的 监测：全身¹³¹I 扫描（术后 6-12 个月）和 Tg 动态监测。¹³¹I 治疗是 DTC 转移的根治性治疗手段之一（摄碘性转 移）。非摄碘性 DTC（约 10-20%）和 ACC 转移预后差，需多种综合治疗（靶向治疗、肽受体放射性核素治疗 PRRT、化疗等）。转移患者的5年生存率显著降低（DTC远处转移10年生存率约50%）。
vocabulary.example_english: Distant metastasis, particularly to the lungs and bones, significantly worsens prognosis in follicular thyroid carcinoma and adrenocortical carcinoma.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 远处转移（尤其肺和骨）显著恶化甲状腺滤泡状癌和肾上腺皮质癌的预后。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 临床缓解是指经过治疗后疾病活动性（症状、体征和实验室异常指标）完全或部分消失的状态，是内分泌肿瘤和 自身免疫性内分泌疾病（Graves病、Cushing病、肢端肥大症等）治疗后的重要疗效终点。缓解分为完全缓解（CR： 所有可测量病变消失、Tg 正常、影像阴性、激素水平正常）和部分缓解（PR：肿瘤缩小≥30%、激素显著下降但 未正常）。在DTC中：完全缓解定义为Tg<0.2 ng/mL（在TSH抑制或刺激下）、颈部超声和全身扫描阴性、无其 他影像学病灶。在库欣病：术后晨间皮质醇<5 μg/dL（或<1.8 μg/dL）定义为缓解。临床缓解的患者需定期随访 （每6-12个月，持续5年以上），因仍有复发风险。
vocabulary.example_english: Biochemical remission in Cushing's disease is defined by undetectable postoperative morning cortisol; patients require long-term surveillance for relapse.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 库欣病的生化缓解定义为术后晨间皮质醇测不出；患者需长期监测复发。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 生存率是指在一定时间后（通常 5 年、10 年）存活的患者的比例，是评估内分泌恶性肿瘤预后的核心指标。不同 内分泌肿瘤的生存率差异巨大：分化型甲状腺癌（DTC）10 年生存率>90%（乳头状癌>95%，滤泡状癌约 85- 90%）、甲状腺髓样癌（MTC）10 年生存率约 50-80%（取决于早期诊断）、肾上腺皮质癌（ACC）5 年生存率约 30-50%（晚期<10%）、嗜铬细胞瘤 5年生存率约 80-90%（良性肿瘤多）、胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤 5年生存率约 50- 80%（取决于分级和分期）。影响生存率的因素：年龄、肿瘤分期（TNM）、病理类型、分化程度、基因突变 （BRAF、RET、RAS等）、初始治疗是否根治和随访管理。
vocabulary.example_english: The 10-year survival rate for papillary thyroid carcinoma exceeds 95%, while adrenocortical carcinoma has a much poorer prognosis.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 甲状腺乳头状癌的10年生存率超过95%，而肾上腺皮质癌预后则差得多。
vocabulary.source_pdf: 内分泌科复试核心词汇表.pdf

vocabulary.definition: 长期随访是指对内分泌疾病（尤其恶性肿瘤和慢性内分泌疾病）患者进行定期（通常每 6-12 个月）的临床评估、 实验室检测和影像学检查，持续至少 5-10 年以上，以监测疾病复发、治疗不良反应和长期并发症。长期随访的核 心内容：①DTC 随访（每 6-12 个月 Tg 和颈部超声，每年全身扫描或根据风险分层）；②肢端肥大症（每年 IGF- 1、生长抑素受体显像，每 1-2 年垂体 MRI）；③库欣病（每 6 个月晨间皮质醇和 UFC，每年垂体 MRI）； ④MEN1/2 患者（终身多器官筛查，按发病年龄和风险分级）。长期随访的终点：无疾病证据（NED）≥5 年可降 为低风险；但DTC终身随访要求（即使NED，因终身潜在复发风险）。内分泌患者随访是“终身任务”。
vocabulary.example_english: Long-term follow-up is essential for all patients with endocrine malignancies to detect late recurrence and manage treatment-related complications.
vocabulary.example_chinese: 长期随访对所有内分泌恶性肿瘤患者至关重要，以发现晚期复发和管理治疗相关并发症。 ---

literature.title: Insulin Resistance in Type 1 Diabetes: Pathophysiological, Clinical, and Therapeutic Relevance.
literature.title_chinese: 1型糖尿病中的胰岛素抵抗：病理生理、临床及治疗相关性。

paragraphs.english: People with type 1 diabetes (T1D) are usually considered to exclusively exhibit betacell failure, but they frequently also feature insulin resistance. This review discusses the mechanisms, clinical features, and therapeutic relevance of insulin resistance by focusing mainly on human studies using goldstandard techniques (euglycemichyperinsulinemic clamp). In T1D, tissuespecific insulin resistance can develop early and sustain throughout disease progression. The underlying pathophysiology is complex, involving both metabolic- and autoimmunerelated factors operating synergistically. Insulin treatment may play an important pathogenic role in predisposing individuals with T1D to insulin resistance. However, the established lifestylerelated risk factors and peripheral insulin administration inducing glucolipotoxicity, hyperinsulinemia, hyperglucagonemia, inflammation, mitochondrial abnormalities, and oxidative stress cannot always fully explain insulin resistance in T1D, suggesting a phenotype distinct from type 2 diabetes. The mutual interaction between insulin resistance and impaired endothelial function further contributes to diabetesrelated complications. insulin resistance should therefore be considered a treatment target in T1D. Aside from lifestyle modifications, continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion can ameliorate insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia, thereby improving glucose toxicity compared with multiple injection insulin treatment. Among other concepts, metformin, pioglitazone, incretinbased drugs such as GLP-1 receptor agonists, sodiumglucose cotransporter inhibitors, and pramlintide can improve insulin resistance, either directly or indirectly. However, considering the current issues of high cost, side effects, limited efficacy, and their offlabel status, these agents in people with T1D are not widely used in routine clinical care at present.
paragraphs.chinese: 1型糖尿病（T1D）患者通常被认为仅存在β细胞功能衰竭，但常伴有胰岛素抵抗。本综述通过聚焦采用金标准技术（高 胰岛素正葡萄糖钳夹）的人体研究，探讨胰岛素抵抗的机制、临床特征及治疗意义。在T1D中，组织特异性胰岛素抵抗 可早期出现并贯穿疾病全程。其病理生理机制复杂，涉及代谢与自身免疫相关因素的协同作用。胰岛素治疗可能在T1D 患者易发胰岛素抵抗中发挥重要致病作用。然而，已确立的生活方式相关风险因素及外周胰岛素给药所诱导的糖脂毒 性、高胰岛素血症、高胰高血糖素血症、炎症、线粒体异常和氧化应激，并不能完全解释T1D中的胰岛素抵抗，提示其 表型有别于2型糖尿病。胰岛素抵抗与内皮功能受损的相互作用进一步加剧糖尿病相关并发症。因此，胰岛素抵抗应被视 为T1D的治疗靶点。除生活方式干预外，与多次胰岛素注射治疗相比，持续皮下胰岛素输注可改善胰岛素抵抗和高胰岛 素血症，从而减轻葡萄糖毒性。在其他方案中，二甲双胍、吡格列酮、基于肠促胰素的药物（如GLP-1受体激动剂）、 钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白抑制剂及普兰林肽可直接或间接改善胰岛素抵抗。然而，考虑到当前存在的高成本、副作用、疗 效有限及超说明书用药等问题，这些药物在T1D患者中尚未广泛应用于常规临床治疗。

literature.title: New advances in type 1 diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 1型糖尿病的新进展

paragraphs.english: Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune condition resulting in insulin deficiency and eventual loss of pancreatic beta cell function requiring lifelong insulin therapy. Since the discovery of insulin more than 100 years ago, vast advances in treatments have improved care for many people with type 1 diabetes. Ongoing research on the genetics and immunology of type 1 diabetes and on interventions to modify disease course and preserve beta cell function have expanded our broad understanding of this condition. Biomarkers of type 1 diabetes are detectable months to years before development of overt disease, and three stages of diabetes are now recognized. The advent of continuous glucose monitoring and the newer automated insulin delivery systems have changed the landscape of type 1 diabetes management and are associated with improved glycated hemoglobin and decreased hypoglycemia. Adjunctive therapies such as sodium glucose cotransporter-1 inhibitors and glucagonlike peptide 1 receptor agonists may find use in management in the future. Despite these rapid advances in the field, people living in underresourced parts of the world struggle to obtain necessities such as insulin, syringes, and blood glucose monitoring essential for managing this condition. This review covers recent developments in diagnosis and treatment and future directions in the broad field of type 1 diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 1型糖尿病是一种自身免疫性疾病，导致胰岛素缺乏并最终丧失胰腺β细胞功能，需要终身胰岛素治疗。自100多年前发 现胰岛素以来，治疗手段的巨大进步改善了许多1型糖尿病患者的护理。针对1型糖尿病的遗传学、免疫学以及干预疾病 进程、保护β细胞功能的研究，拓展了我们对这种疾病的广泛认知。1型糖尿病的生物标志物在显性疾病出现前数月甚至 数年即可检测到，目前该病被划分为三个阶段。持续葡萄糖监测系统及新型自动化胰岛素输送系统的问世，改变了1型糖 尿病的管理格局，并有助于改善糖化血红蛋白水平、减少低血糖发生。辅助疗法如钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白1抑制剂和胰 高血糖素样肽1受体激动剂未来可能在治疗中发挥作用。尽管该领域进展迅速，但全球资源匮乏地区的人们仍难以获得胰 岛素、注射器和血糖监测等管理疾病所必需的物资。本综述涵盖了1型糖尿病诊断与治疗的最新进展，以及该广阔领域的 未来方向。

literature.title: Searching for LADA in patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis: A tool for the prevention of LADA.
literature.title_chinese: 在桥本甲状腺炎患者中筛查LADA：预防LADA的一种工具

paragraphs.english: autoimmune thyroid diseases (AITD), such as Hashimoto's thyroiditis (HT), frequently cooccur with autoimmune diabetes, including latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA). While guidelines recommend thyroid autoantibody screening in patients with autoimmune diabetes, the reverse approachscreening for diabetesrelated autoantibodies in AITD patientsis not routinely practiced. Given the substantial link between glutamic acid decarboxylase antibodies (GADA) and both thyroid and betacell autoimmunity, we recommend frequent GADA testing in AITD patients, especially those with HT. This screening technique may discover LADA early, leading to timely glycaemic monitoring and treatment measures to protect betacell function and reduce diabetes complications.
paragraphs.chinese: 自身免疫性甲状腺疾病（AITD），如桥本甲状腺炎（HT），常与自身免疫性糖尿病（包括成人隐匿性自身免疫性糖尿病 （LADA））共存。尽管指南建议对自身免疫性糖尿病患者进行甲状腺自身抗体筛查，但反向方法——即在AITD患者中 筛查糖尿病相关自身抗体——并未常规实施。鉴于谷氨酸脱羧酶抗体（GADA）与甲状腺及β细胞自身免疫之间存在显著 关联，我们建议对AITD患者（尤其是HT患者）进行频繁的GADA检测。该筛查技术可能早期发现LADA，从而及时采取 血糖监测和治疗措施，以保护β细胞功能并减少糖尿病并发症。

literature.title: Exploring the Gut Microbiota: Key Insights Into Its Role in Obesity, Metabolic Syndrome, and Type 2 Diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 探索肠道微生物群：关于其在肥胖、代谢综合征和2型糖尿病中作用的关键见解
literature.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

paragraphs.english: The gut microbiota (GM), comprising trillions of microorganisms in the gastrointestinal tract, is a key player in the development of obesity and related metabolic disorders, such as type 2 diabetes (T2D), metabolic syndrome (MS), and cardiovascular diseases. This minireview delves into the intricate roles and mechanisms of the GM in these conditions, offering insights into potential therapeutic strategies targeting the microbiota. The review elucidates the diversity and development of the human GM, highlighting its pivotal functions in host physiology, including nutrient absorption, immune regulation, and energy metabolism. Studies show that GM dysbiosis is linked to increased energy extraction, altered metabolic pathways, and inflammation, contributing to obesity, MS, and T2D. The interplay between dietary habits and GM composition is explored, underscoring the influence of diet on microbial diversity and metabolic functions. Additionally, the review addresses the impact of common medications and therapeutic interventions like fecal microbiota transplantation on GM composition. The evidence so far advocates for further research to delineate the therapeutic potential of GM modulation in mitigating obesity and metabolic diseases, emphasizing the necessity of clinical trials to establish effective and sustainable treatment protocols. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 肠道微生物群（GM）由胃肠道中数万亿微生物组成，在肥胖及2型糖尿病（T2D）、代谢综合征（MS）和心血管疾病等 相关代谢紊乱的发展中扮演关键角色。本综述深入探讨了GM在这些疾病中的复杂作用与机制，为靶向微生物群的潜在治 疗策略提供了见解。文章阐述了人类GM的多样性与发育过程，强调其在宿主生理功能中的核心作用，包括营养吸收、免 疫调节和能量代谢。研究表明，GM失调与能量摄取增加、代谢通路改变及炎症反应相关，进而促进肥胖、MS和T2D的 发生。本文还探讨了饮食习惯与GM组成之间的相互作用，强调饮食对微生物多样性和代谢功能的影响。此外，综述分析 了常见药物及粪菌移植等治疗干预措施对GM组成的影响。现有证据支持进一步研究GM调节在缓解肥胖和代谢疾病中的 治疗潜力，并强调开展临床试验以建立有效且可持续治疗方案的必要性。

literature.title: Maturity onset diabetes of the young and beyond: the changing face of singlegene diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 青少年起病的成人型糖尿病及其扩展：单基因糖尿病的演变面貌。

paragraphs.english: maturity onset diabetes of the young (MODY) is the most common form of monogenic diabetes. A genetic diagnosis can help tailor treatment. However, it is vital to test the right genes. This review discusses the need to test the correct genes and widen the genes that are included on panels while also discussing examples of genes that should be removed from panels due to insufficient evidence. This is important to ensure the maximum number of patients receive a genetic diagnosis while avoiding misdiagnosis and mistreatment. To maximize the costbenefit of genetic testing, we need to select the right patients for genetic testingthis review discusses criteria that increase the chance of a patient having a monogenic cause of their diabetes. Reduced penetrance, where some individuals have the pathogenic genotype but do not exhibit the phenotype, is now known to be increasingly common in MODY and other monogenic disorders. This has important implications when a variant is identified in an unaffected individual. This review highlights recent work that polygenic risk may play a role in determining penetrance.
paragraphs.chinese: 青少年起病的成人型糖尿病（MODY）是单基因糖尿病中最常见的类型。基因诊断有助于制定个体化治疗方案，但关键 在于检测正确的基因。本综述探讨了检测正确基因的必要性，以及扩大检测基因组合范围的必要性，同时讨论了因证据 不足应从检测组合中剔除的基因示例。这对于确保尽可能多的患者获得基因诊断，同时避免误诊和误治至关重要。为最 大化基因检测的成本效益，需筛选合适的患者进行检测——本综述分析了提高患者糖尿病单基因病因检出率的筛选标 准。外显率降低（即携带致病基因型但未表现相应表型）在MODY及其他单基因疾病中日益常见，这一现象对在未患病 个体中发现基因变异具有重要临床意义。本综述强调，多基因风险可能在决定外显率中发挥作用。

literature.title: Prevalence and Clinical Characteristics of NEUROD1-MODY in Chinese EarlyOnset Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and a Literature Review.
literature.title_chinese: 中国早发型2型糖尿病中NEUROD1-MODY的患病率与临床特征及文献综述

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: Maturityonset diabetes of the young resulting from mutations of the NEUROD1 gene (NEUROD1- MODY) is a rare form of diabetes and has not been well studied. We aimed to estimate its prevalence in Chinese patients with earlyonset type 2 diabetes mellitus (EOD) and summarize its clinical and genetic characteristics. METHODS: We performed nextgeneration sequencing in 679 patients with EOD to screen rare variants in NEUROD1 exons and evaluated the effects of variants using in vitro experiments. All the reported NEUROD1-MODY cases were reviewed. Patients carrying pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were diagnosed with NEUROD1-MODY according to the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines. RESULTS: Four rare variants were identified in 679 patients with EOD, but only P197H decreased the transcriptional activity in in vitro functional assays to an extent comparable to the wellknown mutation causing NEUROD1-MODY. Its frequency was pretty higher in the European population (0.024) than that in the East Asian population (0.00034) according to the gnomAD database. Twentyeight previously reported patients could be confirmed as diagnosed. The patients in Asia had a lower body mass index and a higher rate of ketosis compared with Caucasians, and the mutations present in Asia often occurred in the transactivation domain. Neurological abnormalities were observed in 10.7% of the patients with NEUROD1-MODY. CONCLUSIONS: NEUROD1-MODY in Chinese patients with EOD is not common (penetrance than Caucasian and needs further exploration必. The possible differences of phenotypes exist between the two ethnic populations.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：由NEUROD1基因突变引起的青少年发病的成年型侵糖尿病（NEUROD1-MODY）是一种罕见的糖尿病类型，尚未 得到充分研究。我们旨在评估其在中国早发2型糖尿病（EOD）患者中的患病率，并总结其临床和遗传特征。方法：我们 对679名EOD患者进行了二代测序，以筛选NEURO-D1外显子中的罕见变异，并通过体外实验评估变异的影响。回顾了所 有已报道的NEUROD1-MODY病例。根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南，携带致病性或可能致病性变异的患者被 诊断为NEUROD1-MODY。结果：在679名EOD患者中发现了四种罕见变异，但只有P197H在体外功能实验中使转录活 性降低的程度与已知导致NEU梦ROD1-MODY的突变相当。根据gnomAD数据库，该变异在欧洲人群中的频率（0.024） 远高于东亚人群（0.00034）。此前报道的28例患者可被确诊。与白种人相比，亚洲患者的体重指数较低，酮症发生率 较高，且亚洲患者中出现的突变常发生在反式激活结构域。10.7%的NEUROD1-MODY患者观察到神经系统异常。结 论：NEUROD1-MODY在中国EOD患者中并不常见（≤0.15%）。P197H可能在中国人群中导致MODY，且其外显率高 于白种人，需进一步探索。两个种族人群之间可能存在表型差异。

literature.title: Phenotypic features, prevalence of KCNJ11-MODY in Chinese patients with earlyonset diabetes and a literature review.
literature.title_chinese: 中国早发糖尿病患者中KCNJ11-MODY的表型特征、患病率及文献综述。

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVE: Gainoffunction (GOF) variants of KCNJ11 cause neonate diabetes and maturityonset diabetes of the young (KCNJ11-MODY), while lossoffunction (LOF) variants lead to hyperinsulinemia hypoglycemia and subsequent diabetes. Given the limited research of KCNJ11-MODY, we aimed to analyse its phenotypic features and prevalence in Chinese patients with earlyonset type 2 diabetes (EOD). DESIGN, PATIENTS AND MEASUREMENTS: We performed next- generation sequencing on 679 Chinese EOD patients to screen for KCNJ11 exons variants. Bioinformatics prediction and the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines was used to determine the pathogenicity and diagnosed KCNJ11-MODY. A literature review was conducted to investigate the phenotypic features of KCNJ11-MODY. RESULTS: We identified six predicted deleterious rare variants in six EOD patients (0.88%). They were classified as uncertain significance (variant of uncertain significance [VUS]), but more common in this EOD cohort than a general Chinese population database, however, without significant difference (53/10,588, 0.50%) (p = .268). Among 80 previously reported patients with KCNJ11-MODY, 23.8% (19/80) carried 9 (32.1%) LOF variants, who had significantly older age at diagnosis, higher birthweight and higher fasting Cpeptide compared to patients with GOF variants.究 Many patients carrying VUS were not correctly diagnosed. CONCLUSIONS: Some rare variants of KCNJ11 might contribute to the development of Chinese EOD, although available evidence has not enough power to support them as cause of KCNJ11-MODY. The clinical features of LOF variants were different from GOF variants in KCNJ11-MODY patients. It is necessary to evaluate the pathogenicity of VUS through function experiments. 权
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：KCNJ11的功能获得性变异可导致新生儿糖尿病和青少年的成人起病型糖尿病（KCNJ11-MODY），而功能丧失性 变异则引发高胰岛素血症性低血糖及后续糖尿病。鉴于KCNJ11-MODY研究有限，本研究旨在分析中国早发2型糖尿病患 者的表型特征及患病率。设计、患者与测量方法：对679例中国早发2型糖尿病患者进行二代测序，筛查KCNJ11外显子 变异。通过生物信息学预测及美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南判定致病性并诊断KCNJ11-MODY。通过文献综述探 究KCNJ11-MODY的表型特征梦。结果：在6例早发2型糖尿病患者（0.88%）中鉴定出6种预测有害的罕见变异。这些变异 被归类为意义不明确变异，但在本早发2型糖尿病队列中的发生率高于中国普通人群数据库（53/10,588，0.50%），但 差异无统计学意义（p=0.268）。在既往报道的80例KCNJ11-MODY患者中，23.8%（19/80）携带9种（32.1%）功能 丧失性变异，与功能获得性变异患者相比，其诊断年龄显著更大、出生体重更高、空腹C肽水平更高。许多携带意义不明 确变异的患者未得到正确诊断。结论：部分KCNJ11罕见变异可能参与中国早发2型糖尿病的发生，但现有证据尚不足以 支持其为KCNJ11-MODY的致病原因。KCNJ11-MODY患者中功能丧失性变异与功能获得性变异的临床特征存在差异。 有必要通过功能实验评估意义不明确变异的致病性。

literature.title: Revised European Society of Endocrinology Clinical Practice Guideline for the management of aggressive pituitary tumours and pituitary carcinomas.
literature.title_chinese: 修订版欧洲内分泌学会临床实践指南：侵袭性垂体肿瘤与垂体癌的管理

paragraphs.english: Pituitary tumours, originating from endocrine cells of the anterior pituitary, are quite common, and in most cases well- controlled by surgery or medical treatment. However, a small subset of pituitary tumours presents with multiple local recurrences or tumour progression despite combined surgical, medical or radiotherapeutic treatment. These are known as aggressive pituitary tumours (APT); also called aggressive pituitary neuroendocrine tumours (PitNETs); or, in the rare case of metastases, pituitary carcinomas (PC) or metastatic PitNETs. Early identification of APT is challenging but is of major clinical importance as they are associated with an increased morbidity and mortality even in the absence of metastases. Here, we provide a revision of the first international, interdisciplinary European Society of Endocrinology (ESE) clinical practice guideline on APTs and PC (2018). Since publication of the 2018 guideline, results from the second ESE survey on APT and PC were published, and more data on APT treatment, including temozolomide, immune checkpoint inhibitors and bevacizumab, emerged. These data are reviewed in this guideline and translated into a practical algorithm to guide APT and PC management. Furthermore, standardized reporting of imaging and histopathological investigations of these tumours is proposed, and the role of molecular analysis is discussed. Last, a section is dedicated to special circumstances such as APT in pregnancy.
paragraphs.chinese: 垂体肿瘤起源于垂体前叶内分泌细胞，较为常见，多数病例可通过手术或药物治疗得到良好控制。然而，少数垂体肿瘤 即使经过手术、药物或放疗等综合治疗，仍会出现多次局侵部复发或肿瘤进展。这类肿瘤被称为侵袭性垂体肿瘤（APT）， 亦称侵袭性垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNETs）；在罕见转移病例中则称为垂体癌（PC）或转移性PitNETs。早期识别APT 具有挑战性，但具有重要临床意义——即使未发生转移，这类肿瘤仍与发病率和死亡率升高相关。本文对2018年首版国 际跨学科欧洲内分泌学会（ESE）APT及PC临床实践指南进行修订。自2018版指南发布以来，第二项关于APT及PC的 ESE调查结果已公布，同时涌现出更多关于替莫唑胺、免疫检查点抑制剂和贝伐珠单抗等APT治疗数据。本指南对这些数 据进行梳理，并转化为指导APT及PC管理的实用诊疗流程。此外，本文提出此类肿瘤影像学和组织病理学检查的标准化 报告规范，探讨分子分析的作用，并专设章节讨论妊娠期APT等特殊情况。

literature.title: Advances in Drug Treatments for Male Patients with Prolactinomas.
literature.title_chinese: 男性泌乳素瘤患者药物治疗进展

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: Pituitary adenomas (PAs), the most common intracranial neuroendocrine tumors, are typically benign. Among them, prolactinomas - tumors that secrete prolactin - account for approximately 60% of all PAs and are characterized by hyperprolactinemia and potential mass effects. Significant epidemiological and clinical differences exist between male and female prolactinoma patients. SUMMARY: Prolactinomas in male patients tend to be larger and more aggressive, presenting unique challenges in treatment and management. Although dopamine agonists (DAs) remain the firstline therapy, men exhibit higher rates of DA resistance compared to women. For refractory prolactinomas in males, alternative treatments include temozolomide (TMZ), immune checkpoint inhibitors (antiPD-1/PDL1 and antiCTLA4), somatostatin receptor analogs, mTOR inhibitors, tyrosine kinase inhibitors, bevacizumab, and aromatase inhibitors. These therapies may provide greater benefits to men with refractory prolactinomas than to women. KEY MESSAGES: Despite advancements, significant challenges and opportunities persist in managing male prolactinoma patients. Key areas requiring attention include early diagnosis, predicting drug responsiveness, understanding sexspecific molecular mechanisms, and developing novel therapeutic strategies. Largescale clinical trials are crucial to further assess the efficacy and safety of these treatments in men. This review consolidates recent progress in medical therapies and management approaches for male prolactinoma patients.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：垂体腺瘤是最常见的颅内神经内分泌肿瘤，通常为良性。其中，分泌催乳素的催乳素瘤约占所有垂体腺瘤的 60%，以高催乳素血症和潜在占位效应为特征。男性和女性催乳素瘤患者在流行病学和临床表现上存在显著差异。摘 要：男性催乳素瘤患者肿瘤体积更大、侵袭性更强，在治疗和管理方面面临独特挑战。尽管多巴胺激动剂仍是一线疗 法，但男性患者对多巴胺激动剂的耐药率高于女性。针对男性难治性催乳素瘤，替代治疗方案包括替莫唑胺、免疫检查 点抑制剂（抗PD-1/PD-L1和抗CTLA4）、生长抑素受体类似物、mTOR抑制剂、酪氨酸激酶抑制剂、贝伐珠单抗和芳香 化酶抑制剂。这些疗法可能对男性难治性催乳素瘤患者比女性患者带来更大获益。核心信息：尽管取得进展，男性催乳 素瘤患者的管理仍面临重大挑战与机遇。需重点关注早期诊断、药物反应预测、性别特异性分子机制解析及新型治疗策 略开发。大规模临床试验对进一步评估这些疗法在男性患者中的有效性和安全性至关重要。本综述整合了男性催乳素瘤 患者药物治疗和管理策略的最新进展。

literature.topic: 空泡蝶鞍综合征 (empty sella syndrome)
literature.title: A Comprehensive Review of Empty Sella and Empty Sella Syndrome.
literature.title_chinese: 空蝶鞍与空蝶鞍综合征的综合综述

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVE: Incidental radiographic findings of an empty sella are prevalent in up to 35% of the general population. While empty sella was initially considered clinically insignificant, a subset of patients exhibits endocrine or neuroophthalmologic manifestations which are diagnostic of empty sella syndrome (ESS). Recent studies suggest that more patients are affected by ESS than previously recognized, necessitating a deeper understanding of this condition. This comprehensive review describes a practical approach to evaluating and managing ESS. METHODS: Literature review was conducted on etiologies and risk factors associated with primary and secondary empty sella, the radiologic features that differentiate empty sella from other sellar lesions, and the role of clinical history and hormone testing in identifying patients with ESS, as well as treatment modalities. RESULTS: pituitary function testing for somatotroph, lactotroph, gonadotroph, corticotroph, and thyrotroph abnormalities is necessary when suspecting ESS. While an isolated empty sella finding does not require treatment, ESS may require pharmacologic or surgical interventions to address hormone deficits or intracranial hypertension. Targeted hormone replacement as directed by the endocrinologist should align with guidelines and patient- specific needs. Treatment may involve a multidisciplinary collaboration with neurology, neurosurgery, or ophthalmology to address patient symptoms. CONCLUSION: This review underscores the evolving understanding of ESS, stressing the significance of accurate diagnosis and tailored management to mitigate potential neurologic and endocrine complications in affected individuals.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：在普通人群中，空蝶鞍的影像学偶然发现发生率高达35%。虽然空蝶鞍最初被认为无临床意义，但部分患者会出 现内分泌或神经眼科表现，符合空蝶鞍综合征（ES-S）的诊断标准。近期研究表明，ESS的实际患病人数较以往认知更 多，亟需深入理解该疾病。本综述系统阐述了ESS评估与管理的实用方法。方法：通过文献回顾，分析原发性和继发性空 蝶鞍的病因及危险因素、空蝶鞍与其他鞍区病变的影像学鉴别特征、临床病史与激素检测在ESS患者识别中的作用，以及 治疗策略。结果：疑似ESS时，需对生长激素、催乳素、促性腺激素、促肾上腺皮质激素及促甲状腺激素功能进行检测。 单纯空蝶鞍无需治疗，但ESS可能需要药物或手术干预以纠正激素缺乏或颅内高压。内分泌科医生应根据指南及患者个体 需求进行靶向激素替代治疗，必要时联合神经内科、神经外科或眼科进行多学科协作以缓解症状。结论：本综述强调了 对ESS认知的持续更新，指出精准诊断与个体化管理对减少患者潜在神经及内分泌并发症的重要性。

literature.title: The socioeconomic burden of acromegaly.
literature.title_chinese: 肢端肥大症的社会经济负担。

paragraphs.english: acromegaly is a rare and insidious disease characterized by chronic excess growth hormone, leading to various morphological changes and systemic complications. Despite its low prevalence, acromegaly poses a significant socioeconomic burden on patients and healthcare systems. This review synthesizes the current state of knowledge on the psychosocial burden, disability, impact on daily life, and cost of acromegaly disease, focusing on the quality of life, partnership, medical care and treatment afflictions, participation in daily activities, professional and leisure impairment, and cost of treatment for acromegaly and its comorbidities. It also examines management strategies, coping mechanisms, and interventions aimed at alleviating this burden. A comprehensive understanding of the extent of the socioeconomic burden in acromegaly is crucial to develop effective strategies to improve treatment and care. Further research is warranted to explore the myriad factors contributing to this burden, as well as the efficacy of interventions to alleviate it, ultimately enhancing the quality of life for patients with acromegaly.
paragraphs.chinese: 肢端肥大症是一种罕见且隐匿的疾病，其特征是生长激素长期过量，导致多种形态改变和全身性并发症。尽管患病率较 低，但肢端肥大症给患者和医疗系统带来了显著的社会经济负担。本综述综合了关于肢端肥大症社会心理负担、残疾、 对日常生活的影响以及疾病成本的最新知识，重点关注生活质量、伴侣关系、医疗护理与治疗困扰、日常活动参与、职 业与休闲障碍，以及肢端肥大症及其合并症的治疗成本。同时，本文还探讨了旨在减轻这一负担的管理策略、应对机制 和干预措施。全面了解肢端肥大症社会经济负担的程度，对于制定改善治疗和护理的有效策略至关重要。未来需进一步 研究导致这一负担的多种因素，以及减轻负担的干预措施的有效性，最终提升肢端肥大症患者的生活质量。

literature.title: An Overlooked Disease: Minimal Autonomous Cortisol Secretion (MACS). A Narrative Review.
literature.title_chinese: 被忽视的疾病：微小自主性皮质醇分泌（MACS）。一篇叙述性综述。
literature.journal: Endocrine, metabolic & immune disorders drug targets

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: A far more common disease than Cushing's syndrome is subclinical hypercortisolism or mild autonomous cortisol secretion (MACS), with an overall prevalence of 0.2-2%. OBJECTIVE: This review aims to shed light on the prevalence, screening and diagnostic criteria, comorbidities, and management of Mild Autonomous cortisol Secretion (MACS). METHODS: Studies eligible targeted MACS regarding prevalence, screening, comorbidities, management, and clinical outcome. This is a narrativereview. IRB approval was not needed. RESULTS: The 1 mg dexamethasone suppression test (DST) remains the first screening test. MACS is associated with adverse cardiometabolic and renal outcomes, osteoporosis and osteopenia, immunodeficiency, depression, coagulopathy, and sarcopenia. surgery is the gold standard treatment. Medical therapy is recommended when surgery is contraindicated or not feasible. Clinically silent hypercortisolism is a frequent entity that necessitates early detection and treatment. The production of cortisol should be looked at as a spectrum where subtle, undetectable levels can still be produced. They know its association with adverse health outcomes. CONCLUSION: MACS is no longer considered an asymptomatic disorder; repeated hormonal and functional tests are crucial to prevent multiorgan damage. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：比库欣综合征更为常见的疾病是亚临床高皮质醇血症或轻度自主皮质醇分泌（MACS），总体患病率为0.2-2%。 目的：本综述旨在阐明轻度自主皮质醇分泌（MACS）的患病率、筛查与诊断标准、合并症及管理方法。方法：纳入的 研究针对MACS的患病率、筛查、合并症、管理及临床结局。本文为叙述性综述，无需机构审查委员会批准。结果：1毫 克地塞米松抑制试验仍是首选筛查方法。MACS与不良心血管代谢及肾脏结局、骨质疏松与骨量减少、免疫缺陷、抑 郁、凝血功能障碍及肌少症相关。手术是金标准治疗方案，当存在手术禁忌或不可行时推荐药物治疗。临床静默性高皮 质醇血症是一种常见情况，需早期发现与治疗。皮质醇的生成应被视为一个连续谱，即使微量且无法检测的水平仍可能 产生。已知其与不良健康结局相关。结论山：MACS不再被视为无症状疾病；重复激素及功能检查对预防多器官损伤至关 重要。

literature.title: Current challenges in Cushing's syndrome testing: blood, saliva, urine, or hair?
literature.title_chinese: 库欣综合征检测的当前挑战：血液、唾液、尿液还是头发？
literature.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Endogenous Cushing's syndrome is one of the most difficult diagnoses in endocrinology. It is mainly based on biochemical tests that assess qualitative and quantitative alterations in cortisol production. Whether performed on blood, saliva, urine, or hair, the biochemical tests currently available have limited diagnostic specificity and sensitivity. Their performance varies depending on the individual characteristics of the patient, the stage of the disease, and the laboratory techniques used to determine cortisol levels. Knowledge of these factors will help physicians choose the most appropriate diagnostic test for each individual. RECENT FINDINGS: Relevant studies and metaanalyses have clarified the actual performance of various biochemical tests in a realworld setting. In addition, the diagnostic arsenal for Cushing's syndrome has been expanded with new tools, such as hair cortisol and cortisone assays, new methods for measuring cortisol in urine or saliva, and new approaches such as steroid metabolomics or multiomics techniques. SUMMARY: This review is a critical reappraisal of the merits and drawbacks of the various "old" and new biochemical tools. Its purpose is to provide the physician with practical advice on the use of biochemical tests at various stages of Cushing's syndrome in order to improve diagnostic accuracy. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：内源性库欣综合征是内分泌学中最具诊断难度的疾病之一，其诊断主要基于评估皮质醇生成质与量改变的生 化检测。无论是血液、唾液、尿液还是毛发检测，现有生化检测方法的诊断特异性和敏感性均有限。检测效能因患者个 体特征、疾病分期及皮质醇测定实验室技术而异。掌握这些因素有助于医师为每位患者选择最适宜的诊断检测。近期发 现：相关研究与荟萃分析明确了各类生化检测在真实临床环境中的实际效能。此外，库欣综合征的诊断工具库已扩展至 新型手段，包括毛发皮质醇与可的松检测、尿液或唾液皮质醇测定新方法，以及类固醇代谢组学或多组学技术等创新方 案。总结：本综述对各类"传统"与新型生化检测工具的优缺点进行了批判性再评估，旨在为医师提供库欣综合征不同阶段 合理运用生化检测的实用建议，以提升诊断准确性。

paragraphs.english: gout is characterized by increased production of purines (through the pentose phosphate pathway), which is coupled with reduced renal or intestinal excretion of urate. Concurrent upregulation of nutrient surplus signaling (mammalian target of rapamycin and hypoxiainducible factor-1a) and downregulation of nutrient deprivation signaling (sirtuin-1 and adenosine monophosphateactivated protein kinase) redirects glucose toward anabolic pathways (rather than adenosine triphosphate production), thus promoting heightened oxidative stress and cardiomyocyte and proximal tubular dysfunction, leading to cardiomyopathy and kidney disease. hyperuricemia is a marker (rather than a driver) of these cellular stresses. By inducing a state of starvation mimicry in a state of nutrient surplus, sodiumglucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors decrease flux through the pentose phosphate pathway (thereby attenuating purine and urate synthesis) while promoting renal urate excretion. These convergent actions exert a meaningful effect to lower serum uric acid by approximately 0.6 to 1.5 mg/dL and to reduce the risk of gout by 30% to 50% in largescale clinical trials.
paragraphs.chinese: 痛风的特点是嘌呤生成增加（通过磷酸戊糖途径），同时伴随肾脏或肠道尿酸排泄减少。营养过剩信号（雷帕霉素靶蛋 白和缺氧诱导因子-1α）的上调与营养缺乏信号（去乙酰化酶-1和腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶）的下调，共同将葡萄糖转向合成 代谢途径（而非生成三磷酸腺苷），从而加剧氧化应激，导致心肌细胞和近端肾小管功能障碍，进而引发心肌病和肾脏 疾病。高尿酸血症是这些细胞应激的标志物（而非驱动因素）。通过模拟营养过剩状态下的饥饿状态，钠葡萄糖协同转 运蛋白2抑制剂可减少磷酸戊糖途径的通量（从而抑制嘌呤和尿酸的合成），同时促进肾脏尿酸排泄。这些协同作用在大 型临床试验中显著降低血清尿酸水平约0.6至1.5 mg/dL，并将痛风风险降低30%至50%。

literature.title: Update on Physical, Psychological, and Quality of Life Management in Klinefelter Syndrome.
literature.title_chinese: 克氏综合征患者身体、心理及生活质量管理的最新进展
literature.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

paragraphs.english: CONTEXT: Klinefelter syndrome (KS), most commonly arises from a 47,XXY karyotype. While KS affects around 1 in 450 to 600 male births, an estimated 50% to 75% of cases go undiagnosed. Individuals with KS are at increased risk of metabolic, cardiovascular, and reproductive comorbidities, increasing mortality risk, psychological burden, and significantly diminished healthrelated quality of life (HRQoL) compared to healthy controls. We provide an updated review of the recent literature on the clinical management for people with KS, associated comorbidities, and the implications on HRQoL. EVIDENCE ACQUISITION: A comprehensive literature search was conducted of key databases MEDLINE, CINAHL, Cochrane, Psychinfo, and EMBASE, followed by a gray search of relevant key papers in KS with medical guideline organizations being searched online and, where available, their publications and proposed guidelines being assessed. All databases were searched from their inception until December 2024, and Englishlanguage restrictions applied. EVIDENCE SYNTHESIS: Current evidence highlights the need for early detection, the importance of appropriate medication management, and multidisciplinary care to address infertility, cancer risks, neurocognitive deficits, and adverse mental health. Lifespanspecific interventions remain underexplored, necessitating further research to optimize outcomes and refine clinical guidelines. CONCLUSION: KS management is guided by only one endorsed guideline. International and interprofessional collaboration is needed to develop consensus documents. Existing guidelines pay minimal attention to the numerous HRQoL challenges, overlooking the effect and diagnosis of psychological comorbidities. Enhancing HRQoL and optimizing physical and mental wellbeing should be prioritized to improve HRQoL outcomes in people with KS.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：克兰费尔特综合征（KS）最常见源于47,XXY核型。尽管KS影响约1/450至1/600的男性新生儿，但估计有50%至 75%的病例未被确诊。与健康对照组相比，KS患者发生代谢、心血管和生殖系统合并症的风险更高，死亡风险增加，心 理负担加重，健康相关生活质量（HR-Qo山L）显著下降。本文对KS患者临床管理、相关合并症及其对HR-QoL影响的最新 文献进行了综述更新。证据获取：对MEDLINE、CINAHL、Cochrane、Psychinfo和EMBASE等主要数据库进行了全面 文献检索，随后对KS相关重要论文进行灰色文献检索，并在线检索医学指南组织，评估其已发表文献和拟议指南。所有 数据库检索时间均从建库至2024年12月，并限定英文文献。证据综合：现有证据强调早期检测的重要性、合理用药管理 的必要性，以及通过多学科协作解决不孕不育、癌症风险、神经认知缺陷和不良心理健康问题。针对不同生命周期的干 预措施仍研究不足，需进一步研究以优化结局并完善临床指南。结论：KS管理仅有一项经认可的指南作为指导。需通过 国际与跨专业合作制定共识性文件。现有指南对HR-QoL面临的诸多挑战关注甚少，忽视了心理合并症的影响与诊断。应 优先提升HR-QoL并优化身心健康，以改善KS患者的HR-QoL结局。

literature.title: Navigating fertility dilemmas across the lifespan in girls with Turner syndromea scoping review.
literature.title_chinese: 特纳综合征女孩一生中面临的生育困境——一项范围综述。

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: Girls with Turner syndrome (TS) lack a partial or complete sex chromosome, which causes an accelerated decline of their ovarian reserve. Girls have to deal with several dilemmas related to their fertility, while only a limited number of them are referred to a fertility specialist and counselled about options of family planning on time. OBJECTIVE AND RATIONALE: This scoping review provides an update of the literature on fertility in girls with TS throughout their lifespan and aims to propose a clinical practice guideline on fertility in TS. SEARCH METHODS: Databases of PubMed, Embase, and Web of science were searched using the following key terms: Turner syndrome, fertility, puberty, pregnancy, sexhormones, karyotype, fertility preservation, assisted reproductive techniques, and counselling, alongside relevant subject headings and synonymous terms. English language articles published since 2007 were critically reviewed. Pregnancies after using donated oocytes and data about girls with TS with Ychromosomal content were excluded. OUTCOMES: This search identified 1269 studies of which 120 were extracted for the review. The prevalence of natural conception ranged from 15% to 48% in women with 45,X/46,XX, 1% to 3% in women with 45,X, and 4% to 9% in women with other TS karyotypes. When assessing a girl's fertility potential, it was crucial to determine the karyotype in two cell lines, because hidden mosaicism may exist. In addition to karyotype, assessment of antiMullerian hormone (AMH) played a significant role in estimating ovarian function. Girls with AMH above the detection limit were most likely to experience spontaneous thelarche, menarche, and ongoing ovarian function during the reproductive lifespan. fertility preservation became more routine practice: vitrification of oocytes was reported in 58 girls with TS and a median of five oocytes were preserved per stimulation. ovarian tissue cryopreservation has demonstrated the presence of follicles in approximately 30% of girls with TS, mostly in girls with mosaicTS, spontaneous puberty, and AMH above the detection limit. Although girls and their parents appreciated receiving counselling on fertility in TS, only one in ten girls with TS received specialized counselling. Unfamiliarity with fertility preservation techniques or uncertainties regarding the eligibility of a girl for fertility preservation constituted barriers for healthcare professionals when discussing fertility with girls with TS. WIDER IMPLICATIONS: There currently is a high demand for fertility preservation techniques in girls with TS. A reliable prognostic model to determine which girls with TS might benefit from fertility preservation is lacking. Only a minority of these girls received 云comprehensive fertility counselling on the full spectrum of fertility, including uncertainties of fertility preservation, pregnancy risks, and alternatives, such as adoption. fertility preservation could be a viable option for girls with TS. However, the question remains whether enough oocytes can be obtained for a realistic prospect of a live birth. It is important that girls and parents are empowered with the necessary information to make a wellinformed decision.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：特纳综合征（TS）女孩因部分或完全缺失一条性染色体，导致其卵巢储备功能加速衰退。这些女孩需面对与生育 能力相关的多重困境，但仅有少数被转诊至生育专科医生处，并接受关于计划生育选项的及时咨询。目的与依据：本范 围综述更新了TS女孩全生命周期生育能力的文献，旨在提出TS患者生育管理的临床实践指南。检索方法：在PubMed、 Embase和Web of Science数据库中，使用以下关键词进行检索：特纳综合征、生育能力、青春期、妊娠、性激素、核 型、生育力保存、辅助生殖技术及咨询，同时结合相关主题词和同义词。对2007年以来发表的英文文献进行严格评审。 排除使用捐赠卵母细胞妊娠的案例及含Y染色体成分的TS女孩数据。结果：共检索到1269项研究，其中120项纳入分析。 自然受孕率在45,X/46,XX核型女性中为15%-48%，45,X核型女性为1%-3%，其他TS核型女性为4%-9%。评估女孩生育 潜力时，需确定两种细胞系的核型，因为可能存在隐匿性嵌合体。除核型外，抗缪勒管激素（AMH）检测在评估卵巢功 能中起关键作用。AMH高于检测阈值的女孩更可能经历自发性乳房发育、月经初潮，并在生育年龄维持卵巢功能。生育 力保存逐渐成为常规操作：58例TS女孩报告了卵母细胞玻璃化冷冻，每次刺激平均保存5枚卵母细胞。卵巢组织冷冻保 存显示约30%的TS女孩存在卵泡，主要为嵌合型TS、自发性青春期及AMH高于检测阈值的女孩。尽管女孩及其父母认可 接受TS生育咨询，但仅十分之一的TS女孩获得专业咨询。医疗专业人员在与TS女孩讨论生育问题时，因对生育力保存技 术不熟悉或对女孩是否符合保存条件存在不确定性而面临障碍。广泛意义：目前TS女孩对生育力保存技术需求极高，但 缺乏可靠的预测模型来确定哪些TS女孩可能从中获益。仅少数女孩接受了涵盖生育能力全貌（包括生育力保存的不确定 性、妊娠风险及领养等替代方案）的全面生育咨询。对于部分TS女孩而言，生育力保存可能是可行选择。

literature.topic: 多囊卵巢综合征 (polycystic ovary syndrome)
literature.title: Lifestyle management in polycystic ovary syndrome - beyond diet and physical activity.
literature.title_chinese: 多囊卵巢综合征的生活方式管理——超越饮食与体育锻炼

paragraphs.english: polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common condition affecting reproductiveaged women with reproductive, metabolic and psychological consequences. Weight and lifestyle (diet, physical activity and behavioural) management are firstline therapy in international evidencebased guidelines for PCOS. While these recommend following populationlevel diet and physical activity guidelines, there is ongoing interest and research in the potential benefit of including psychological and sleep interventions, as well as a range of traditional, complimentary and integrative medicine (TCIM) approaches, for optimal management of PCOS. There is limited evidence to recommend a specific diet composition for PCOS with approaches including modifying protein, carbohydrate or fat quality or quantity generally having similar effects on the presentations of PCOS. With regards to physical activity, promising evidence supports the provision of vigorous aerobic exercise, which has been shown to improve body composition, cardiorespiratory fitness and insulin resistance. Psychological and sleep interventions are also important considerations, with women displaying poor emotional wellbeing and higher rates of clinical and subclinical sleep disturbance, potentially limiting their ability to make positive lifestyle change. While optimising sleep and emotional wellbeing may aid symptom management in PCOS, research exploring the efficacy of clinical interventions is lacking. Uptake of TCIM approaches, in particular supplement and herbal medicine use, by women with PCOS is growing. However, there is currently insufficient evidence to support integration into routine clinical practice. Research investigating inositol supplementation have produced the most promising findings, showing improved metabolic profiles and reduced hyperandrogenism. Findings for other supplements, herbal medicines, acupuncture and yoga is so far inconsistent, and to reduce heterogeneity more research in specific PCOS populations, (e.g. defined age and BMI ranges) and consistent approaches to intervention delivery, duration and comparators are needed. While there are a range of lifestyle components in addition to populationrecommendations for diet and physical activity of potential benefit in PCOS, robust clinical trials are warranted to expand the relatively limited evidencebase regarding holistic lifestyle management. With consumer interest in holistic healthcare rising, healthcare providers will be required to broaden their knowledge pertaining to how these therapies can be safely and appropriately 梦utilised as adjuncts to conventional medical management.
paragraphs.chinese: 多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种常见疾病，影响育龄女性的生殖、代谢及心理健康。国际循证指南将体重与生活方式 （饮食、体力活动及行为）管理作为PCOS的一线疗法。尽管指南建议遵循人群层面的饮食与体力活动指南，但关于心理 干预、睡眠干预以及传统、补充与整合医学（TCIM）方法对PCOS优化管理的潜在益处，仍持续引发关注与研究。目前 尚无充分证据推荐PCOS的特定饮食构成，调整蛋白质、碳水化合物或脂肪的质量或数量等方法对PCOS临床表现的影响 通常相似。在体力活动方面，有前景的证据支持进行高强度有氧运动，该运动已被证实可改善身体成分、心肺功能及胰 岛素抵抗。心理与睡眠干预同样重要——PCOS女性常表现出情绪健康水平低下，且临床及亚临床睡眠障碍发生率较高， 这可能限制其积极改变生活方式的能力。尽管优化睡眠与情绪健康可能有助于PCOS症状管理，但探索临床干预效果的研 究仍较为缺乏。PCOS女性对TCIM方法（尤其是补充剂与草药）的使用率正在上升，但目前尚无充分证据支持将其纳入 常规临床实践。关于肌醇补充剂的研究结果最具前景，显示其可改善代谢指标并降低高雄激素血症。其他补充剂、草 药、针灸及瑜伽的研究结果尚不一致。为减少异质性，需针对特定PCOS人群（如限定年龄与BMI范围）开展更多研究， 并采用一致的干预实施方式、持续时间及对照方案。尽管除人群推荐的饮食与体力活动外，多种生活方式干预对PCOS具 有潜在益处，但仍需开展高质量临床试验以扩展当前相对有限的整体生活方式管理证据基础。随着消费者对整体健康关 注度的提升，医疗保健提供者需拓宽知识储备，了解如何安全、恰当地将这些疗法作为常规医疗管理的辅助手段。

literature.title: Precocious Puberty in Hypothyroidism: MiniReview of Van Wyk- Grumbach Syndrome.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺功能减退症中的性早熟：Van Wyk-Grumbach综合征的迷你综述

paragraphs.english: Severe hypothyroidism can affect a variety of organs and can develop atypical manifestations. Peripheral precocious puberty may be secondary to other endocrinological diseases, which must be taken into account in the differential diagnosis in order to avoid unnecessary additional tests. Van WykGrumbach syndrome is an infrequent manifestation characterized by severe hypothyroidism and incomplete precocious puberty. Diagnosis is made by clinical and complementary tests, and the main treatment goal is to achieve euthyroidism through hormone replacement. prognosis is good once the treatment is established. The aim of this study is to review the available literature about Van WykGrumbach syndrome following the PRISMA statement, and to present the first clinical case published in Spain. We have included the articles published during the period from 1905 to week 40 of 2022. A total of 68 articles have been selected for study and analysis, within which there are 99 published clinical cases. Girls accounted for 92.1% of cases (median age at the diagnosis 8.5 years). metrorrhagia was the most prevalent symptom, present in 80.5% of the girls. abdominal ultrasound was performed in 93.3% of the girls and 97.8% of them had at least one ovarian cyst. All cases were treated with levothyroxine, responding satisfactorily after the first doses of treatment. To conclude, Van WykGrumbach syndrome is characterized by severe hypothyroidism and incomplete precocious puberty, which is important to keep in mind in order to avoid complementary exams and unnecessary surgical interventions. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 严重甲状腺功能减退症可影响多种器官，并出现非典型表现。外周性性早熟可能继发于其他内分泌疾病，在鉴别诊断中 必须考虑这一点，以避免不必要的额外检查。Van Wyk侵-Grumbach综合征是一种罕见表现，其特征为严重甲状腺功能减 退症和不完全性性早熟。诊断需通过临床及辅助检查确定，主要治疗目标是通过激素替代疗法实现甲状腺功能正常化。 一旦开始治疗，预后良好。本研究旨在遵循PRISM-A声明回顾关于Van Wyk-Grumbach综合征的现有文献，并介绍西班 牙首例临床病例。我们纳入了1905年至2山022年第40周期间发表的文章，共筛选出68篇文献进行分析，其中包含99例临 床病例。女性患者占92.1%（诊断时中位年龄8.5岁）。月经过多是最常见症状，见于80.5%的女性患者。93.3%的女性 患者接受了腹部超声检查，其中97.8%存在至少一个卵巢囊肿。所有病例均使用左甲状腺素治疗，首次给药后反应良 好。总之，Van Wyk-Grumbach综合征以严重甲状腺功能减退症和不完全性性早熟为特征，需牢记此特点以避免不必要 的辅助检查和手术干预。

literature.topic: 男性性腺功能减退 (male hypogonadism)
literature.title: Plasma metabolomics in male primary and functional hypogonadism.
literature.title_chinese: 男性原发性和功能性性腺功能减退症的血浆代谢组学研究

paragraphs.english: metabolomics proposes to unveil the molecular machinery involved in each specific disease by the comprehensive analysis of lowmolecularweight metabolites in a biological sample. This narrative minireview analyzes previous studies applying ultrahighperformance liquid chromatographyhighresolution mass spectrometry (HRMS)-based metabolomics to highlight different metabolic pathways involved in male hypogonadism and testosterone replacement therapy, both in the case of insulinsensitive patients with primary hypogonadism and in the case of insulinresistant patients with functional hypogonadism. In functional hypogonadism, metabolomics revealed that different biochemical pathways are affected. In detail, glycolysis is the most important biochemical process involved in these patients. Glucose metabolism is fueled by amino acid degradation, and gluconeogenesis is widely stimulated. Some important pathways, including glycerol, are compromised. Furthermore, mitochondrial electron transport is influenced, namely, by a decrease in ATP production. On the contrary, betaoxidation of short- and mediumchain fatty acids does not represent an energy source in hypogonadal patients. Both lactate and acetylCoA are converted into ketone bodies, which increased immensely. However, carnosine and beta- alanine are greatly reduced. These metabolic changes are associated with increased fatigue and mental confusion. After testosterone replacement therapy, a complete restoration is achieved for only a part of the metabolites. It is of note that only in patients with functional hypogonadism treated with testosterone are ketone bodies produced at high levels, so the symptoms sometimes reported by these patients after the beginning of the therapy (difficulty in concentrating, depressed mood, brain fog, and memory impairment) might represent a specific "keto flulike" syndrome, related to the metabolic ketonic state. 权
paragraphs.chinese: 代谢组学旨在通过对生物样本中低分子量代谢物的全面分析，揭示每种特定疾病涉及的分子机制。本叙述性小型综述分 析了以往基于超高效液相色谱高分辨质谱（HRMS-）的代谢组学研究，以突出男性性腺功能减退症及睾酮替代疗法中涉 及的不同代谢通路，研究对象包括胰岛素敏感的原发性性腺功能减退症患者和胰岛素抵抗的功能性性腺功能减退症患 者。在功能性性腺功能减退症中，代谢组学揭示多种生化通路受到影响。具体而言，糖酵解是这些患者中最重要的生化 过程。葡萄糖代谢由氨基酸降解驱动，糖异生被广泛激活。包括甘油在内的一些重要通路受损。此外，线粒体电子传递 受到影响，表现为ATP生成减少。相反，短链和中链脂肪酸的β氧化并不构成性腺功能减退症患者的能量来源。乳酸和乙 酰辅酶A均转化为酮体，其水平显著升高。然而，肌肽和β-丙氨酸大幅减少。这些代谢变化与疲劳加剧和精神混乱相关。 在睾酮替代疗法后，仅部分代谢物完全恢复。值得注意的是，仅在接受睾酮治疗的功能性性腺功能减退症患者中，酮体 以高水平产生，因此这些患者在治疗开始后有时报告的症状（注意力难以集中、情绪低落、脑雾和记忆障碍）可能代表 一种与代谢性酮症状态相关的特定“酮流感样”综合征。

literature.title: Puberty and Growth in Cystic Fibrosis: A Review.
literature.title_chinese: 囊性纤维化中的青春期与生长：综述。

paragraphs.english: cystic fibrosis (CF) is a chronic disease process that has historically been associated with delayed puberty and growth. Mechanisms for delayed growth and puberty in chronic disease include malnutrition, inflammation, alterations of the growth hormone axis, chronic corticosteroid use, and changes to gonadotropin signaling or release. Early evidence suggested that people with CF have delayed puberty, decreased peak height velocity, and decreased final adult height compared to the general population. Management of delayed puberty in CF typically involves addressing the underlying cause of delay, and evidence for the utility of growth hormone to optimize growth in people with CF is inconsistent. In the era of highly effective modulator therapies for CF, early studies are examining changes in the growth and puberty trajectory in youth with CF. The full impact of highly effective modulator therapy on height outcomes remains unclear.
paragraphs.chinese: 囊性纤维化（CF）是一种慢性疾病过程，历来与青春期延迟和生长迟缓相关。慢性疾病中生长与青春期延迟的机制包括 营养不良、炎症、生长激素轴改变、长期使用皮质类固醇以及促性腺激素信号传导或释放的变化。早期证据表明，与普 通人群相比，CF患者存在青春期延迟、身高增长峰值速度降低以及最终成年身高减少。CF患者青春期延迟的管理通常涉 及解决延迟的根本原因，而生长激素在优化CF患者生长方面的效用证据并不一致。在CF高效调节剂治疗时代，早期研究 正在探讨CF青少年生长与青春期轨迹的变化。高效调节剂治疗对身高结局的全面影响仍不明确。

literature.title: A Comprehensive Review of Syndromic Forms of Obesity: Genetic Etiology, Clinical Features and Molecular Diagnosis.
literature.title_chinese: 综合征性肥胖的综合综述：遗传病因学、临床特征与分子诊断

paragraphs.english: Syndromic obesity refers to obesity occurring with additional clinical findings, such as intellectual disability/developmental delay, dysmorphic features, and congenital malformations. PURPOSE OF REVIEW: To present a narrative review regarding the genetic etiology, clinical description, and molecular diagnosis of syndromic obesity, which is a rare condition with high phenotypic variability and genetic heterogeneity. The following syndromes are presented in this review: PraderWilli, Bardet- Biedl, Pseudohypoparathyroidism, Alstrom, SmithMagenis, Cohen, Temple, 1p36 deletion, 16p11.2 microdeletion, Kleefstra, SIM1-related, BorjesonForssmanLehmann, WAGRO, Carpenter, MORM, and MYT1Lrelated syndromes. RECENT FINDINGS: There are three main groups of mechanisms for syndromic obesity: imprinting, transcriptional activity regulation, and cellular cilia function. For molecular diagnostic, methods of genomewide investigation should be prioritized over sequencing of panels of syndromic obesity genes. In addition, we present novel syndromic conditions that need further delineation, but evidences suggest they have a higher frequency of obesity. The etiology of syndromic obesity tends to be linked to disrupted neurodevelopment (central) and is associated with a diversity of genes and biological pathways. In the genetic investigation of individuals with syndromic obesity, the possibility that the etiology of the syndromic condition is independent of obesity should be considered. The accurate genetic diagnosis impacts medical management, treatment, and prognosis, and allows proper genetic counseling. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 综合征性肥胖是指肥胖伴随其他临床表现，如智力障碍/发育迟缓、畸形特征和先天性畸形。综述目的：本文对综合征性 肥胖的遗传病因、临床描述和分子诊断进行叙述性综述侵，该疾病是一种罕见病，具有高度表型变异性和遗传异质性。本 综述涵盖以下综合征：普拉德威利综合征、巴德比德尔综合征、假性甲状旁腺功能减退症、阿尔斯特伦综合征、史密 斯马吉利综合征、科恩综合征、坦普尔综合征、-1p36缺失综合征、16p11.2微缺失综合征、克利夫斯特拉综合征、 SIM1相关综合征、博耶森福斯曼莱曼综合征、WAGRO综合征、卡彭特综合征、MORM综合征和MYT1L相关综合征。 最新发现：综合征性肥胖的机制主要分为三类：基因组印记、转录活性调控和细胞纤毛功能。在分子诊断方面，应优先 采用全基因组检测方法而非综合征性肥胖基因组合测序。此外，本文提出了一些需要进一步界定的新型综合征，但已有 证据表明这些综合征的肥胖发生率较高。综合征性肥胖的病因往往与神经发育障碍（中枢性）相关，并涉及多种基因和 生物学通路。在对综合征性肥胖患者进行遗传学调查时，应考虑综合征的病因可能与肥胖无关。准确的遗传诊断会影响 医疗管理、治疗和预后，并有助于进行适当的遗传咨询。

literature.topic: 原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症 (primary hyperparathyroidism)
literature.title: Advances in Parathyroid Hormonebased medicines.
literature.title_chinese: 基于甲状旁腺激素的药物的进展。

paragraphs.english: parathyroid hormone (PTH), produced by the parathyroid glands, plays a critical role in the regulation of calcium and phosphate homeostasis, acting primarily on bone and kidney to maintain serum calcium levels within a narrow range. parathyroid hormone also plays important roles in bone remodeling by directly stimulating osteoblasts and osteocytes, integrating its calcemic response with stimulation of bone formation. Through the RANK/RANKligand system, these cells activate osteoclasts, promoting a balanced process of bone formation and resorption that maintains bone density and strength. Dysregulation of PTH, as seen in disorders such as hyper- and hypoparathyroidism, can lead to significant clinical complications. In recent years, major advancements have been made in the development of PTH analogs, aimed at leveraging PTH's physiological effects on bone to treat conditions such as osteoporosis and hypoparathyroidism. While PTH promotes both bone formation and bone resorption, the net outcome may be a gain or loss of bone mass, depending largely on the administration pattern of PTH or its analogs. When PTH is given intermittently (eg, as oncedaily subcutaneous injection), bone formation is favored. Continuous administration of PTH or chronic elevation of blood PTH levels as seen in primary hyperparathyroidism tend to promote bone resorption. parathyroid hormone analogs, such as teriparatide (PTH(1-34)) and the PTHrP analog abaloparatide, administered once daily, have significant efficacy in stimulating bone formation, making them valuable options for the treatment of osteoporosis. Given this capacity to improve bone structure, these analogs hold broader therapeutic potential for other skeletal disorders, including fracture healing and oral bone repair, which expands the scope of PTHbased therapies beyond osteoporosis. Longacting PTH analogs have applications in treating hypoparathyroidism, offering an alternative to conventional treatment with calcium and active vitamin D. This article reviews the molecular mechanisms of approved and emerging PTHbased medicines, their clinical applications, and recent advances in optimizing their therapeutic potential. We also discuss ongoing research aimed at developing nextgeneration PTH analogs with improved efficacy for skeletal and metabolic disorders.
paragraphs.chinese: 甲状旁腺激素（PTH）由甲状旁腺分泌，在调节钙磷稳态中发挥关键作用，主要通过作用于骨骼和肾脏将血清钙水平维 持在狭窄范围内。甲状旁腺激素还通过直接刺激成骨细胞和骨细胞，将钙调节反应与骨形成刺激相结合，在骨重塑中发 挥重要作用。这些细胞通过RANK/RANK配体系统激活破骨细胞，促进骨形成与骨吸收的平衡过程，从而维持骨密度和 强度。PTH调节异常（如甲状旁腺功能亢进或减退）可导致显著的临床并发症。近年来，基于PTH生理效应的类似物研 发取得重大进展，旨在利用其对骨骼的作用治疗骨质疏松症和甲状旁腺功能减退等疾病。虽然PTH既能促进骨形成也能 促进骨吸收，但净效应可能是骨量增加或减少，这主要取决于PTH或其类似物的给药方式。间歇性给药（如每日一次皮 下注射）时，骨形成占优势；而持续性给药或原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进导致的慢性血PTH升高则倾向于促进骨吸收。每 日一次给药的甲状旁腺激素类似物（如特立帕肽[PTH(1-34)]和PTHrP类似物阿巴洛肽）在刺激骨形成方面具有显著疗 效，成为治疗骨质疏松症的重要选择。鉴于其改善骨结构的能力，这些类似物在骨折愈合和口腔骨修复等其他骨骼疾病 中具有更广泛的治疗潜力，拓展了PTH类药物的应用范围。长效PTH类似物可用于治疗甲状旁腺功能减退，为传统钙剂 和活性维生素D治疗提供替代方案。本文综述了已获批和新兴PTH类药物的分子机制、临床应用及优化其治疗潜力的最新 进展，并讨论了旨在开发新一代PTH类似物以改善骨骼和代谢疾病疗效的持续研究。

paragraphs.english: In the present European Society of endocrinology (ESE) clinical guideline, we present recommendations for the diagnosis, management, and monitoring of chronic hypoparathyroidism (HypoPT) in adults. management of HypoPT has changed since the first ESE clinical guideline was published in 2015, as has the knowledge on patient burden of the disease, and the understanding of associated morbidities. In line with the ESE policy, the 2015 guidelines were updated based on uptodate scientific evidence. As HypoPT is an orphan disease, strong evidence for most outcomes is scarce and recommendations were based on careful synthesis of the literature and expert opinion. postsurgical HypoPT should be defined as persisting more than 12 months following surgery; recovery could be expected even thereafter (clinical question I [Q I]). For Q II (optimal treatment of chronic HypoPT), relevant data regarding conventional treatment are lacking for clinically relevant endpoints and longterm effects. PTH replacement therapy reduces the pill burden of conventional therapy, improves various biochemical parameters, and potentially improves QoL. We cannot recommend a substantial role for parathyroid allotransplantation in the treatment of chronic HypoPT (Q III). In conclusion, we present recommendations for the diagnosis, management, and monitoring of chronic HypoPT in adults, to give health care providers practical clinical guidance on the management of this condition. The guideline can serve as a source for preparation of educational materials to empower patients and clinicians. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 在当前欧洲内分泌学会（ESE）临床指南中，我们针对成人慢性甲状旁腺功能减退症（HypoPT）的诊断、管理和监测提 出建议。自2015年首版ESE临床指南发布以来，HypoP侵T的管理方式已发生改变，同时人们对疾病给患者带来的负担及相 关并发症的认识也有所深化。根据ESE政策，2015版指南基于最新科学证据进行了更新。由于HypoPT属于罕见病，多数 结局指标缺乏强有力的证据支持，相关建议基于对文献的审慎整合及专家意见制定。术后HypoPT应定义为术后持续超过 12个月；即使在此时间点后仍可能恢复（山临床问题I [Q I]）。针对问题II（慢性HypoPT的最佳治疗），目前缺乏关于常 规治疗对临床相关终点及长期影响的充分数据。甲状旁腺激素替代疗法可减少常规治疗的药片负担，改善多项生化指 标，并可能提升生活质量。我们不建议将甲状旁腺同种异体移植作为慢性HypoPT的主要治疗手段（问题III [Q III]）。总 之，我们提出成人慢性HypoPT诊断、管理和监测的建议，为医疗工作者提供该疾病管理的实用临床指导。本指南可作为 编写患者及临床医生教育材料的参考依据。

literature.title: Endocrine features of primary mitochondrial diseases.
literature.title_chinese: 原发性线粒体疾病的内分泌特征。
literature.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Primary mitochondrial diseases are one of the most prevalent groups of multisystem genetic disorders. Endocrinopathies associated with mitochondrial diseases may have clinical features that are distinct from the more common forms. We provide an overview of mitochondrial disorder genetics and phenotypes, focusing on recent studies regarding identification and treatment of associated endocrinopathies. RECENT FINDINGS: Known endocrine phenotypes of mitochondrial disorders continue to expand, and now include growth hormone deficiency, hypogonadism, precocious puberty, hypoparathyroidism, hypo- and hyperthyroidism, diabetes, and adrenal insufficiency. Recent studies suggest several genotypephenotype correlations, including those related to nuclear variants. Diagnosis is important, as special considerations should be made in the management of endocrinopathies in mitochondrial patients. Finally, new mitochondrial replacement strategies may soon be available for women interested in preventing mitochondrial disease transmission to offspring. SUMMARY: Patients with multiple endocrinopathies or atypical endocrinopathies should be evaluated for primary mitochondrial disease, as a diagnosis may impact management of these individuals.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：原发性线粒体疾病是最常见的多系统遗传性疾病之一。线粒体疾病相关的内分泌病变可能具有与常见类型不 同的临床特征。本文概述线粒体疾病的遗传学与表型，重点关注近期关于相关内分泌病变识别与治疗的研究。最新发 现：线粒体疾病已知的内分泌表型持续扩展，目前包括生长激素缺乏、性腺功能减退、性早熟、甲状旁腺功能减退、甲 状腺功能减退与亢进、糖尿病及肾上腺皮质功能不全。近期研究表明存在多种基因型表型关联，包括与核基因变异相关 的关联。诊断至关重要，因为线粒体疾病患者的内分泌病变管理需特殊考量。此外，针对希望预防线粒体疾病遗传给后 代的女性，新的线粒体替代策略可能很快问世。总结：对于存在多种内分泌病变或非典型内分泌病变的患者，应评估其 是否患有原发性线粒体疾病，因为诊断可能影响这些患者的治疗管理。

literature.title: Hypoparathyroidism and assisted reproductive technology: considerations while undergoing ovarian hyperstimulation.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状旁腺功能减退与辅助生殖技术：卵巢过度刺激过程中的注意事项
literature.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: hypoparathyroidism (hypoPTH) is a rare disease that requires diligent adherence to treatment regimens to prevent hypocalcemia but also treatmentinduced hypercalcemia and hypercalciuria. The menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and lactation can all impact calcium homeostasis but there is little known regarding the impact of ovarian stimulation. Furthermore, the limited reports suggest no clear association between menstrual phase and calcium balance among those with hypoPTH. With increasing patient utilization of assisted reproductive technology (ART), there is a need for better understanding the care required for patients with hypoparathyroidism pursuing fertility technology. RECENT FINDINGS: There is currently no literature available on patients with hypoparathyroidism and the impact of controlled ovarian stimulation on calcium homeostasis. We present information regarding physiologic changes in pregnancy that impact calcium homeostasis and the first case presentation of a patient with hypoparathyroidism pursuing ART. SUMMARY: This article provides the first insights and guidance when providing fertility care for patients with hypoparathyroidism.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：甲状旁腺功能减退症（hypoPTH）是一种罕见疾病，需要患者严格遵循治疗方案以预防低钙血症，同时避免 治疗引发的高钙血症和高钙尿症。月经周期、妊娠和哺乳均可能影响钙稳态，但关于卵巢刺激的影响知之甚少。此外， 有限的研究报告表明，在甲状旁腺功能减退症患者中，月经周期与钙平衡之间无明显关联。随着患者对辅助生殖技术 （ART）的使用增加，需更深入了解甲状旁腺功能减退症患者在接受生育技术时的护理需求。最新发现：目前尚无关于 甲状旁腺功能减退症患者及控制性卵巢刺激对钙稳态影响的文献。本文介绍了妊娠期影响钙稳态的生理变化，并首次报 告一例甲状旁腺功能减退症患者接受辅助生殖技术的病例。总结：本文为甲状旁腺功能减退症患者的生育护理提供了初 步见解与指导。 -

literature.title: Epidemiologic changes in thyroid disease.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺疾病的流行病学变化。
literature.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: To analyze the evolving epidemiologic trends in thyroid disease, focusing on risk factors, underlying drivers of these changes, and their implications on clinical practice and research priorities. RECENT FINDINGS: thyroid disease remains one of the most prevalent groups of disorders globally, and the shift in its frequency and distribution is multifactorial. The prevalence of hypothyroidism increases with age, although normal thyrotropin ranges appear to be age- dependent, raising concern for potentially inappropriate levothyroxine use. hyperthyroidism and Graves' disease continue to be predominant in reproductiveage women but exhibit a milder phenotype at diagnosis. Thyroid nodules are increasingly found in asymptomatic patients, likely from more widespread use of neck and chest imaging. thyroid cancer incidence has risen exponentially over the years, mostly driven by overdiagnosis of lowrisk tumors; however, a small rise in incidence of higher risk tumors has been noted. obesity appears to be a risk factor for thyroid cancer occurrence and more aggressive forms of the disease. SUMMARY: Understanding epidemiologic trends in thyroid disease is crucial for guiding clinical practice and research efforts, aiming to optimize patient outcomes while preventing unnecessary and potentially harmful interventions.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：分析甲状腺疾病流行病学趋势的演变，重点关注风险因素、这些变化的潜在驱动因素及其对临床实践和研究 重点的影响。最新发现：甲状腺疾病仍是全球最常见的疾病群之一，其频率和分布的变化受多因素影响。甲状腺功能减 退症的患病率随年龄增长而增加，但正常促甲状腺激素范围似乎与年龄相关，这引发了对左甲状腺素可能不当使用的担 忧。甲状腺功能亢进症和格雷夫斯病在育龄女性中仍占主导地位，但诊断时表型较轻。甲状腺结节在无症状患者中越来 越常见，可能源于颈部和胸部影像学检查的广泛使用。甲状腺癌发病率多年来呈指数级增长，主要归因于低风险肿瘤的 过度诊断；然而，高风险肿瘤的发病率略有上升。肥胖似乎是甲状腺癌发生及更具侵袭性疾病的危险因素。总结：理解 甲状腺疾病的流行病学趋势对于指导临床实践和研究工作至关重要，旨在优化患者预后，同时避免不必要且可能有害的 干预措施。

literature.title: Management Aspects of Medical Therapy in Graves Disease.
literature.title_chinese: 格雷夫斯病药物治疗的管理方面

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVE: Graves disease (GD) is the most common cause of hyperthyroidism. Treatment options include antithyroid drugs (ATDs), radioactive iodine, and surgery. In this review, we focus on the medical aspects of managing GD. METHODS: The authors conducted a literature review of PubMed to include studies and review articles on GD management, ATDs, longterm safety of antithyroid drugs, hyperthyroidism in pregnancy, Graves ophthalmopathy, and special circumstances related to hyperthyroidism. RESULTS: In adjunction to ATDs, medical management for GD also includes betablockers, glucocorticoids, and iodine containing agents. ATDs are currently the preferred option for initial management of GD, reflecting a shift in practice observed in the United States over the past 2 decades. ATDs in appropriate doses are welltolerated and safe when used for longer duration, during pregnancy, and other circumstances discussed in this article. Routine thyroid function tests are important for monitoring. thyrotropin receptor antibody plays an essential role in determining duration of treatment and assessing the likelihood of recurrence. CONCLUSION: Medical management of GD with antithyroid drug is safe and effective. Longterm use beyond 24 months in patients with elevated thyrotropin receptor antibody is a reasonable alternative option to surgery and radioactive iodine due to higher rates of remission.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：格雷夫斯病（GD）是甲状腺功能亢进症最常见的病因。治权疗方案包括抗甲状腺药物（ATDs）、放射性碘和手 术。本综述重点关注GD的药物治疗管理。方法：作者对PubMed进行文献综述，纳入关于GD管理、ATDs、抗甲状腺药 物长期安全性、妊娠期甲状腺功能亢进症、格雷夫斯眼侵病及甲状腺功能亢进症相关特殊情况的文献和综述文章。结果： 除ATDs外，GD的药物治疗还包括β受体阻滞剂、糖皮质激素和含碘制剂。目前ATDs是GD初始治疗的首选方案，这反映 了美国过去20年临床实践的转变。在适当剂量下，-ATDs在长期使用、妊娠期及本文讨论的其他情况下具有良好的耐受性 和安全性。常规甲状腺功能检测对监测至关重要。促甲状腺激素受体抗体在确定治疗时长和评估复发可能性中发挥关键 作用。结论：使用抗甲状腺药物进行GD的药物治疗安全有效。对于促甲状腺激素受体抗体升高的患者，持续使用超过24 个月的长期治疗因缓解率更高，梦是手术和放射性碘治疗的合理替代方案。

literature.title: The genetics of Graves' disease.
literature.title_chinese: 格雷夫斯病的遗传学

paragraphs.english: Graves' disease (GD) is the commonest cause of hyperthyroidism and has a strong female preponderance. Everyday clinical practice suggests strong aggregation within families and twin studies demonstrate that genetic factors account for 60-80% of risk of developing GD. In this review, we collate numerous genetic studies and outline the discoveries over the years, starting with historic candidate gene studies and then exploring more recent genomewide linkage and association studies, which have involved substantial cohorts of East Asian patients as well as those of European descent. Variants in genes including HLA, CTLA4, and PTPN22 have been shown to have substantial individual effects on disease susceptibility. In addition, we examine emerging evidence concerning the possibility that genetic variants may correlate with relevant clinical phenotypes including age of onset of GD, severity of thyrotoxicosis, goitre size and relapse of hyperthyroidism following antithyroid drug therapy, as well as thyroid eye disease. This review supports the inheritance of GD as a complex genetic trait, with a growing number of more than 80 susceptibility loci identified so far. Future implementation of more targeted clinical therapies requires larger studies investigating the influence of these genetic variants on the various phenotypes and different outcomes of conventional treatments.
paragraphs.chinese: 格雷夫斯病（GD）是甲状腺功能亢进症最常见的病因，且具有显著的女性发病优势。日常临床实践表明该病存在明显的 家族聚集性，双胞胎研究证实遗传因素占GD发病风险的60-80%。本综述系统梳理了众多遗传学研究，从早期的候选基 因研究到近期涉及大量东亚裔及欧洲裔人群的全基因组连锁与关联研究，揭示了HLA、CTLA4、PTPN22等基因变异对疾 病易感性的显著个体效应。此外，我们探讨了基因变异与相关临床表型（包括GD发病年龄、甲状腺毒症严重程度、甲状 腺肿大小、抗甲状腺药物治疗后甲亢复发及甲状腺眼病）之间可能关联的新证据。本综述支持GD作为复杂遗传性状的遗 传模式，目前已发现超过80个易感位点。未来实施更具靶向性的临床治疗，需要更大规模的研究来探究这些遗传变异对 各类表型及常规治疗不同结局的影响。

literature.title: Considerations in the Diagnosis and Management of Thyroid Dysfunction in Older Adults.
literature.title_chinese: 老年人甲状腺功能障碍诊断与管理的考量因素
literature.journal: Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association

paragraphs.english: Background: thyroid dysfunction is common in older adults and poses diagnostic and management challenges for clinicians. In this narrative review, we present published data focusing on special considerations in the diagnosis and management of hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism in older adults. Methods: A comprehensive literature search of the PubMed and Ovid MEDLINE databases was conducted from January 2000 to December 2024 to identify pertinent articles in English for this narrative review. Results: Due to significant cardiovascular risk if untreated, both overt hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism should be treated in older adults. Findings from observational studies do not support treating older adults with subclinical hypothyroidism with a thyrotropin (TSH) <7 mIU/L. However, observational data have demonstrated an increased risk of cardiovascular mortality and stroke in older adults with subclinical hypothyroidism with TSH 7.0-9.9 mIU/L and of coronary heart disease, cardiovascular mortality, and heart failure in those with TSH >/=10 mIU/L, suggesting levothyroxine treatment in these individuals should be considered. Data from clinical trials failed to show improvement with levothyroxine in hypothyroidism symptoms or fatigue in older adults with subclinical hypothyroidism compared with placebo. Over- and underreplacement with thyroid hormone is common and should be avoided, as populationbased studies have shown associations with adverse cardiovascular and skeletal events. subclinical hyperthyroidism with a TSH <0.1 mIU/L should be treated in older individuals as it has been associated with increased cardiovascular risk and bone density loss based on observational data. Randomized controlled trials have shown that longterm lowdose methimazole is a viable alternative to radioactive iodine in older adults with hyperthyroidism. Conclusions: A personalized approach should be undertaken in the diagnosis and management of thyroid dysfunction in older adults. Multiple factors should be considered, including physiological agerelated changes in thyroid function, comorbidities, and polypharmacy. Care should be taken to maintain euthyroidism in order to avoid adverse events.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：甲状腺功能障碍在老年人中较为常见，给临床医生的诊断和管理带来挑战。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们重点介绍 了关于老年人甲状腺功能减退症和甲状腺功能亢进症诊断与管理的特殊考量因素的相关已发表数据。方法：对PubMed 和Ovid MEDLINE数据库进行2000年1月至2024年12月的全面文献检索，以确定本叙述性综述相关的英文文章。结果： 由于未经治疗会带来显著的心血管风险，老年人显性甲状腺功能减退症和甲状腺功能亢进症均应接受治疗。观察性研究 结果不支持对促甲状腺激素（TSH）<7 mIU/L的亚临床甲状腺功能减退症老年患者进行治疗。然而，观察性数据显示， TSH为7.0-9.9 mIU/L的亚临床甲状腺功能减退症老年患者心血管死亡和卒中风险增加，而TSH≥10 mIU/L的患者冠心 病、心血管死亡和心力衰竭风险增加，提示应考虑对这些个体进行左甲状腺素治疗。临床试验数据未能显示与安慰剂相 比，左甲状腺素能改善亚临床甲状腺功能减退症老年患者的甲状腺功能减退症状或疲劳。甲状腺激素的过度或不足替代 治疗较为常见，应予以避免，因为基于人群的研究显示其与不良心血管和骨骼事件相关。对于TSH<0.1 mIU/L的亚临床 甲状腺功能亢进症老年患者应进行治疗，因为观察性数据显示其与心血管风险增加和骨密度下降相关。随机对照试验表 明，在老年甲状腺功能亢进症患者中，长期低剂量甲巯咪唑是放射性碘的可行替代方案。结论：老年人甲状腺功能障碍 的诊断和管理应采取个体化方法。需考虑多种因素，包括甲状腺功能随年龄的生理性变化、合并症及多重用药。应谨慎 维持甲状腺功能正常状态，以避免不良事件发生。

literature.title: Thyroid dysfunction and female infertility. A comprehensive review.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺功能障碍与女性不孕症：一项全面综述

paragraphs.english: INTRODUCTION: Female infertility is defined as the inability to achieve pregnancy following one year of consistent, unprotected sexual intercourse. Among the various endocrine factors contributing to this complex issue, thyroid dysfunction assumes a pivotal and noteworthy role. METHODS: A narrative review, encompassing 134 articles up to 2023, was conducted utilizing the PubMed/Medline, EMBASE, and Scielo databases. The primary focus of this review was to investigate the effects of thyroid dysfunction on female infertility. RESULTS: Thyroid disorders exert a significant influence on folliculogenesis, fertilization, and implantation processes. Thyroid autoimmunity, although associated with diminished ovarian reserve, does not typically necessitate levothyroxine therapy. On the other hand, both subclinical and overt hypothyroidism often require levothyroxine treatment to enhance fertility and optimize obstetric outcomes. hyperthyroidism warrants prompt intervention due to its heightened risk of miscarriage. Furthermore, thyroid dysfunction exerts notable effects on assisted reproductive technologies, underscoring the importance of achieving euthyroidism prior to ovarian stimulation. CONCLUSION: Women presenting with thyroid dysfunction must undergo meticulous and individualized assessments since fertility outcomes, whether achieved through natural conception or assisted reproductive technologies, can be significantly influenced by thyroidrelated factors.
paragraphs.chinese: 引言：女性不孕症定义为在规律无保护性交一年后未能妊娠。在导致这一复杂问题的多种内分泌因素中，甲状腺功能障 碍扮演着关键且值得关注的角色。方法：通过检索PubMed/Medline、EMBASE和Scielo数据库，对截至2023年的134 篇文献进行叙述性综述。本综述主要探讨甲状腺功能障碍对女性不孕症的影响。结果：甲状腺疾病对卵泡发育、受精及 胚胎着床过程具有显著影响。甲状腺自身免疫虽与卵巢储备功能下降相关，但通常无需左甲状腺素治疗。而亚临床和显 性甲状腺功能减退症常需左甲状腺素治疗以改善生育能力及优化产科结局。甲状腺功能亢进症因流产风险升高需及时干 预。此外，甲状腺功能障碍对辅助生殖技术具有显著影响，凸显了在卵巢刺激前实现甲状腺功能正常化的重要性。结 论：甲状腺功能障碍女性必须接受细致且个体化的评估，因为无论通过自然受孕还是辅助生殖技术实现的生育结局，均 可能受到甲状腺相关因素的显著影响。

literature.title: Hypothyroidism in Older Adults: A Narrative Review.
literature.title_chinese: 老年人甲状腺功能减退症：叙述性综述。
literature.journal: Endocrine, metabolic & immune disorders drug targets

paragraphs.english: The prevalence of hypothyroidism increases along with aging, resulting in one of the most common comorbidities among patients over 75 years. The leading causes of hypothyroidism in older adults are iatrogenic, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, and medications. The narrative review aimed to discuss the clinical characteristics of hypothyroidism in older adults and the impact of hormonal replacement therapy on survival rates. Thyroid function declines over time due to physiological changes in the thyroid stimulating hormone signaling, iodine absorption and metabolism, thyroid hormone metabolism, and activity at peripheral sites. A serum TSH value over the upper limit of the normal reference range is not necessarily attributable to hypothyroidism. However, an appropriate diagnostic workup is required to rule out true hypothyroidism and discriminate the etiology (i.e., thyroid autoimmune diseases, iodine deficiency, druginduced hypothyroidism). levothyroxine treatment should be considered in cases of overt hypothyroidism. A complete risktobenefit assessment, particularly considering the overall health status, life expectancy, cognitive function, mood, and cardiovascular and neurological background, should be considered before treating subclinical hypothyroidism with more potential benefits in patients under 75 years old. levothyroxine formulations facilitating hormone absorption and increasing compliance to longterm treatment should be preferred. TSH target should usually be set over 3 mIU/ml. Defining optimal diagnostic approaches and targeted therapeutic strategies should be considered in the personalized management of aged patients with hypothyroidism.
paragraphs.chinese: 甲状腺功能减退症的患病率随年龄增长而升高，成为75岁以上患者最常见的合并症之一。老年人甲状腺功能减退的主要 病因包括医源性因素、桥本甲状腺炎及药物影响。本综述旨在探讨老年甲减的临床特征及激素替代治疗对生存率的影 响。由于促甲状腺激素信号传导、碘吸收与代谢、甲状腺激素代谢及外周组织活性等生理变化，甲状腺功能会随时间推 移逐渐下降。血清TSH值超过正常参考范围上限不一定归因于甲减，但需通过适当诊断流程排除真性甲减并鉴别病因 （如甲状腺自身免疫性疾病、碘缺乏、药物性甲减）。显性甲减应考虑左甲状腺素治疗。对于75岁以下患者，治疗亚临 床甲减前需进行完整的风险获益评估，尤其需综合考虑整体健康状况、预期寿命、认知功能、情绪状态及心血管与神经 系统基础疾病。应优先选择促进激素吸收且能提高长期治疗依从性的左甲状腺素制剂。TSH目标值通常设定为高于3 mIU/ml。在老年甲减患者的个体化管理中，应明确最佳诊断方法及靶向治疗策略。
