literature.title: Reimagining the Therapeutic Approach for Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer: The Roadmap to a Cure.
literature.title_chinese: 重新构想间变性甲状腺癌的治疗方法：治愈之路
literature.journal: Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association

paragraphs.english: Background: anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) is an aggressive cancer that leads to rapid death if left untreated. However, recent advances in ATC treatment have dramatically changed the prognosis in a select group of patients with BRAF(V600E) mutations. In these patients, BRAF/MEK inhibitors have been shown to dramatically and rapidly shrink tumors. Yet, these responses are shortlived unless additional treatment modalities are applied. In patients without a BRAF(V600E) mutation, the current available therapies are far less effective. Summary: In this article, we review the relevant literature and propose applying the "Total therapy" approach used since the 1960s for another deadly but curable disease, acute lymphocytic leukemia, to ATC. We have adapted the concepts of Induction, Consolidation, and Maintenance, applying them to ATC. This regimen integrates the treatments we have found to be successful in ATC: combination systemic therapy using targeted therapy plus immunotherapy, surgery, radiation, and continuation of the systemic therapy for several years, thereby attempting to eradicate all residual ATC cells. Conclusions: There has been a renewed interest in understanding the genomics of ATC and treating these patients with urgency rather than just providing palliative care. This shift has led to significant improvements in the prognosis of ATC. With the right tools and a clear roadmap to guide us, we now aim to take on the challenge of curing these patients.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：未分化甲状腺癌（ATC）是一种侵袭性癌症，若不治疗将迅速致命。然而，近年来ATC治疗的进展显著改变了部分 携带BRAF(V600E)突变患者的预后。研究表明，BRAF/MEK抑制剂可快速且显著缩小这类患者的肿瘤。但若不联合其他 治疗手段，这种疗效难以持久。对于无BRAF(V600E)突侵变的患者，现有疗法的效果则远不理想。摘要：本文通过文献回 顾，提出将自20世纪60年代起用于治疗另一种致命但可治愈疾病——急性淋巴细胞白血病的"整体治疗"策略应用于 ATC。我们借鉴了诱导、巩固和维持治疗的概念，将其整合为针对ATC的治疗方案：联合靶向治疗与免疫治疗的全身性疗 法、手术、放疗，并持续数年维持全身治疗，旨在彻底清除所有残留的ATC细胞。结论：近年来，学界重新聚焦于ATC基 因组学研究，并以紧迫态度积极治疗患者，而非仅提供姑息护理。这一转变显著改善了ATC的预后。凭借合适的工具与清 晰的路线图，我们正致力于攻克治愈这些患者的挑战。

literature.title: Thyroid cancer and insulin resistance.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺癌与胰岛素抵抗。

paragraphs.english: thyroid cancer has shown a parallel increase with diabetes in the last few years. This narrative review aims to explain the association between these two entities, focusing on insulin resistance as the mediator and exploring the effects of antidiabetic agents on thyroid cancer incidence and progression.We searched Pubmed for Englishwritten articles on insulin resistance, diabetes, antidiabetic treatments, and thyroid cancer reported from January 2019 to April 2023. Exclusion criteria were preclinical and clinical studies involving a population with thyroid dysfunction, benign nodular goiter, or those that only analyzed thyroid cancer's association with obesity.The results of the narrative literature review revealed 96 articles. Additionally, four studies from a manual search were retrieved. After the exclusion criteria were applied, we included 20 studies. Out of 8 studies on insulinresistant or metabolic syndrome patients, all suggest a positive association with thyroid cancer. At the same time, for diabetes, four out of five publications support a link with thyroid cancer. The seven remaining studies on antidiabetics suggest that metformin might benefit thyroid cancer. In contrast, the evidence for an association between Glucagonlike peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RA) and increased thyroid cancer findings is limited.In conclusion, the association between thyroid cancer and diabetes may be explained by insulin resistance, as shown in observational studies. However, the causal role is yet to be defined. Although the wide use of different antidiabetic agents has been related to thyroid cancer prevalence and progression, future research with drugs such as metformin or GLP-1 RA is still needed. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 过去几年中，甲状腺癌与糖尿病的发病率同步上升。本叙述性综述旨在解释这两种疾病之间的关联，重点关注胰岛素抵 抗作为中介因素，并探讨抗糖尿病药物对甲状腺癌发病率和进展的影响。我们检索了PubMed上2019年1月至2023年4 月期间发表的关于胰岛素抵抗、糖尿病、抗糖尿病治疗与甲状腺癌的英文文献。排除标准包括涉及甲状腺功能障碍、良 性结节性甲状腺肿人群的临床前和临床研究，以及仅分析甲状腺癌与肥胖关联的研究。叙述性文献综述结果显示共96篇 文章，另通过手动检索获得4项研究。应用排除标准后，我们纳入20项研究。在8项针对胰岛素抵抗或代谢综合征患者的 研究中，所有结果均提示与甲状腺癌呈正相关；而关于糖尿病，5篇文献中有4篇支持其与甲状腺癌的关联。其余7项关于 抗糖尿病药物的研究表明，二甲双胍可能对甲状腺癌有益，而胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RA）与甲状腺癌风 险增加的关联证据有限。结论：观察性研究表明，甲状腺癌与糖尿病的关联可能通过胰岛素抵抗解释，但因果关系尚未 明确。尽管不同抗糖尿病药物的广泛使用与甲状腺癌患病率和进展相关，但未来仍需开展针对二甲双胍或GLP-1 RA等药 物的研究。

literature.title: Dermatologic manifestations of thyroid disease: a literature review.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺疾病的皮肤表现：文献综述。

paragraphs.english: INTRODUCTION: thyroid hormone is considered one of the key regulatory hormones for skin homeostasis. Multiple organs are affected by the release of peripheral thyroid hormones (T4 and T3) further regulating various functions at a cellular level. Specifically, skin is considered an important target organ in which the thyroid hormone has a significant impact. Multiple skin diseases are associated with thyroid hormone dysregulation. However, other striking dermatologic manifestations are seen in nails and hair as well. hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, and thyroid cancer can have an array of cutaneous manifestations, and we present the recent updates in this field. METHODS: A PubMed search was performed for updates in any new skin disease findings and treatments between 2010 and 2022. Research published in the past decade and previously known foundational skin findings associated with thyroid disease were presented in this review. CONCLUSION: Cutaneous manifestations of thyroid disease is one of the first notable signs of thyroid hormone dysregulation. This article reviews the recent updates on the thyroid and skin interplay, and it further discusses overt visible findings and various available treatment modalities.
paragraphs.chinese: 引言：甲状腺激素被认为是皮肤稳态的关键调节激素之一。外周甲状腺激素（T4和T3）的释放会影响多个器官，并在细 胞层面进一步调节多种功能。特别是，皮肤被视为甲状腺激素发挥重要作用的靶器官。多种皮肤疾病与甲状腺激素失调 相关。此外，指甲和毛发也会出现显著的真皮表现。甲状腺功能减退、甲状腺功能亢进和甲状腺癌可引发一系列皮肤表 现，本文介绍了该领域的最新进展。方法：通过PubMed检索2010年至2022年间关于新发现的皮肤疾病及其治疗的最新 研究。本综述纳入了过去十年发表的研究以及既往已知的与甲状腺疾病相关的基础皮肤表现。结论：甲状腺疾病的皮肤 表现是甲状腺激素失调最早出现的显著体征之一。本文回顾了甲状腺与皮肤相互作用的最新进展，并进一步讨论了明显 的可见表现及多种现有治疗方式。

literature.title: Progress in Thyroid Cancer Genomics: A 40-Year Journey.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺癌基因组学进展：40年历程
literature.journal: Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association

paragraphs.english: Background: Very little was known about the molecular pathogenesis of thyroid cancer until the late 1980s. As part of the Centennial celebration of the American Thyroid Association, we review the historical discoveries that contributed to our current understanding of the genetic underpinnings of thyroid cancer. Summary: The pace of discovery was heavily dependent on scientific breakthroughs in nucleic acid sequencing technology, cancer biology, thyroid development, thyroid cell signaling, and growth regulation. Accordingly, we attempt to link the primary observations on thyroid cancer molecular genetics with the methodological and scientific advances that made them possible. Conclusions: The major genetic drivers of the common forms of thyroid cancer are now quite well established and contribute to a significant extent to how we diagnose and treat the disease. However, many challenges remain. Future work will need to unravel the complexity of thyroid cancer ecosystems, which is likely to be a major determinant of their biological behavior and on how they respond to therapy.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：直到20世纪80年代末，人们对甲状腺癌的分子发病机制仍知之甚少。作为美国甲状腺协会百年庆典的一部分，我 们回顾了那些有助于当前理解甲状腺癌遗传基础的历史性发现。摘要：这些发现的步伐在很大程度上依赖于核酸测序技 术、癌症生物学、甲状腺发育、甲状腺细胞信号传导和生长调控等领域的科学突破。因究此，我们试图将甲状腺癌分子遗 传学的主要发现与促成这些发现的方法学和科学进步联系起来。结论：目前，常见类型甲状腺癌的主要遗传驱动因素已 相当明确，并在很大程度上影响了我们对该疾病的诊断和治疗方式。然而，仍有许多挑战有待解决。未来的研究需要揭 示甲状腺癌生态系统的复杂性，这可能是决定其生物学行为及治疗反应的关键因素。

literature.title: Sirolimus for the treatment of Graves' orbitopathy.
literature.title_chinese: 西罗莫司治疗格雷夫斯眼病

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVES: A role of mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) in the pathogenesis of Graves' Orbitopathy (GO) has been proposed and rapamycin, better known as sirolimus, an mTOR inhibitor, was recently used in patients with GO. Here we review the available studies evaluating the role of mTOR in GO pathogenesis and the effects of sirolimus on GO. DESIGN: A comprehensive search of PubMed was conducted using the following keywords: "Graves' Orbitopathy", or "thyroid eye disease", or "Graves' ophthalmopathy", or "thyroidassociated ophthalmopathy"; and: "mTOR", or "sirolimus", or "rapamycin". INCLUSION CRITERIA: 1) original articles (preclinical and clinical studies); 2) English language. The articles that did not adequately explore the role of mTOR in GO pathogenesis and those in which the effects of sirolimus on GO were not investigated were excluded. At the end of the screening process, nine studies were included in this systematic review. RESULTS: mTOR signaling pathway was found to be upregulated in patients with GO. In addition, studies in a mouse model of GO, in orbital fibroblasts and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) derived from GO patients showed a significant reduction in inflammatory mediators, adipogenesis and fibrosis after treatment with sirolimus. In 2007 and 2019 two cases of patients with GO unresponsive to glucocorticoids and successfully treated with sirolimus were described. Consistently with these results, two retrospective investigations showed that treatment with sirolimus, used at low dosage for 12 weeks, was followed by a greater overall response of GO compared with methylprednisolone at 24 weeks. In addition, a good response in diplopia and ocular motility restriction after treatment with sirolimus was reported by two case series. All of these studies reported a good tolerability of sirolimus. Finally, GO response to treatment was shown to correlate with the serum levels of sirolimus at the end of treatment. CONCLUSIONS: Sirolimus may represent a cheap, effective, and safe alternative treatment for GO. In addition, serum levels of sirolimus may be used to predict the response to treatment. Randomized clinical trials are needed to confirm the efficacy of sirolimus on GO and establish the best possible treatment protocol.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：已有研究提出mTOR（哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白）在格雷夫斯眼病（GO）发病机制中的作用，而雷帕霉素（更常 称为西罗莫司）作为一种mTO梦R抑制剂，近期已被用于GO患者。本文回顾了评估mTOR在GO发病机制中作用及西罗莫 司对GO疗效的现有研究。设计：通过PubMed数据库进行综合检索，关键词包括："Graves' orbitopathy"、"thyroid eye disease" 云、 "Graves' ophthalmopathy" 、 "thyroid-associated ophthalmopathy"； 以 及"mTOR"、"sirolimus"、"rapamycin"。纳入标准：1）原创性文章（临床前及临床研究）；2）英文文献。排除未充 分探讨mTOR在GO发病机制中作用或未研究西罗莫司对GO疗效的文章。经筛选后，共纳入9项研究进行系统综述。结 果：研究发现GO患者中mTOR信号通路表达上调。此外，在GO小鼠模型及源自GO患者的眼眶成纤维细胞和外周血单核 细胞（PBMCs）研究中，西罗莫司治疗后炎症介质、脂肪生成及纤维化显著减少。2007年和2019年分别报道了两例对 糖皮质激素无应答的GO患者经西罗莫司成功治疗的案例。与这些结果一致，两项回顾性研究显示，低剂量西罗莫司治疗 12周后，GO总体应答率优于24周甲泼尼龙治疗。此外，两项病例系列报告了西罗莫司治疗后复视和眼球运动受限的良 好改善。所有研究均显示西罗莫司耐受性良好。最后，GO治疗应答与治疗结束时西罗莫司血清水平相关。结论：西罗莫 司可能成为GO经济、有效且安全的替代治疗方案。此外，西罗莫司血清水平可用于预测治疗应答。需通过随机临床试验 确认西罗莫司对GO的疗效并确定最佳治疗方案。

literature.title: Advances in artificial intelligence in thyroidassociated ophthalmopathy.
literature.title_chinese: 人工智能在甲状腺相关眼病中的进展。

paragraphs.english: Thyroidassociated ophthalmopathy (TAO), also referred to as Graves' ophthalmopathy, is a medical condition wherein ocular complications arise due to autoimmune thyroid illness. The diagnosis of TAO, reliant on imaging, typical ocular symptoms, and abnormalities in thyroid function or thyroidassociated antibodies, is generally graded and staged. In recent years, Artificial intelligence(AI), particularly deep learning(DL) technology, has gained widespread use in the diagnosis and treatment of ophthalmic diseases. This paper presents a discussion on specific studies involving AI, specifically DL, in the context of TAO, highlighting their applications in TAO diagnosis, staging, grading, and treatment decisions. Additionally, it addresses certain limitations in AI research on TAO and potential future directions for the field.
paragraphs.chinese: 甲状腺相关眼病（TAO），又称格雷夫斯眼病，是一种因自身免疫性甲状腺疾病导致眼部并发症的疾病。TAO的诊断依 赖于影像学检查、典型眼部症状以及甲状腺功能或甲状腺相关抗体异常，通常需要进行分级和分期。近年来，人工智能 （AI），特别是深度学习（DL）技术，在眼科疾病的诊断和治疗中得到了广泛应用。本文讨论了AI（尤其是DL）在TAO 中的具体研究，重点介绍了其在TAO诊断、分期、分级及治疗决策中的应用。此外，还探讨了AI在TAO研究中存在的某 些局限性以及该领域未来的潜在发展方向。 究

literature.title: Role of genetics and epigenetics in Graves' orbitopathy.
literature.title_chinese: 遗传学与表观遗传学在格雷夫斯眼病中的作用。

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVES: The pathogenesis of Graves' orbitopathy (GO) remains to be fully elucidated. Here, we reviewed the role of genetics and epigenetics. DESIGN: We conducted a PubMed search with the following keywords: GO, thyroid eye disease; or Graves' ophthalmopathy; or thyroidassociated ophthalmopathy; and: genetic, or epigenetic, or gene expression, or gene mutation, or gene variant, or gene polymorphism, or DNA methylation, or DNA acetylation. Articles in which whole DNA and/or RNA sequencing, proteome, and methylome analyses were performed were chosen. RESULTS: The different prevalence of GO in the two sexes, as well as racial differences, suggest that genetics play a role in GO pathogenesis. In addition, the longlasting phenotype of GO and patientderived orbital fibroblasts suggests a genetic or epigenetic mechanism. Although no genes have been found to confer a specific risk for GO, differential gene expression has been reported in orbital fibroblasts from GO patients vs control fibroblasts, suggesting that an epigenetic mechanism may be involved. In this regard, a different degree of DNA methylation, which affects gene expression, has been found between GO and control fibroblasts, which was confirmed by whole methylome analysis. histone acetylation and deacetylation, which also affect gene expression, remain to be investigated. CONCLUSIONS: Although no pathogenic gene variants have been reported, epigenetic mechanisms elicited by an initial autoimmune insult seem to be needed for differential gene expression to occur and, thus, for GO to develop and persist over time.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：格雷夫斯眼病（GO）的发病机制尚未完全阐明。本文综述了遗传学与表观遗传学在其中的作用。设计：我们在 PubMed中检索了以下关键词：GO、甲状腺眼病；或格雷夫斯眼病；或甲状腺相关眼病；以及：遗传、表观遗传、基因 表达、基因突变、基因变异、基因多态性、DNA甲基化、DNA乙酰化。筛选出进行全DNA和/或RNA测序、蛋白质组学 及甲基化组学分析的文章。结果：GO在性别及种族间的患病率差异提示遗传因素在其发病机制中发挥作用。此外，GO 的持续性表型及患者来源的眼眶成纤维细胞表明存在遗传或表观遗传机制。尽管尚未发现特异性增加GO风险的基因，但 GO患者与对照组眼眶成纤维细胞的差异基因表达已被报道，提示表观遗传机制可能参与其中。在此方面，GO与对照组 成纤维细胞中影响基因表达的DNA甲基化程度存在差异，这一发现已通过全甲基化组分析得到证实。同样影响基因表达 的组蛋白乙酰化与去乙酰化作用仍有待研究。结论：尽管尚未报道致病性基因变异，但初始自身免疫损伤引发的表观遗 传机制似乎是差异基因表达发生、进而导致GO发生并持续存在的必要条件。

literature.title: 2023 European Thyroid Association Clinical Practice Guidelines for thyroid nodule management.
literature.title_chinese: 2023年欧洲甲状腺协会甲状腺结节管理临床实践指南

paragraphs.english: With the widespread use of sensitive imaging techniques, which include neck visualization, a conspicuous number of thyroid nodules emerge and demand attention. Most lesions are benign, asymptomatic, and do not warrant treatment. In the case of cancer diagnosis, most are small, intrathyroidal and indolent neoplasms that can safely be managed conservatively. There is a pronounced need for more costeffective, riskadapted approaches to the management of this highly prevalent condition, taking the wishes of the patient into consideration. Thus, the present guidelines aim at providing a clinical practice guide for the initial workup and the subsequent management of adult individuals harboring thyroid nodules. Importantly, these guidelines are not intended to cover the management of thyroid malignancy. The manuscript and the specific recommendations were developed by reconciling the best available research evidence with the knowledge and clinical experience of the panelists and updating aspects of a number of previous European Thyroid Association guidelines.
paragraphs.chinese: 随着颈部可视化等敏感成像技术的广泛应用，大量甲状腺结节被发现并需要关注。大多数病变为良性、无症状且无需治 疗。在确诊为癌症的病例中，多数为微小、局限于甲状腺内的惰性肿瘤，可通过保守治疗安全处理。针对这种高发疾 病，亟需更具成本效益、风险适应性的管理方案，同时需考虑患者意愿。因此，本指南旨在为成人甲状腺结节的初始评 估及后续管理提供临床实践指导。需特别说明，本指南不涵盖甲状腺恶性肿瘤的管理。本文件及具体建议通过整合现有 最佳研究证据与专家组成员的临床经验及知识制定，并更新了欧洲甲状腺协会既往多项指南的相关内容。

literature.title: Thyroid nodules: Global, economic, and personal burdens.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺结节：全球、经济和个人负担。

paragraphs.english: Thyroid nodules have garnered attention due to changes in population surveillance systems and rising concerns about the associated financial burden on healthcare systems, payers, and patients. In this review, we find that prevalence rates vary widely based on method of detection and may particularly pronounced in asymptomatic patients undergoing routine screening. incidence rates may be particularly rising in lowerincome and middleincome countries and may be declining in higherincome countries. Despite high incidence rates, survival rates continue to be as high as 97% for papillary thyroid cancer. Over the last few decades, thyroid nodule workup and management has grown more sophisticated with the advent of fineneedle aspiration biopsy, specialized biomarkers, and molecular testing. However, gaps remain in risk stratification that can lead to substantial costs of care. Certain molecular tests, such as the Afirma Gene Sequencing Classifier can lead to a cost per diagnosis of $17,873 while achieving only mild decreases in diagnostic lobectomies for patients (11.6% to 9.7% in one study). Outofpocket costs associated with thyroid nodule management continue to drive significant financial toxicity for patients, especially for individuals with thyroid cancer. financial toxicity has been defined as a term that describes how direct and indirect medical costs of cancer care strain patients and households via decreased income, assets, and spending on basic necessities. Recent studies suggest that such toxicity can lead to adverse financial outcomes, such as foreclosure and bankruptcy. Additional costeffectiveness analyses are needed to improve existing thyroid nodule management systems and new clinical tools are needed to avoid unnecessary workup and management. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 甲状腺结节因人群监测系统的变化以及对其给医疗系统、支付方和患者带来的经济负担日益增加的担忧而受到关注。本 综述发现，基于检测方法的不同，患病率差异显著，尤其在接受常规筛查的无症状患者中更为突出。中低收入国家的发 病率可能呈上升趋势，而高收入国家则可能有所下降。尽管发病率较高，但甲状腺乳头状癌的生存率仍高达97%。过去 几十年间，随着细针穿刺活检、特异性生物标志物及分子检测的出现，甲状腺结节的评估与管理已日趋精细。然而，风 险分层仍存在不足，可能导致高昂的医疗成本。某些分子检测（如Afirma基因测序分类器）的单次诊断费用可达17,873 美元，而仅使患者诊断性甲状腺切除术的比例略有下降（一项研究中从11.6%降至9.7%）。与甲状腺结节管理相关的自 付费用持续给患者带来显著的经济毒性，尤其对甲状腺癌患者而言。经济毒性被定义为描述癌症诊疗的直接和间接医疗 成本如何通过收入减少、资产缩水及基本生活开支压缩而给患者及家庭造成压力的术语。近期研究表明，此类毒性可能 导致不良经济后果，云如房屋止赎和破产。未来需开展更多成本效益分析以完善现有甲状腺结节管理体系，并开发新型临 床工具以避免不必要的评估与管理。

literature.title: Artificial Intelligence in Thyroidology: A Narrative Review of the Current Applications, Associated Challenges, and Future Directions.
literature.title_chinese: 甲状腺学中的人工智能：当前应用、相关挑战及未来方向的叙述性综述
literature.journal: Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association

paragraphs.english: Background: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in health care has grown exponentially with the promise of facilitating biomedical research and enhancing diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, disease prevention, and health care delivery. We aim to examine the current state, limitations, and future directions of AI in thyroidology. Summary: AI has been explored in thyroidology since the 1990s, and currently, there is an increasing interest in applying AI to improve the care of patients with thyroid nodules (TNODs), thyroid cancer, and functional or autoimmune thyroid disease. These applications aim to automate processes, improve the accuracy and consistency of diagnosis, personalize treatment, decrease the burden for health care professionals, improve access to specialized care in areas lacking expertise, deepen the understanding of subtle pathophysiologic patterns, and accelerate the learning curve of less experienced clinicians. There are promising results for many of these applications. Yet, most are in the validation or early clinical evaluation stages. Only a few are currently adopted for risk stratification of TNODs by ultrasound and determination of the malignant nature of indeterminate TNODs by molecular testing. Challenges of the currently available AI applications include the lack of prospective and multicenter validations and utility studies, small and low diversity of training data sets, differences in 究data sources, lack of explainability, unclear clinical impact, inadequate stakeholder engagement, and inability to use outside of the research setting, which might limit the value of their future adoption. Conclusions: AI has the potential to improve many aspects of thyroidology; however, addressing the limitations affecting the suitability of AI interventions in thyroidology is a prerequisite to ensure that AI provides added value for patients with thyroid disease. 权
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：人工智能在医疗领域的应用呈指数级增长，有望促进生物医学研究，并提升诊断、治疗、监测、疾病预防及医疗 服务水平。本文旨在探讨人工智能在甲状腺学领域的应用现状、局限性及未来发展方向。摘要：自20世纪90年代起，人 工智能已开始应用于甲状腺学领域。当前山，利用人工智能改善甲状腺结节、甲状腺癌、功能性或自身免疫性甲状腺疾病 患者诊疗的研究兴趣日益浓厚。这些应用旨在实现流程自动化、提高诊断准确性与一致性、制定个性化治疗方案、减轻 医疗专业人员负担、改善缺乏专业知识的地区的专科医疗服务可及性、深化对细微病理生理模式的理解，并加速经验不 足临床医生的学习曲线。多项应用已展现出令人鼓舞的成果，但多数仍处于验证或早期临床评估阶段。目前仅有少数应 用被实际采纳，包括通过超声进行甲状腺结节风险分层，以及通过分子检测确定不确定性质甲状腺结节的恶性特征。现 有AI应用面临的挑战包括：缺乏前瞻性多中心验证及效用研究、训练数据集规模小且多样性不足、数据来源差异、可解 释性缺失、临床影响不明确、利益相关方参与不足，以及无法在科研环境外使用等问题，这些因素可能限制其未来应用 价值。结论：人工智能具有改善甲状腺学多领域实践的潜力，但解决影响AI干预措施在甲状腺学中适用性的局限性，是 确保AI为甲状腺疾病患者创造附加价值的先决条件。

literature.title: Endogenous hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia: case series and literature review.
literature.title_chinese: 内源性高胰岛素血症性低血糖：病例系列与文献综述。

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE: Endogenous hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia (EHH) is an uncommon disease characterized by inappropriately high plasma insulin levels despite low plasma glucose levels. Some rare etiologies can lead to EHH. Correct diagnosis is a prerequisite for treatment. Hence, although challenging, it is crucial for patients with EHH to identify the different causes. METHODS: We describe a case series of three patients, all of whom had obvious hypoglycemic symptoms and extraordinary hyperinsulinemia. Their plasma glucose, insulin, and Cpeptide levels were tested simultaneously when hypoglycemia occurred. Moreover, other biochemical indices and relevant antibody levels were measured and imaging examinations were conducted. RESULTS: According to their medical history, physical examination, laboratory results, and imaging findings, the three patients were diagnosed with insulinoma, type B insulin resistance syndrome, and insulin autoimmune syndrome. After precise treatments, hypoglycemia was ultimately eliminated. CONCLUSION: Although these diseases have similar symptoms and biochemical abnormalities, the treatment and prognosis are different. The case series presented here highlights the challenges in the differential diagnosis of EHH. An accurate diagnosis is necessary for hypoglycemia treatment.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：内源性高胰岛素血症性低血糖（EHH）是一种罕见疾病，其特征是尽管血糖水平较低，但血浆胰岛素水平却异常 升高。某些罕见病因可导致EHH。正确诊断是治疗的前提。因此，尽管具有挑战性，但明确EHH患者的不同病因至关重 要。方法：我们报告了三例病例系列，所有患者均有明显低血糖症状和异常高胰岛素血症。在低血糖发作时同步检测其 血糖、胰岛素和C肽水平。此外，还测量了其他生化指标和相关抗体水平，并进行了影像学检查。结果：根据病史、体格 检查、实验室结果和影像学发现，三名患者分别被诊断为胰岛素瘤、B型胰岛素抵抗综合征和胰岛素自身免疫综合征。经 过精准治疗后，低血糖最终消除。结论：尽管这些疾病具有相似的症状和生化异常，但治疗和预后不同。本病例系列强 调了EHH鉴别诊断的挑战性。准确诊断是低血糖治疗的必要条件。

literature.title: Glucagonoma and Glucagonoma Syndrome: An Updated Review.
literature.title_chinese: 胰高血糖素瘤与胰高血糖素瘤综合征：最新综述。

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: glucagonoma is a rare welldifferentiated slowly proliferating pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour, characterized by several manifestations including necrolytic migratory erythema, weight loss, diabetes and anaemia. AIM: The purpose of the current review was to acknowledge literature about this rare tumour discerning the clinical features, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis of glucagonoma by comparing three different periods. RESULTS: A study published by Song reviewed 216 cases from studies published between 1999 and 2016, making a comparison with 407 cases reported before 1998 by Soga and Yakuwa. The current review consisted of 86 cases reported in studies published in and after 2017: 40 males and 46 females, with an average age of 48.2 years. The maletofemale ratio was 0.87. The rate of typical clinical findings was as follows: NME, 93.2% (69/74); DM, 70.3% (50/74); weight loss, 62.2% (46/74); anaemia, 44.6% (33/74); glossitis or stomatitis or cheilitis, 31.1% (23/74). A total of 85 cases reported the location of the tumour as the pancreas and 38.8% of these cases involved the tail of the pancreas. The average tumour size was 4.6 cm in patients between 2017 and 2024. metastasis was detected in 52.3% of patients (45/86). The comparison with previous series highlighted an earlier age of diagnosis of glucagonoma and a higher rate of NME, consistent with a higher diagnostic accuracy. CONCLUSIONS: glucagonoma is a rare pathology, with peculiar characteristics that need to be acknowledged to achieve a timely diagnosis and finally improve patient prognosis.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：胰高血糖素瘤是一种罕见的、分化良好且缓慢增殖的胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤，其特征性表现包括坏死松解性游走性 红斑、体重减轻、糖尿病和贫血。目的：本综述旨在通过比较三个不同时期的相关文献，阐明这种罕见肿瘤的临床特 征、诊断、治疗及预后。结果：Song发表的一项研究回顾了1999年至2016年间发表的216例病例，并与Soga和Yakuwa 在1998年前报告的407例病例进行了比较。本综述纳入了2017年及之后发表的86例病例：其中男性40例，女性46例， 平均年龄48.2岁，男女比例为0.87。典型临床表现的发生率如下：坏死松解性游走性红斑93.2%（69/74）；糖尿病 70.3%（50/74）；体重减轻62.2%（46山/74）；贫血44.6%（33/74）；舌炎、口腔炎或唇炎31.1%（23/74）。共85例 病例报告肿瘤位于胰腺，其中38.8%的病例累及胰尾部。2017年至2024年间患者的平均肿瘤大小为4.6厘米。52.3%的患 者（45/86）发现转移。与既往系列研究相比，本综述显示胰高血糖素瘤的诊断年龄更早，坏死松解性游走性红斑的发生 率更高，这与更高的诊断准确性一致。结论：胰高血糖素瘤是一种罕见疾病，需认识其独特特征以实现及时诊断，最终 改善患者预后。 云

literature.title: Practical therapeutic approach in the management of diabetes mellitus secondary to Cushing's syndrome, acromegaly and neuroendocrine tumours.
literature.title_chinese: 库欣综合征、肢端肥大症及神经内分泌肿瘤继发糖尿病的实用治疗策略

paragraphs.english: Cushing's syndrome, acromegaly and neuroendocrine disorders are characterized by an excess of counterregulatory hormones, able to induce insulin resistance and glucose metabolism disorders at variable degrees and requiring immediate treatment, until patients are ready to undergo surgery. This review focuses on the management of diabetes mellitus in endocrine disorders related to an excess of counterregulatory hormones. Currently, the landscape of approved agents for treatment of diabetes is dynamic and is mainly patientcentred and not glycaemiacentred. In addition, personalized medicine is more and more required to provide a precise approach to the patient's disease. For this reason, we aimed to define a practical therapeutic algorithm for management of diabetes mellitus in patients with glucagonoma, pheochromocytoma, Cushing's syndrome and acromegaly, based on our practical experience and on the physiopathology of the specific endocrine disease taken into account. This document is addressed to all specialists who approach patients with diabetes mellitus secondary to endocrine disorders characterized by an excess of counterregulatory hormones, in order to take better care of these patients. Care and control of diabetes mellitus should be one of the primary goals in patients with an excess of counterregulatory hormones requiring immediate and aggressive treatment.
paragraphs.chinese: 库欣综合征、肢端肥大症及神经内分泌疾病的特征为反调节激素过权量，这些激素可在不同程度上诱发胰岛素抵抗和糖代 谢紊乱，需在患者接受手术前进行紧急治疗。本综述聚焦于与反调节激素过量相关的内分泌疾病中糖尿病的治疗管理。 当前获批的糖尿病治疗药物格局动态变化，主要遵循以侵患者为中心而非以血糖为中心的原则。此外，精准医疗日益要求 针对患者疾病提供个体化方案。基于此，我们结合临床实践经验及特定内分泌疾病的病理生理机制，旨在为胰高血糖素 瘤、嗜铬细胞瘤、库欣综合征及肢端肥大症患者的糖尿病管理制定实用治疗路径。本文面向所有接诊继发于反调节激素 过量内分泌疾病所致糖尿病患者的专科医师，以期优化此类患者的诊疗。对于需要紧急强化治疗的反调节激素过量患 者，糖尿病的管控应作为首要目标之一。

literature.title: Nuclear medicine and perspective thoughts in the diagnosis and treatment of pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma.
literature.title_chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤诊断与治疗中的核医学及前瞻性思考。

paragraphs.english: pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma (PPGL) are rare and lifethreatening tumors of the adrenal medulla and extra- adrenal paraganglia, respectively. Management of PPGL depends on accurate diagnosis and treatment. This review provides a very comprehensive overview of nuclear medicine in PPGL with some of our perspective views on diagnostic challenges and pitfalls, treatment, and new phase studies. It describes nuclear medicine techniques including (64)Cu/(68)GaDOTASSA, (18)FFDOPA, (18)FFDG, (123)IMIBG, and some emerging molecular imaging agents and PRRT therapies, such as (203)Pb VMTalphaNET and (212)Pb VMTalphaNET targeted alpha therapy (TAT). It also provides insight into the use of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) inhibitors in combination with therapeutics in aggressive/metastatic PPGL. Through a comprehensive review of the latest developments and clinical practice, this review aims to guide healthcare professionals in improving the diagnostic accuracy and therapeutic efficacy of PPGL.
paragraphs.chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤（PPGL）分别是发生于肾上腺髓质和肾上腺外副神经节的罕见且危及生命的肿瘤。PPGL的诊 疗依赖于精准诊断与规范治疗。本综述全面阐述了核医学在PPGL中的应用，并结合我们的观点探讨了诊断挑战与陷阱、 治疗策略及新药临床研究。文中系统介绍了包括(64)Cu/(68)Ga-DOTA-SSA、(18)F-FDOPA、(18)F-FDG、(123)I- MIBG等核医学技术，以及(203)Pb VMT-alpha-NET和(212)Pb VMT-alpha-NET靶向α疗法（TAT）等新兴分子影像剂 与PRRT疗法。同时深入探讨了增殖细胞核抗原（PCNA）抑制剂联合治疗在侵袭性/转移性PPGL中的应用价值。通过系 统梳理最新研究进展与临床实践，本综述旨在指导医疗专业人员提升PPGL的诊断准确性与治疗效能。

literature.title: A review of the safety of sodiumglucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors.
literature.title_chinese: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2抑制剂的安全性综述。

paragraphs.english: The development of sodiumglucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors represents a major turning point in the effort to preserve kidney function and prevent cardiovascular events and heart failure hospitalisations in those at high risk. These agents have now transcended their original glucoselowering indication and provide a range of clinical benefits in people both with and without diabetes, and at varying levels of kidney function. Despite this, SGLT2 inhibitors remain underutilized by the medical community. One potential barrier to improved uptake may be concern about adverse effects. The following review summarizes the wealth of information garnered from clinical trials and realworld data in recent years to examine the safety of SGLT2 inhibitors and to provide practical advice to promote safer use of these important therapies.
paragraphs.chinese: 钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂的发展，标志着在保护高危人群肾功能、预防心血管事件及心力衰竭住院方 面的重要转折点。这类药物已超越其最初的降糖适应症，为伴或不伴糖尿病、不同肾功能水平的患者提供了广泛的临床 获益。尽管如此，SGLT2抑制剂在医学界的应用仍不充分。阻碍其推广的潜在因素之一可能是对不良反应的担忧。本综 述总结了近年来从临床试验和真实世界数据中获取的丰富信息，旨在评估SGLT2抑制剂的安全性，并提供实用建议以促 进这些重要疗法的安全应用。 究

literature.title: Treatment recommendations for glycogen storage disease type IB- associated neutropenia and neutrophil dysfunction with empagliflozin: Consensus from an international workshop.
literature.title_chinese: 恩格列净治疗糖原贮积症IB型相关中性粒细胞减少症和中性粒细胞功能障碍的建议：国际研讨会共识。

paragraphs.english: glycogen storage disease type Ib (GSD Ib, biallelic variants in SLC37A4) is a rare disorder of glycogen metabolism complicated by neutropenia/neutrophil dysfunction. Since 2019, the SGLT2-inhibitor empagliflozin has provided a mechanismbased treatment option for the symptoms caused by neutropenia/neutrophil dysfunction (e.g. mucosal lesions, inflammatory bowel disease). Because of the rarity of GSD Ib, the published evidence on safety and efficacy of empagliflozin is still limited and does not allow to develop evidencebased guidelines. Here, an international group of experts provides 14 best practice consensus treatment recommendations based on expert practice and review of the published evidence. We recommend to start empagliflozin in all GSD Ib individuals with clinical or laboratory signs related to neutropenia/neutrophil dysfunction with a dose of 0.3-0.4 mg/kg/d given as a single dose in the morning. Treatment can be started in an outpatient setting. The dose should be adapted to the weight and in case of inadequate clinical treatment response or side effects. We strongly recommend to pause empagliflozin immediately in case of threatening dehydration and before planned longer surgeries. Discontinuation of GCSF therapy should be attempted 究in all individuals. If available, 1,5- AG should be monitored. Individuals who have previously not tolerated starches should be encouraged to make a new attempt to introduce starch in their diet after initiation of empagliflozin treatment. We advise to monitor certain safety and efficacy parameters and recommend continuous, alternatively frequent glucose measurements during the introduction of empagliflozin. We provide specific recommendations for special circumstances like pregnancy and liver transplantation.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖原贮积症Ib型（GSD Ib，由SLC37A4基因双等位基因变异引起）是一种罕见的糖原代谢疾病，常伴有中性粒细胞减少/ 功能障碍。自2019年起，SGLT2抑制剂恩格列净为中性粒细胞减少/功能障碍引起的症状（如黏膜病变、炎症性肠病）提 供了基于病理机制的治疗选择。由于GSD Ib的罕见性，关于恩格列净安全性和有效性的已发表证据仍然有限，尚不足以 制定循证指南。为此，一个国际专家组基于临床实践经验和已发表证据的回顾，提出了14项最佳实践共识治疗建议。我 们建议对所有出现中性粒细胞减少/功能障碍相关临床或实验室指征的GSD Ib患者启用恩格列净，初始剂量为0.3-0.4 mg/kg/d，早晨单次给药。治疗可在门诊启动。剂量应根据体重调整，若临床疗效不足或出现副作用时需调整剂量。我 们强烈建议在面临脱水风险时及计划进行长时间手术前立即暂停恩格列净。所有患者均应尝试停用G-CSF治疗。如条件 允许，应监测1,5-脱水葡萄糖醇水平。对于既往无法耐受淀粉类食物的患者，建议在启动恩格列净治疗后重新尝试在饮食 中引入淀粉。我们建议在启用恩格列净期间监测特定安全性和有效性参数，并推荐持续或频繁进行血糖监测。针对妊娠 和肝移植等特殊情况，我们提供了具体建议。

literature.title: Rewriting Diabetes Therapy: How Incretin Modulation is Transforming Cardiovascular and Renal Outcomes.
literature.title_chinese: 改写糖尿病治疗：肠促胰岛素调节如何改变心血管和肾脏结局
literature.journal: Diabetes therapy : research, treatment and education of diabetes and related disorders

paragraphs.english: INTRODUCTION: In patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), cardiovascular (CV) disease and chronic kidney disease (CKD) drive excess morbidity and mortality. Beyond glucoselowering, incretinbased therapies may provide organ protection across the cardiorenal axis. METHODS: Narrative review of mechanistic pathways and randomized trials of GLP- 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA), DPP-4 inhibitors, and newer dual/triple agonists, with targeted updates from recent pivotal programs (SELECT, FLOW, SOUL, SURPASSCVOT) and emerging oral smallmolecule GLP-1R agonists. RESULTS: Longacting GLP-1RA reduces major adverse CV events (MACE), allcause and CV death, heartfailure hospitalization, and kidney composites across CV outcome trials and metaanalyses. A 2019 pooled analysis and a 2025 update confirm consistent reductions in MACE and hard kidney outcomes independent of baseline HbA1c. In obesity without diabetes, semaglutide 2.4 mg lowered MACE in SELECT, expanding prevention beyond glycemia. In CKD with T2DM, FLOW showed that semaglutide reduced major kidney disease events and death from CV/kidney causes. In T2DM with ASCVD and/or CKD, the SOUL cardiovascular outcome trial (CVOT) demonstrated that oral semaglutide reduced threepoint MACE versus placebo. In headtohead CVOT, tirzepatide was noninferior to dulaglutide on MACE while achieving greater weight and HbA1c reductions. Mechanistically, GLP-1R signaling spans GscAMP/PKA, betaarrestindependent pathways, and additional routes (including Gq contexts), aligning with antiinflammatory, 必natriuretic, and antifibrotic effects observed preclinically and clinically. Oral nonpeptide GLP-1R agonists (e.g., orforglipron) show phase 2 efficacy but lack longterm CV/renal outcome data. CONCLUSIONS: incretinbased therapy has shifted care from glucosecentric targets to cardiorenal risk reduction. GLP-1RA are guidelineendorsed for patients with T2DM and high CV/renal risk irrespective of HbA1c; dual agonists and oral smallmolecule agents may broaden indications pending definitive outcome evidence.
paragraphs.chinese: 引言：在2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者中，心血管疾病和慢性肾脏病是导致超额发病率和死亡率的主要原因。除降糖作用 外，基于肠促胰素的疗法可能通过心肾轴提供器官保护。方法：对GLP-1受体激动剂、DPP-4抑制剂及新型双/三重激动 剂的机制通路和随机试验进行叙述性综述，并针对近期关键研究项目（SELECT、FLOW、SOUL、SURPASS-CVOT）及 新兴口服小分子GLP-1R激动剂进行靶向更新。结果：在心血管结局试验和荟萃分析中，长效GLP-1RA可降低主要不良心 血管事件、全因及心血管死亡、心力衰竭住院和肾脏复合终点。2019年汇总分析及2025年更新证实，无论基线HbA1c 水平如何，MACE和硬性肾脏结局均持续降低。在无糖尿病的肥胖患者中，司美格鲁肽2.4mg在SELECT试验中降低 MACE，将预防范围扩展至血糖控制之外。在合并T2DM的CKD患者中，FLOW试验显示司美格鲁肽可减少主要肾脏疾病 事件及心血管/肾脏原因死亡。在合并ASCVD和/或CKD的T2DM患者中，SOUL心血管结局试验证实口服司美格鲁肽较安 慰剂降低三点MACE。头对头CVOT显示，替尔泊肽在MACE方面非劣效于度拉糖肽，同时实现更显著的体重和HbA1c降 低。机制上，GLP-1R信号涵盖Gs-cAMP/PKA、β-arrestin依赖性通路及其他途径（包括Gq背景），与临床前和临床观 察到的抗炎、利钠和抗纤维化效应一致。口服非肽类GLP-1R激动剂（如orforglipron）显示2期疗效，但缺乏长期心血 管/肾脏结局数据。结论：基于肠促胰素的疗法已将治疗重点从以血糖为中心转向降低心肾风险。GLP-1RA被指南推荐用 于合并高心血管/肾脏风险的T2DM患者，无论HbA1c水平如何；双激动剂和口服小分子药物可能扩大适应症，但需确证 性结局证据。

literature.title: Semaglutide and obesity: beyond the nutritional and lifestyle intervention?
literature.title_chinese: 司美格鲁肽与肥胖：超越营养与生活方式干预？

paragraphs.english: Semaglutide is the second marketed glucagonlike peptide 1 receptor agonist that can be used safely and efficiently in non- diabetic people with excess weight, providing a new milestone in the pharmacological treatment of obesity. This narrative review aims to describe the clinical actions of this new drug in weight management in nondiabetic patients along with possible sideeffects and dropout reasons. To accomplish this, the PubMed database was searched to retrieve the most relevant clinical studies published to date on this topic, using the following keywords "semaglutide and obesity". Currently, semaglutide is on the market in two formulations, the onceweekly subcutaneous (s.c.) semaglutide and oncedaily oral semaglutide. Data in the literature on the antiobesity action of semaglutide are available for both routes of administration of the drug, with a prevalence of studies using the s.c. one. However, given its dosage, oral semaglutide may provide greater attractiveness and better treatment adherence, but further research is needed in this field.
paragraphs.chinese: 司美格鲁肽是第二种上市的胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂，可安全有效地用于非糖尿病超重人群，为肥胖症的药物治疗 树立了新里程碑。本叙述性综述旨在阐述该新药在非糖尿病患者体重管理中的临床作用，以及可能的副作用和停药原 因。为此，我们检索了PubMed数据库中迄今发表的相关临床研究，使用关键词"semaglutide and obesity"。目前，司 美格鲁肽有两种剂型上市：每周一次皮下注射剂和每日一次口服剂。文献中关于司美格鲁肽抗肥胖作用的数据涵盖两种 给药途径，其中以皮下注射剂研究为主。然而，考虑到剂量因素，口服司美格鲁肽可能具有更高的吸引力和更好的治疗 依从性，但该领域仍需进一步研究。

literature.title: Strategies for minimizing muscle loss during use of incretinmimetic drugs for treatment of obesity.
literature.title_chinese: 使用肠促胰岛素类似物治疗肥胖期间减少肌肉流失的策略
literature.journal: Obesity reviews : an official journal of the International Association for the Study of Obesity

paragraphs.english: The rapid and widespread clinical adoption of highly effective incretinmimetic drugs (IMDs), particularly semaglutide and tirzepatide, for the treatment of obesity has outpaced the updating of clinical practice guidelines. Consequently, many patients may be at risk for adverse effects and uncertain longterm outcomes related to the use of these drugs. Of emerging concern is the loss of skeletal muscle mass and function that can accompany rapid substantial weight reduction; such losses can lead to reduced functional and metabolic health, weight cycling, compromised quality of life, and other adverse outcomes. Available evidence suggests that clinical trial participants receiving IMDs for the treatment of obesity lost 10% or more of their muscle mass during the 68- to 72-week interventions, approximately equivalent to 20 years of agerelated muscle loss. The ability to maintain muscle mass during caloric restrictioninduced weight reduction is influenced by two key factors: nutrition and physical exercise. nutrition therapy should ensure adequate intake and absorption of highquality protein and micronutrients, which may require the use of oral nutritional supplements. Additionally, concurrent physical activity, especially resistance training, has been shown to effectively minimize loss of muscle mass and function during weight reduction therapy. All patients receiving IMDs for obesity should participate in 究comprehensive treatment programs emphasizing adequate protein and micronutrient intakes, as well as resistance training, to preserve muscle mass and function, maximize the benefit of IMD therapy, and minimize potential risks. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 高效模拟肠促胰岛素药物（IMDs），特别是司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽，在肥胖治疗中的快速广泛临床应用已超越了临床实 践指南的更新速度。因此，许多患者可能面临药物相关侵不良反应及不确定长期结局的风险。新近引发关注的是，快速大 幅减重可能伴随骨骼肌质量与功能的丧失，这种流失会导致功能代谢健康下降、体重循环、生活质量受损及其他不良后 果。现有证据表明，接受IMDs治疗肥胖的临床试验参与者在68至72周的干预期间，肌肉质量减少了10%以上，约相当 于20年年龄相关的肌肉流失量。在热量限制诱导的减重过程中维持肌肉质量的能力受两大关键因素影响：营养与体育锻 炼。营养治疗应确保优质蛋白质和微量营养素的充分摄入与吸收，必要时需使用口服营养补充剂。此外，同步进行体育 锻炼（尤其是抗阻训练）已被证实能有效减少减重治疗期间的肌肉质量与功能流失。所有接受IMDs治疗肥胖的患者都应 参与综合治疗方案，强调充足蛋白质和微量营养素摄入及抗阻训练，以保护肌肉质量与功能，最大化IMDs治疗获益，并 最小化潜在风险。 云

literature.title: IncretinBased Weight Loss Pharmacotherapy: Can Resistance Exercise Optimize Changes in Body Composition?
literature.title_chinese: 基于肠促胰素的减重药物治疗：抗阻运动能否优化身体成分变化？

paragraphs.english: This narrative review highlights the degree to which new antiobesity medications based on gutderived nutrientstimulated hormones (incretins) cause loss of lean mass, and the importance of resistance exercise to preserve muscle. Glucagonlike peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) induce substantial weight loss in randomized trials, effects that may be enhanced in combination with glucosedependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor agonists. Liraglutide and semaglutide (GLP- 1RA), tirzepatide (GLP-1 and GIP receptor dual agonist), and retatrutide (GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptor triple agonist) are peptides with incretin agonist activity that induce approximately 15-24% weight loss in adults with overweight and obesity, alongside beneficial impacts on blood pressure, cholesterol, blood glucose, and insulin. However, these agents also cause rapid and significant loss of lean mass ( approximately 10% or approximately 6 kg), comparable to a decade or more of aging. Maintaining muscle mass and function as humans age is crucial to avoiding sarcopenia and frailty, which are strongly linked to morbidity and mortality. Studies indicate that supervised resistance exercise training interventions with a duration >10 weeks can elicit large increases in lean mass ( approximately 3 kg) and strength ( approximately 25%) in men and women. After a lowcalorie diet, combining aerobic exercise with liraglutide improved weight loss maintenance compared with either alone. Retaining lean mass during incretin therapy could blunt body weight (and fat) regain on cessation of weight loss pharmacotherapy. We propose that tailored resistance exercise training be recommended as an adjunct to incretin therapy to optimize changes in body composition by preserving lean mass while achieving fat loss.
paragraphs.chinese: 本综述强调，基于肠道源性营养刺激激素（肠促胰岛素侵）的新型抗肥胖药物在多大程度上导致瘦体重流失，以及抗阻运 动对维持肌肉的重要性。随机试验表明，胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）可诱导显著体重下降，与葡萄糖依 赖性促胰岛素多肽（GIP）受体激动剂联用时效果可能增强。利拉鲁肽和司美格鲁肽（GLP-1RA）、替尔泊肽（GLP-1与 GIP受体双重激动剂）以及瑞他鲁肽（GL山P-1、GIP与胰高血糖素受体三重激动剂）均具有肠促胰岛素激动活性，可使超 重和肥胖成人减重约15-24%，同时对血压、胆固醇、血糖和胰岛素产生有益影响。然而，这些药物也会导致瘦体重快速 显著流失（约10%或约6公斤）梦，相当于十年以上的衰老过程。随着年龄增长，维持肌肉质量和功能对避免肌少症和衰弱 至关重要，而这两者与发病率和死亡率密切相关。研究表明，持续超过10周的有监督抗阻运动训练干预可使男性和女性 的瘦体重增加约3公斤，力量提升约25%。在低热量饮食后，将有氧运动与利拉鲁肽联合使用比单独使用任一方法更能改 善体重维持效果。在肠促胰岛素治疗期间保留瘦体重，可减缓停药后体重（及脂肪）的反弹。我们建议将定制化抗阻运 动训练作为肠促胰岛素治疗的辅助手段，通过保留瘦体重同时实现减脂，优化身体成分变化。

literature.topic: 胰岛素周制剂 (once weekly insulin)
literature.title: Emerging perspectives on onceweekly insulins in type 1 and type 2 diabetes: a minireview.
literature.title_chinese: 关于每周一次胰岛素在1型和2型糖尿病中的新兴观点：小型综述。

paragraphs.english: The development of onceweekly basal insulin analogues, such as insulin icodec and efsitora alfa, represents a promising strategy to reduce injection burden and improve adherence in diabetes management. This minireview summarizes the recent findings from clinical trials evaluating onceweekly insulin therapies in both type 1 and type 2 diabetes. In type 1 diabetes, available data remain limited; however, the ONWARDS 6 and QWINT-5 trials demonstrated that onceweekly icodec and efsitora, respectively, achieved comparable reductions in HbA1c to oncedaily insulin degludec, when used in combination with prandial insulin. In type 2 diabetes, accumulating evidences from randomized clinical trials supports the efficacy of onceweekly icodec and efsitora, showing noninferiorityand in some cases, superioritycompared to oncedaily basal insulin, both in insulinnaive individuals and in those previously treated with insulin. safety profiles of onceweekly insulins in type 2 diabetes are reassuring, with similar rates of clinically significant and severe hypoglycemia compared to oncedaily regimens. In contrast, trials in type 1 diabetes reported higher hypoglycemia rates with onceweekly insulins. Recent findings from the COMBINE program demonstrated that the fixedratio combination of icodec and semaglutide (IcoSema) produced superior HbA1c reductions compared to either agent alone, though not superior to a basalbolus regimen with glargine and aspart insulin. However, several important questions remain to be addressed regarding onceweekly insulins, including their longterm efficacy on cardiovascular outcomes and overall longterm safety.
paragraphs.chinese: 每周一次的基础胰岛素类似物（如胰岛素icodec和efsitora alfa）的开发，是减轻注射负担、提高糖尿病治疗依从性的重 要策略。本综述总结了近期评估每周一次胰岛素疗法在1侵型和2型糖尿病中应用的临床试验结果。在1型糖尿病中，现有数 据仍有限；但ONWARDS 6和QWINT-5试验表明，联合餐时胰岛素使用时，每周一次的icodec和efsitora分别实现了与 每日一次德谷胰岛素相当的HbA1c降幅。在2型糖尿病中，随机临床试验积累的证据支持每周一次icodec和efsitora的疗 效，显示其在未使用过胰岛素及既往接受胰岛素治疗的患者中，疗效非劣效于每日一次基础胰岛素，部分情况下甚至更 优。每周一次胰岛素在2型糖尿病中的安全性令人放心，临床显著和严重低血糖发生率与每日一次方案相似。相比之下， 1型糖尿病试验报告每周一次胰岛素组低血糖发生率更高。COMBINE项目最新结果显示，icodec与司美格鲁肽的固定比 例复方制剂（IcoSema）在降低HbA1c方面优于单药治疗，但未优于甘精胰岛素联合门冬胰岛素的基础餐时方案。然 而，关于每周一次胰岛素仍存在若干重要问题待解答，包括其对心血管结局的长期疗效及整体长期安全性。

literature.title: Onceweekly Insulin Icodec Versus Oncedaily Longacting Insulin for Type II Diabetes: A Metaanalysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
literature.title_chinese: 每周一次胰岛素Icodec对比每日一次长效胰岛素治疗2型糖尿病：随机对照试验的荟萃分析。

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: insulin icodec is a novel basal insulin analog with onceweekly subcutaneous administration. We aim to estimate the efficacy and safety of insulin icodec vs longacting insulin (insulin glargine and degludec) in type II diabetic patients. METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and metaanalysis synthesizing randomized controlled trials (RCTs), which were retrieved by systematically searching PubMed, Web of Science, SCOPUS, and Cochrane through May 29, 2023. We used RevMan V. 5.4 to pool dichotomous data using risk ratio (RR) and continuous data using mean difference (MD) with a 95% confidence interval (CI). Our primary outcome was glycated hemoglobin (HbA1C) change. RESULTS: We included 7 RCTs with a total of 3183 patients. insulin icodec was associated with significantly decreased HbA1C (MD: -0.15 with 95% CI [-0.24, -0.06], P = .002) and increased percentage of time with glucose in range (TIR) (MD: 4.06 with 95% CI [2.06, 6.06], P = .0001). However, insulin icodec was associated with increased body weight (MD: 0.57 with 95% CI [0.45, 0.70], P = .00001). Also, there was no difference regarding any serious adverse events (AEs) (RR: 0.96 with 95% CI [0.76, 1.20], P = .7) or AEs leading to withdrawal (RR: 1.54 with 95% CI [0.84, 2.82], P = .16). However, insulin icodec was associated with increased any AEs incidence (RR: 1.06 with 95% CI [1.01, 1.12], 究P = .02). CONCLUSION: insulin icodec was associated with decreased HbA1C, increased TIR, with similar hypoglycemic and serious AEs. However, it was also associated with increased body weight and the incidence of any AEs. 必
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：胰岛素icodec是一种新型基础胰岛素类似物，每周皮下注射一次。本研究旨在评估胰岛素icodec与长效胰岛素 （甘精胰岛素和德谷胰岛素）在2型糖尿病患者中的疗效侵和安全性。方法：我们进行了一项系统综述和荟萃分析，综合了 截至2023年5月29日通过系统检索PubMed、Web of Science、SCOPUS和Cochrane数据库获得的随机对照试验 （RCT）。使用RevMan V.5.4软件，以风险比（RR-）合并二分类数据，以均值差（MD）合并连续数据，并计算95%置 信区间（CI）。主要结局指标为糖化血红蛋白（HbA1C）变化。结果：共纳入7项RCT，总计3183例患者。胰岛素 icodec与HbA1C显著降低相关（MD：-0.15，95% CI [-0.24, -0.06]，P = .002），且血糖在目标范围内时间（TIR）百 分比增加（MD：4.06，95% 梦CI [2.06, 6.06]，P = .0001）。然而，胰岛素icodec与体重增加相关（MD：0.57，95% CI [0.45, 0.70]，P = .00001）。此外，两组在严重不良事件（RR：0.96，95% CI [0.76, 1.20]，P = .7）或导致退出研 究的不良事件（RR：云1.54，95% CI [0.84, 2.82]，P = .16）方面无显著差异。但胰岛素icodec与任何不良事件发生率增 加相关（RR：1.06，95% CI [1.01, 1.12]，P = .02）。结论：胰岛素icodec可降低HbA1C、增加TIR，且低血糖和严重 不良事件风险与对照组相似，但同时也与体重增加及任何不良事件发生率升高相关。

literature.title: Advances in Cell Replacement Therapies for Diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病细胞替代疗法的最新进展

paragraphs.english: islet cell replacement therapies have evolved as a viable treatment option for type 1 diabetes complicated by problematic hypoglycemia and glycemic lability. Refinements of islet manufacturing, islet transplantation procedures, peritransplant recipient management, and immunosuppressive protocols allowed most recipients to achieve favorable outcomes. Subsequent phase 3 trials of transplantation of deceased donor islets documented the effectiveness of transplanted islets in restoring near- normoglycemia, glycemic stability, and protection from severe hypoglycemia, with an acceptable safety profile for the enrolled highrisk population. Health authorities in several countries have approved deceased donor islet transplantation for treating patients with type 1 diabetes and recurrent severe hypoglycemia. These achievements amplified academic and industry efforts to generate pluripotent stem cellderived betacells through directed differentiation for betacell replacement. Preliminary results of ongoing clinical trials suggest that the transplantation of stem cellderived betacells can consistently restore insulin independence in immunosuppressed recipients with type 1 diabetes, thus signaling the profound progress made in generating an unlimited and a uniform supply of cells for transplant. Avoiding the risks of chronic immunosuppression represents the next frontier. Several strategies have entered or are approaching clinical investigation, including immuneisolating islets, engineering immuneprivileged islet implantation sites, rendering islets immune evasive, and inducing immune tolerance in transplanted islets. Capitalizing on highdimensional, multiomic technologies for deep profiling of graftdirected immunity and the fate of the graft will provide new insights that promise to translate into sustaining functional graft survival longterm. Leveraging these parallel progression paths will facilitate the wider clinical adoption of cell replacement therapies in diabetes care. ARTICLE HIGHLIGHTS: transplantation of deceased donorderived primary human islets has restored nearnormoglycemia and protection from severe hypoglycemia in immunosuppressed recipients with type 1 diabetes. transplantation of embryonic stem cellderived betacells has restored insulin independence in immunosuppressed recipients with type 1 diabetes. Clinical trials are underway and planned to evaluate the safety and efficacy of transplantation of mature stem cellderived betacells with transient, local, minimal, and/or nomaintenance immunosuppression in recipients with type 1 diabetes. The highdimensional, multiomic monitoring of immunity to transplanted islets and of the fate of the islet graft will faciliate the identification of determinants of sustained islet graft function and of patients most likely to benefit from cell replacement therapies.
paragraphs.chinese: 胰岛细胞替代疗法已成为治疗伴有问题性低血糖和血糖不稳定的1型糖尿病的可行选择。胰岛制备、胰岛移植流程、围移 植期受者管理及免疫抑制方案的改进，使大多数受者获得了良好预后。后续的死亡供体胰岛移植三期临床试验证实，移 植胰岛能有效恢复接近正常的血糖水平、稳定血糖并预防严重低血糖，且对纳入的高风险人群具有可接受的安全性。多 个国家的卫生机构已批准使用死亡供体胰岛移植治疗伴有复发性严重低血糖的1型糖尿病患者。这些成就推动了学术界和 工业界通过定向分化生成多能干细胞来源的β细胞以替代β细胞的努力。正在进行的临床试验初步结果表明，移植干细胞 来源的β细胞可稳定恢复免疫抑制的1型糖尿病受者的胰岛素独立性，这标志着在生成无限且均一的移植细胞供应方面取 得了重大进展。避免慢性免疫抑制的风险是下一个前沿领域。多项策略已进入或即将进入临床研究阶段，包括免疫隔离 胰岛、构建免疫豁免的胰岛植入位点、使胰岛具备免疫逃逸能力，以及诱导移植胰岛的免疫耐受。利用高维度多组学技 术深度分析针对移植物的免疫反应及移植物命运，将提供新的见解，有望转化为长期维持功能性移植物存活的策略。利 用这些并行的发展路径，将推动细胞替代疗法在糖尿病治疗中的更广泛应用。文章亮点： - 移植死亡供体来源的原代人 胰岛，可使免疫抑制的1型糖尿病受者恢复接近正常的血糖水平并预防严重低血糖。- 移植胚胎干细胞来源的β细胞，可 使免疫抑制的1型糖尿病受者恢复胰岛素独立性。- 正在进行的及计划中的临床试验，旨在评估在1型糖尿病受者中移植 成熟干细胞来源的β细胞，并采用短暂、局部、最小化或无需维持免疫抑制方案的安全性和有效性。- 对移植胰岛的免疫 反应及胰岛移植物命运的高维度多组学监测，将有助于识别维持胰岛移植物功能的决定因素，以及最可能从细胞替代疗 法中获益的患者群体。

literature.title: Clinical Presentation and Diagnostic Approach to Hypoglycemia in Adults Without Diabetes Mellitus.
literature.title_chinese: 非糖尿病成人低血糖的临床表现与诊断方法

paragraphs.english: OBJECTIVE: To review the clinical presentation, causes, and diagnostic approach to spontaneous hypoglycemia in adults without diabetes mellitus. METHODS: A literature review was performed using the PubMed and Google Scholar databases. RESULTS: hypoglycemia is uncommon in people who are not on glucoselowering medications. Under normal physiologic conditions, multiple neural and hormonal counterregulatory mechanisms prevent the development of abnormally low levels of plasma glucose. If spontaneous hypoglycemia is suspected, the Whipple triad should be used to confirm hypoglycemia before pursuing further diagnostic workup. The Whipple criteria include the following: (1) low levels of plasma glucose, (2) signs or symptoms that would be expected with low levels of plasma glucose, and (3) improvement in those signs or symptoms when the level of plasma glucose increases. Spontaneous hypoglycemia can be caused by conditions that cause endogenous hyperinsulinism, including insulinoma, postbariatric hypoglycemia, and noninsulinoma pancreatogenous hypoglycemia. Spontaneous hypoglycemia can also be seen with critical illness, hepatic or renal dysfunction, hormonal deficiency, nondiabetesrelated medications, and nonislet cell tumors. The initial diagnostic approach should begin by obtaining a detailed history of the nature and timing of the patient's symptoms, medications, underlying comorbid conditions, and any acute illness. A laboratory evaluation should be conducted at the time of the spontaneous symptomatic episode. Supervised tests such as a 72-hour fast or mixedmeal test may be needed to recreate the situation under which the patient is likely to experience symptoms. CONCLUSION: We provide an overview of the physiology of counterregulatory response to hypoglycemia, its causes, and diagnostic approaches to spontaneous hypoglycemia in adults.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：回顾无糖尿病的成人自发性低血糖的临床表现、病因及诊断方法。方法：通过PubMed和Google Scholar数据库 进行文献综述。结果：低血糖在未服用降糖药物的人群中并不常见。在正常生理条件下，多种神经和激素反调节机制可 防止血浆葡萄糖水平异常降低。若怀疑自发性低血糖，应在进一步诊断检查前使用Whipple三联征确认低血糖。 Whipple标准包括：（1）血浆葡萄糖水平低，（2）出现与低血糖水平相符的体征或症状，（3）当血浆葡萄糖水平升高 时，这些体征或症状得到改善。自发性低血糖可由导致内源性高胰岛素血症的疾病引起，包括胰岛素瘤、减重术后低血 糖及非胰岛素瘤性胰源性低血糖。此外，危重症、肝肾功能障碍、激素缺乏、非糖尿病相关药物及非胰岛细胞肿瘤也可 导致自发性低血糖。初始诊断方法应从详细询问患者症状的性质与发生时间、用药史、基础合并症及任何急性疾病开 始。应在自发性症状发作时进行实验室评估。可能需要进行72小时禁食或混合餐试验等监督下的测试，以重现患者可能 出现症状的情境。结论：我们概述了低血糖反调节反应的生理机制、病因及成人自发性低血糖的诊断方法。

literature.topic: 糖尿病视网膜病变 (diabetic retinopathy)
literature.title: A Review on Diabetic Retinopathy.
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病视网膜病变综述

paragraphs.english: diabetic retinopathy is a wellrecognised microvascular complication of diabetes and is among the leading cause of blindness all over the world. Over the last decade, there have been advances in the diagnosis of diabetic retinopathy and diabetic macular edema. At the same time, newer therapies for the management of diabetic retinopathy have evolved. As a result of these advances, a decline in severe vision loss due to diabetes has been witnessed in some developing countries. However, there is a steady increase in the number of people affected with diabetes, and is expected to rise further in the coming years. Therefore, it is prudent to identify diabetic retinopathy, and timely intervention is needed to decrease the burden of severe vision loss. An effort has been made to review all the existing knowledge regarding diabetic retinopathy in this article and summarize the present treatment options for diabetic retinopathy.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病视网膜病变是糖尿病公认的微血管并发症，也是全球导致失明的主要原因之一。过去十年间，糖尿病视网膜病变 及糖尿病黄斑水肿的诊断技术取得了进展。与此同时，针对糖尿病视网膜病变的新型治疗方法也不断涌现。得益于这些 进步，部分发展中国家因糖尿病导致的严重视力丧失病例有所减少。然而，糖尿病患者人数仍在持续增长，预计未来几 年将进一步上升。因此，及早识别糖尿病视网膜病变并进行及时干预，对于减轻严重视究力丧失的负担至关重要。本文旨 在系统回顾糖尿病视网膜病变的现有知识，并总结当前的治疗方案。

literature.title: Inflammation, diabetic foot and related treatments.
literature.title_chinese: 炎症、糖尿病足及相关治疗。

paragraphs.english: diabetic foot, one of the most severe chronic complications of diabetes mellitus, arises from complex interactions among neuropathy, vascular ischemia, and inflammatory dysregulation. This review systematically explores the inflammatory regulatory network centered on NFkappaB and the interleukin (IL) family in the diabetic foot microenvironment and examines their roles in promoting tissue damage. Under hyperglycemic conditions, the AGERAGE axis potently activates the NFkappaB signaling pathway, leading to upregulation of proinflammatory factors and suppression of antiinflammatory mediators, thereby forming a vicious cycle of "inflammationoxidative stresstissue damage." Charcot foot, a distinct subtype characterized by neurogenic osteoarthropathy, is strongly linked to abnormal IL-6/RANKL pathway activation and impaired antiinflammatory neuropeptide signaling. We further assess the diagnostic utility of inflammatory biomarkers, including procalcitonin (PCT), highsensitivity Creactive protein (hsCRP), and the neutrophiltolymphocyte ratio (NLR), and summarize current therapeutic challenges along with emerging targeted strategies, such as NFkappaB inhibition via salicylates. This review underscores the importance of spatiotemporal heterogeneity and dynamic equilibrium within inflammatory networks for clinical stratification and proposes that integrating multiomics data with artificial intelligence models holds promise for developing personalized interventions. This approach offers novel theoretical insights to overcome therapeutic bottlenecks in diabetic foot management.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病足是糖尿病最严重的慢性并发症之一，其发病机制涉及神经病变、血管缺血及炎症调控失调的复杂相互作用。本 综述系统探讨了糖尿病足微环境中以NF-κB和白细胞介素（IL）家族为核心的炎症调控网络，并阐明其在促进组织损伤中 的作用。在高血糖条件下，AGE-RAGE轴强烈激活NF-κB信号通路，导致促炎因子上调及抗炎介质抑制，形成"炎症氧 化应激组织损伤"的恶性循环。夏科足作为以神经源性骨关节病为特征的独特亚型，与IL-6/RANKL通路异常激活及抗炎 神经肽信号受损密切相关。我们进一步评估了降钙素原（PCT）、超敏C反应蛋白（hs-CRP）及中性粒细胞淋巴细胞比 值（NLR）等炎症生物标志物的诊断价值山，并总结了当前治疗挑战及新兴靶向策略（如水杨酸盐抑制NF-κB）。本综述 强调炎症网络的时空异质性与动态平衡对临床分层的重要性，并提出整合多组学数据与人工智能模型有望开发个性化干 预方案，为突破糖尿病足治疗瓶颈提供全新理论视角。

literature.title: Current status and progress in research on dressing management for diabetic foot ulcer.
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病足溃疡敷料管理的研究现状与进展

paragraphs.english: diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) is a major complication of diabetes and is associated with a high risk of lower limb amputation and mortality. During their lifetime, 19%-34% of patients with diabetes can develop DFU. It is estimated that 61% of DFU become infected and 15% of those with DFU require amputation. Furthermore, developing a DFU increases the risk of mortality by 50%-68% at 5 years, higher than some cancers. Current standard management of DFU includes surgical debridement, the use of topical dressings and wound decompression, vascular assessment, and glycemic control. Among these methods, local treatment with dressings builds a protective physical barrier, maintains a moist environment, and drains the exudate from DFU wounds. This review summarizes the development, pathophysiology, and healing mechanisms of DFU. The latest research progress and the main application of dressings in laboratory and clinical stage are also summarized. The dressings discussed in this review include traditional dressings (gauze, oil yarn, traditional Chinese medicine, and others), basic dressings (hydrogel, hydrocolloid, sponge, foam, film agents, and others), bacteriostatic dressings, composite dressings (collagen, nanomaterials, chitosan dressings, and others), bioactive dressings (scaffold dressings with stem cells, decellularized wound matrix, autologous platelet enrichment plasma, and others), and dressings that use modern technology (3D bioprinting, photothermal effects, bioelectric dressings, microneedle dressings, smart bandages, orthopedic prosthetics and regenerative medicine). The dressing management challenges and limitations are also summarized. The purpose of this review is to help readers understand the pathogenesis and healing mechanism of DFU, help physicians select dressings correctly, provide an updated overview of the potential of biomaterials and devices and their application in DFU management, and provide ideas for further exploration and development of dressings. Proper use of dressings can promote DFU healing, reduce the cost of treating DFU, and reduce patient pain.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病足溃疡（DFU）是糖尿病的主要并发症，与下肢截肢和死亡的高风险相关。19%-34%的糖尿病患者一生中可能发 生DFU。据估计，61%的DFU会感染，其中15%需要截肢。此外，发生DFU会使5年死亡风险增加50%-68%，高于某些 癌症。目前DFU的标准治疗包括手术清创、局部敷料使用、伤口减压、血管评估和血糖控制。其中，敷料局部治疗可构 建保护性物理屏障、维持湿润环境并引流DFU伤口渗出液。本综述总结了DFU的发展、病理生理学和愈合机制，同时概 述了敷料在实验室和临床阶段的最新研究进展及主要应用。文中讨论的敷料包括传统敷料（纱布、油纱、中药等）、基 础敷料（水凝胶、水胶体、海绵、泡沫、薄膜剂等）、抑菌敷料、复合敷料（胶原蛋白、纳米材料、壳聚糖敷料等）、 生物活性敷料（含干细胞支架敷料、脱细胞伤口基质、自体富血小板血浆等）以及应用现代技术的敷料（3D生物打印、 光热效应、生物电敷料、微针敷料、智能绷带、骨科假体与再生医学）。同时总结了敷料管理的挑战与局限性。本综述 旨在帮助读者理解DFU的发病机制与愈合机制，指导医生正确选择敷料，提供生物材料与器械在DFU管理中的潜力及应 用的更新概述，并为敷料的进一步探索与开发提供思路。合理使用敷料可促进DFU愈合、降低治疗成本并减轻患者痛 苦。

literature.title: Mechanisms of diabetic foot ulceration: A review.
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病足溃疡的机制：综述。

paragraphs.english: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) are associated with complex pathogenic factors and are considered a serious complication of diabetes. The potential mechanisms underlying DFUs have been increasingly investigated. Previous studies have focused on the three aspects of diabetic peripheral vascular disease, neuropathy, and wound infections. With advances in technology, researchers have been gradually conducting studies using immune cells, endothelial cells, keratinocytes, and fibroblasts, as they are involved in wound healing. It has been reported that the upregulation or downregulation of molecular signaling pathways is essential for the healing of DFUs. With a recent increase in the awareness of epigenetics, its regulatory role in wound healing has become a much soughtafter trend in the treatment of DFUs. This review focuses on four aspects involved in the pathogenesis of DFUs: physiological and pathological mechanisms, cellular mechanisms, molecular signaling pathway mechanisms, and epigenetics. Given the challenge in the treatment of DFUs, we are hopeful that our review will provide new ideas for peers.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病足溃疡（DFUs）的致病因素复杂，被视为糖尿病的严重并发症。近年来，关于DFUs潜在机制的研究日益深入。 既往研究主要聚焦于糖尿病周围血管病变、神经病变及创面感染三个方面。随着技术进步，研究者逐步开展涉及免疫细 胞、内皮细胞、角质形成细胞和成纤维细胞在创面愈合中作用的研究。已有报道指出，分子信号通路的上调或下调对 DFUs的愈合至关重要。随着表观遗传学认知的深化，其在创面愈合中的调控作用已成为DFUs治疗领域备受关注的新趋 势。本综述从DFUs发病机制涉及的四个维度展开：生理病理机制、细胞机制、分子信号通路机制及表观遗传学机制。鉴 于DFUs治疗的挑战性，我们期待本综述能为同行提供新的研究思路。

literature.topic: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒 (diabetic ketoacidosis)
literature.title: Developing a Protocol for Management of Euglycemic Diabetic Ketoacidosis.
literature.title_chinese: 制定正常血糖糖尿病酮症酸中毒管理方案

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA) has been described since the 1970s, however the incidence appears to be increasing in association with the increased use of sodiumglucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) medications. Traditional hospitalbased DKA protocols in which an insulin infusion is adjusted based on glucose levels are not effective in euDKA due to the presence of euglycemia which limits the capacity for insulin administration. This review was completed to review the data on euDKA and introduce a protocol for targeted management of this condition. RECENT FINDINGS: Data comparing euDKA outcomes to traditional hyperglycemia DKA demonstrate longer hospital length of stay and mean time to anion gap closure in euDKA based on current DKA management standards. Furthermore, the increase in prescribing SGLT2i medications thereby increases the risk of euDKA. At present, there are no reported protocols specific for euDKA and it is not directly addressed in the most recent guidelines issued by endocrinology specialty societies. We created a protocol within our hospital intensive care unit to standardize treatment of euDKA using fixed insulin infusion and titration of dextrosecontaining fluids. The protocol has been approved by our hospital regulatory committees and is currently being utilized in intensive care units. Future studies should review ongoing safety and efficacy of protocol use in various hospital settings.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：正常血糖性糖尿病酮症酸中毒（euDKA）自20世纪70年代起已有记载，但随着钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制 剂（SGLT2i）药物使用的增加，其发病率似乎呈上升趋势。传统基于医院的DKA治疗方案（根据血糖水平调整胰岛素输 注）对euDKA无效，因为正常血糖限制了胰岛素给药能侵力。本综述旨在总结euDKA相关数据，并引入针对该病症的靶向 管理方案。最新发现：比较euDKA与传统高血糖DKA结局的数据显示，基于当前DKA管理标准，euDKA患者的住院时间 更长，阴离子间隙闭合平均时间也更长。此外，SG-LT2i药物处方的增加进一步提高了euDKA风险。目前尚无针对euDKA 的特定治疗方案报告，且内分泌专业学会最新发布的指南也未直接涉及该问题。我们在医院重症监护室制定了一项方 案，通过固定胰岛素输注和含糖液体滴定来标准化euDKA治疗。该方案已获医院监管委员会批准，目前正在重症监护室 应用。未来研究应持续评估该方案在不同医院环境中的安全性和有效性。

literature.title: Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis in the era of SGLT-2 inhibitors.
literature.title_chinese: SGLT-2抑制剂时代的正常血糖性糖尿病酮症酸中毒。

paragraphs.english: euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (EDKA) is an emerging complication of diabetes associated with an increasing use of sodiumglucose transporter type 2 (SGLT-2) inhibitor drugs. This review highlights the growing incidence of EDKA and its diagnostic challenges due to the absence of hallmark hyperglycemia seen in diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA). The paper presents a classification system for the severity of EDKA, categorizing it into mild, moderate, and severe based on serum pH and bicarbonate levels. Another classification system is proposed to define stages of EDKA based on anion gap and ketones at the time of diagnosis and during the treatment period. A treatment algorithm is proposed to guide clinicians in managing EDKA. This treatment algorithm includes monitoring anion gap and ketones to guide insulin and fluid management, and slower transition to subcutaneous insulin to prevent a relapse. Increased awareness of EDKA is essential for a timely diagnosis because an early diagnosis and treatment can improve clinical outcomes.
paragraphs.chinese: 正常血糖性糖尿病酮症酸中毒（EDKA）是糖尿病的一种新兴并发症，与2型钠葡萄糖转运体（SGLT-2）抑制剂药物的 使用增加相关。本综述强调了EDKA发病率的上升及其诊断挑战，因为该病缺乏糖尿病酮症酸中毒（DKA）典型的高血糖 特征。本文提出了一种基于血清pH值和碳酸氢盐水平的EDKA严重程度分类系统，将其究分为轻度、中度和重度。另一分 类系统则根据诊断时及治疗期间的阴离子间隙和酮体水平，定义了EDKA的不同阶段。此外，本文提出了一种治疗流程以 指导临床医生管理EDKA，该流程包括监测阴离子间隙和酮体以指导胰岛素和液体管理，并建议更缓慢地过渡至皮下胰岛 素以防止复发。提高对EDKA的认识对于及时诊断至关重要，因为早期诊断和治疗可改善临床结局。

literature.topic: 高血糖高渗状态 (hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state)
literature.title: Diabetic ketoacidosis and hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state in patients with endstage renal disease on dialysis: a review.
literature.title_chinese: 终末期肾病透析患者中的糖尿病酮症酸中毒和高渗性高血糖状态：综述。

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE: This review aims to discuss the prevalence, risk factors, and management of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) and hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state (HHS) in patients with endstage renal disease (ESRD) on hemodialysis. METHODS: A comprehensive literature review of retrospective studies, case reports, and clinical guidelines was conducted. RESULTS: DKA and HHS incidence is lower in ESRD patients due to delayed insulin clearance and regular dialysis. Management requires cautious fluid administration, reduced insulin infusion rates, conservative potassium replacement, and gradual correction of hyperosmolarity. Emergency hemodialysis may be necessary for severe acidosis or hyperkalemia. CONCLUSION: Treatment must be individualized. Emerging strategies, including extended dialysis sessions and closed- loop insulin delivery, require further validation.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：本综述旨在探讨终末期肾病（ESRD）血液透析患者中糖尿病酮症酸中毒（DKA）和高渗性高血糖状态（HHS）的 患病率、危险因素及管理策略。方法：对回顾性研究、病例报告及临床指南进行系统性文献综述。结果：由于胰岛素清 除延迟及规律透析，ESRD患者中DKA和HHS的发生率较低。管理需谨慎补液、降低胰岛素输注速率、保守补钾并逐步纠 正高渗状态。严重酸中毒或高钾血症时可能需要紧急血液透析。结论：治疗需个体化。延长透析疗程及闭环胰岛素输注 等新兴策略仍需进一步验证。

literature.title: The role of automated insulin delivery technology in diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 自动化胰岛素输送技术在糖尿病中的作用

paragraphs.english: The role of automated insulin delivery systems in diabetes is expanding. Hybrid closedloop systems are being used in routine clinical practice for treating people with type 1 diabetes. Encouragingly, realworld data reflects the performance and usability observed in clinical trials. We review the commercially available hybrid closedloop systems, their distinctive features and the associated realworld data. We also consider emerging indications for closedloop systems, including the treatment of type 2 diabetes where variability of daytoday insulin requirements is high, and other challenging applications for this technology. We discuss issues around access and implementation of closedloop technology, and consider the limitations of present closedloop systems, as well as innovative approaches that are being evaluated to improve their performance.
paragraphs.chinese: 自动化胰岛素输注系统在糖尿病治疗中的作用正在不断扩大。混合闭环系统已广泛应用于1型糖尿病的常规临床治疗。令 人振奋的是，真实世界数据反映了临床试验中观察到的性能和可用性。我们回顾了市售的混合闭环系统、其独特特征及 相关真实世界数据。同时探讨了闭环系统的新兴适应症，包括治疗每日胰岛素需求波动较大的2型糖尿病，以及该技术在 其他具有挑战性场景中的应用。我们讨论了闭环技术的可及性与实施问题，分析了当前究闭环系统的局限性，以及正在评 估的旨在提升其性能的创新方法。

literature.topic: 持续葡萄糖监测 (continuous glucose monitoring)
literature.title: Is It Time to Move Beyond TIR to TITR? RealWorld Data from Over 20,000 Users of Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Patients with Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes.
literature.title_chinese: 是时候从TIR转向TITR了吗？来自超过20,000名1型和2型糖尿病患者持续血糖监测的真实世界数据。

paragraphs.english: The growing use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) has been supported by expert consensus and clinical guidelines on glycemic management in diabetes with time in range (TIR 70-180 mg/dL) representing a key CGMderived glucose metric. time in tight range (TITR) has also been proposed for clinical use, spanning largely normal glucose levels of 70-140 mg/dL. However, keeping such narrow glucose ranges can be challenging, and understanding the factors modulating TITR can help achieve these tight glycemic targets. Our reallife study aimed to evaluate the relationship between average glucose (AG) and TIR/TITR in a large cohort (n = 22,006) of CGM users, divided into four groups: selfidentified as having type 1 diabetes (T1D) treated with insulin using multiple daily injections (MDI) or pumps; type 2 diabetes (T2D) on MDI or insulin pumps; T2D on basal insulin only; and T2D not on insulin treatment. The T2D groups, regardless of treatment type, displayed the highest TIR and TITR values, associated with lowest glycemic variability measured as glucose coefficient of variation (CV; 23-30%). The T1D group showed the lowest TIR and TITR, associated with the highest CVs (36-38%). Overall, higher CV was associated with lower TIR and TITR for AG values below 180 and 140 mg/dL, respectively, with the reverse holding true for AG values above these thresholds. The discordance between AG and TIR/TITR was less pronounced in T2D compared with T1D, attributed to lower CV in the former group. It was also observed that TITR has advantages over TIR for assessing glycemia status and progress toward more stringent A1C, particularly when approaching normal glucose levels. The data detail how CV affects the AG relationship with TIR/TITR, which has implications for CGM interpretation. In many instances TITR, rather than TIR, may be preferable to employ once AG falls below 140 mg/dL and nearnormal glucose levels are required clinically.
paragraphs.chinese: 持续葡萄糖监测（CGM）的广泛应用已获得糖尿病血糖管理专家共识和临床指南的支持，其中目标范围内时间（TIR 70- 180 mg/dL）是CGM衍生的关键血糖指标。严格目标范围内时间（TITR）也被提出用于临床实践，其范围主要覆盖正常 血糖水平70-140 mg/dL。然而，维持如此狭窄的血糖范围具有挑战性，理解影响TITR的因素有助于实现这些严格的血 糖目标。本真实世界研究旨在评估大规模CGM用户队列（n=22,006）中平均血糖（AG）与TIR/TITR的关系。研究对象 分为四组：自我报告为1型糖尿病（T1D）且接受每日多次胰岛素注射（MDI）或胰岛素泵治疗者；2型糖尿病（T2D） 接受MDI或胰岛素泵治疗者；仅使用基础胰岛素的T2D患者；以及未接受胰岛素治疗的T2D患者。无论采用何种治疗方 式，T2D组的TIR和TITR值均最高，且血糖变异系数（CV；23-30%）最低。T1D组的TIR和TITR值最低，CV值最高 （36-38%）。总体而言，当AG低于180 mg/dL和140 mg/dL时，较高的CV与较低的TIR和TITR相关；当AG高于这些 阈值时则相反。与T1D相比，T2D组中AG与TIR/TITR的不一致性更小，这归因于前者的CV较低。研究还发现，在评估血 糖状态及向更严格糖化血红蛋白（A1C）目标进展时，TITR比TIR更具优势，尤其在接近正常血糖水平时。这些数据详细 说明了CV如何影响AG与TIR/TITR的关系，这对CGM解读具有重要意义。当AG低于140 mg/dL且临床需要接近正常血糖 水平时，多数情况下优先使用TITR而非TIR更为合适。

literature.title: Onceweekly insulin efsitora alfa: Design and rationale for the QWINT phase 3 clinical development programme.
literature.title_chinese: 每周一次胰岛素efsitora alfa：QWINT 3期临床开发项目的设计与原理

paragraphs.english: AIMS: insulin efsitora alfa (efsitora) is a onceweekly basal insulin. This review describes the study design and rationale of the efsitora phase 3 Once Weekly (QW) insulin Therapy (QWINT) clinical development programme, including the five trials, QWINT-1 through QWINT-5. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The five trials included insulinnaive adults (QWINT- 1 and -2) with type 2 diabetes (T2D), adults with T2D previously treated with basal insulin (QWINT-3 and -4), and QWINT- 5 in adults with type 1 diabetes. All five trials were designed as multicentre, randomized, controlled, openlabel, treatto- target studies to investigate the efficacy and safety of efsitora versus active oncedaily basal insulin comparators (insulin glargine U100 or insulin degludec U100). The primary objective of each trial is to compare the change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26 or 52 between efsitora and the active comparator. The key secondary objectives include change in fasting glucose, insulin dose and continuous glucose monitoring variables, and patientreported outcome questionnaires. CONCLUSIONS: The QWINT development programme includes a racially and geographically diverse population to provide important information regarding the efficacy and safety of efsitora and its clinical management of people with diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的：胰岛素依非托拉α（依非托拉）是一种每周一次的基础胰岛素。本综述描述了依非托拉3期每周一次胰岛素治疗 （QWINT）临床开发项目的研究设计和原理，包括五项试验（QWINT-1至QWINT-5）。材料与方法：这五项试验包括 未使用过胰岛素的2型糖尿病（T2D）成人患者（QWINT-1和-2）、既往接受基础胰岛素治疗的T2D成人患者 （QWINT-3和-4），以及1型糖尿病成人患者（QWINT-5）。所有五项试验均设计为多中心、随机、对照、开放标签、 达标治疗研究，旨在评估依非托拉与每日一次活性基础胰岛素对照药（甘精胰岛素U100或德谷胰岛素U100）的有效性 和安全性。每项试验的主要目标是比较依非托拉与活性对照药从基线至第26周或第52周HbA1c的变化。关键次要目标包 括空腹血糖变化、胰岛素剂量、持续血糖监测变量以及患者报告结局问卷。结论：QWINT开发项目纳入了种族和地理背 景多样的人群，为依非托拉的有效性、安全性及其在糖尿病患者中的临床管理提供了重要信息。

literature.title: Safety and glycaemic control during exercise with the MiniMed 780G: A narrative review of evidence from lab to real world.
literature.title_chinese: MiniMed 780G运动期间的安全性与血糖控制：从实验室到现实世界证据的叙述性综述

paragraphs.english: Physical activity plays a critical role in reducing cardiovascular risk among individuals with type 1 diabetes (PwT1D); however, more than twothirds of PwT1D remain insufficiently active, primarily due to the unpredictability of glucose fluctuations and the fear of hypoglycaemia during exercise. Automated insulin delivery systems, such as the MiniMed 780G (MM780G), offer potential solutions by automating insulin dosing, supporting stable glucose control, and allowing for a higher temporary glucose target. This narrative review summarizes the current evidence on the safety and efficacy of the MM780G system during exercise in PwT1D, with a focus on the temporary target (TT) feature and realworld usability. The MM780G consistently supports glycaemic safety during exercise, especially moderateintensity aerobic activity, with time in range frequently meeting or exceeding consensus guidelines. Activation of the TT feature 60- to 120-min preexercise, particularly when paired with reduced meal boluses, significantly lowers the risk of hypoglycaemia. Realworld studies confirm its safety across varied activities, including prolonged aerobic exercise and contact sports. While evidence for resistance and highintensity exercise remains limited, initial findings are favourable. User education is crucial to optimize use, particularly in competitive and prolonged settings. The MM780G is a safe and effective tool for glycaemic management during exercise in PwT1D. Best outcomes are achieved through strategic use of the TT feature and meal bolus reduction, individualized carbohydrate strategies and proper education. Applying easytofollow preexercising recommendations may encourage better engagement with regular exercising. Further research is needed on longterm adaptations to training and resistancebased exercise protocols. 权
paragraphs.chinese: 体育锻炼在降低1型糖尿病患者心血管风险方面具有关键作用，但超过三分之二的患者仍缺乏足够运动，主要原因是血糖 波动不可预测以及对运动期间低血糖的担忧。以美敦力MiniMed 780G（MM780G）为代表的自动胰岛素输注系统，通 过自动化胰岛素输注、维持血糖稳定并允许设置更高的临时血糖目标，提供了潜在解决方案。本综述总结了MM780G系 统在1型糖尿病患者运动期间安全性与有效性的现有证据，重点关注临时目标功能及真实世界应用体验。MM780G在运 动期间（尤其是中等强度有氧运动）持续保障血糖安全，血糖达标时间常达到或超过共识指南标准。运动前60-120分钟 激活临时目标功能，特别是配合减少餐前胰岛素剂量时，可显著降低低血糖风险。真实世界研究证实其在多种运动场景 （包括长时间有氧运动和接触性运动）中的安全性。尽管抗阻训练和高强度运动的证据仍有限，但初步结果令人鼓舞。 用户教育对优化使用至关重要，尤其在竞技运动和长时间运动场景中。MM780G是1型糖尿病患者运动期间血糖管理的 安全有效工具。通过策略性使用临时目标功能、减少餐前胰岛素剂量、个体化碳水化合物策略及充分教育，可获得最佳 效果。采用易于遵循的运动前建议可能有助于促进患者坚持规律运动。未来需进一步研究长期训练适应及抗阻运动方 案。

literature.title: Diabetes Technology in People with Type 2 Diabetes: Novel Indications.
literature.title_chinese: 2型糖尿病患者中的糖尿病技术：新适应症。

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: diabetes technology has been continuously evolving. Current versions of continuous glucose monitors (CGM) use minimally invasive designs, monitor glucose values with high accuracy, and can be used to guide insulin dosing. Extensive evidence supports the use of diabetes technology for monitoring and insulin administration in people with type 1 diabetes. However, there is emerging evidence for people with type 2 diabetes. In this review, we present the different technological devices used to monitor glucose and deliver insulin and the evidence supporting their use in people with type 2 diabetes. RECENT FINDINGS: The use of CGMs in people with type 2 diabetes treated with insulin or noninsulin therapies has been associated with improvements in glycemic control and time spent in hypoglycemia. Smart insulin pens and smart connected devices are options to track compliance and guide insulin delivery in people who do not require insulin pump therapy. Mechanical patch pumps can be used to reduce the burden of multiple daily insulin injections. automated insulin delivery algorithms improve glycemic control without an increase in hypoglycemia. The use of technology in the management of type 2 diabetes generates glycemic data previously inaccessible, reduces barriers for insulin initiation, improves glycemic control, tracks adherence to therapy, and improves user satisfaction.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：糖尿病技术持续发展。当前版本的持续葡萄糖监测系统采用微创设计，能以高精度监测血糖值，并可用于指 导胰岛素剂量调整。大量证据支持糖尿病技术在1型糖尿病患者监测与胰岛素给药中的应用，但针对2型糖尿病患者的证 据正在逐步积累。本综述将介绍用于血糖监测与胰岛素给药的不同技术设备，以及支持其在2型糖尿病患者中应用的循证 依据。最新发现：在接受胰岛素或非胰岛素治疗的2型糖尿病患者中使用持续葡萄糖监测系统，可改善血糖控制并减少低 血糖时间。智能胰岛素笔与智能连接设备为无需胰岛素泵治疗的患者提供了依从性追踪与胰岛素给药指导方案。机械贴 片泵可减轻每日多次胰岛素注射的负担。自动化胰岛素输注算法能在不增加低血糖风险的前提下改善血糖控制。糖尿病 管理技术的应用可获取既往无法获得的血糖数据，降低胰岛素启动障碍，改善血糖控制，追踪治疗依从性，并提升用户 满意度。
