literature.title: Obesity, Metabolic Syndrome, and OsteoarthritisAn Updated Review.
literature.title_chinese: 肥胖、代谢综合征与骨关节炎——最新综述

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: metabolic syndrome (MetS), also called the 'deadly quartet' comprising obesity, diabetes, dyslipidemia, and hypertension, has been ascertained to have a causal role in the pathogenesis of osteoarthritis (OA). This review is aimed at discussing the current knowledge on the contribution of metabolic syndrome and its various components to OA pathogenesis and progression. RECENT FINDINGS: Lately, an increased association identified between the various components of metabolic syndrome (obesity, diabetes, dyslipidemia, and hypertension) with OA has led to the identification of the 'metabolic phenotype' of OA. These metabolic perturbations alongside lowgrade systemic inflammation have been identified to inflict detrimental effects upon multiple tissues of the joint including cartilage, bone, and synovium leading to complete joint failure in OA. Recent epidemiological and clinical findings affirm that adipokines significantly contribute to inflammation, tissue degradation, and OA pathogenesis mediated through multiple signaling pathways. OA is no longer perceived as just a 'wear and tear' disease and the involvement of the metabolic components in OA pathogenesis adds up to the complexity of the disease. Given the global surge in obesity and its allied metabolic perturbations, this review aims to throw light on the current knowledge on the pathophysiology of MetSassociated OA and the need to address MetS in the context of metabolic OA management. Better regulation of the constituent factors of MetS could be profitable in preventing MetSassociated OA. The identification of key roles for several metabolic regulators in OA pathogenesis has also opened up newer avenues in the recognition and development of novel therapeutic agents.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：代谢综合征（MetS），又称“致命四重奏”，包括肥胖、糖尿病、血脂异常和高血压，已被证实对骨关节炎 （OA）的发病机制具有因果作用。本综述旨在探讨当前关于代谢综合征及其各组分对OA发病和进展影响的认识。最新 发现：近期，代谢综合征各组分（肥胖、糖尿病、血脂异常和高血压）与OA之间关联的增强，促使了OA“代谢表型” 的识别。这些代谢紊乱伴随低度全身性炎症，已被发现对关节的多种组织（包括软骨、骨骼和滑膜）造成有害影响，最 终导致OA中的关节完全衰竭。最新的流行病学和临床研究证实，脂肪因子通过多种信号通路显著促进炎症、组织降解及 OA发病机制。OA不再被视为单纯的“磨损”性疾病，代谢组分在OA发病机制中的参与增加了疾病的复杂性。鉴于全球 肥胖及其相关代谢紊乱的激增，梦本综述旨在阐明当前关于MetS相关OA病理生理学的认识，以及在代谢性OA管理中应对 MetS的必要性。更好地调控MetS的组成因素可能有助于预防MetS相关OA。此外，多种代谢调节因子在OA发病机制中 关键作用的发现，也为识别和开发新型治疗药物开辟了新途径。

literature.title: Obesity Paradox: Fact or Fiction?
literature.title_chinese: 肥胖悖论：事实还是虚构？

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: obesity is related to several comorbidities such as type 2 diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, heart failure, and various types of cancers. While the detrimental effect of obesity in both mortality and morbidity has been well established, the concept of the obesity paradox in specific chronic diseases remains a topic of continuous interest. In the present review, we examine the controversial issues around the obesity paradox in certain conditions such as cardiovascular disease, several types of cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and the factors that may confound the relation between obesity and mortality. RECENT FINDINGS: We refer to the obesity paradox when particular chronic diseases exhibit an interesting "paradoxical" protective association between the body mass index (BMI) and clinical outcomes. This association, however, may be driven by multiple factors among which the limitations of the BMI itself; the unintended weight loss precipitated by chronic illness; the various phenotypes of obesity, i.e., sarcopenic obesity or the athlete's obesity phenotype; and the cardiorespiratory fitness levels of the included patients. Recent evidence highlighted that previous cardioprotective medications, obesity duration, and smoking status seem to play a role in the obesity paradox. The obesity paradox has been described in a plethora of chronic diseases. It cannot be emphasized enough that the incomplete information received from a single BMI measurement may interfere with outcomes of studies arguing in favor of the obesity paradox. Thus, the development of carefully designed studies, unhampered by confounding factors, is of great importance.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：肥胖与多种合并症相关，如2型糖尿病、心血管疾病、心力衰竭及各类癌症。尽管肥胖对死亡率和发病率的负 面影响已得到充分证实，但特定慢性疾病中"肥胖悖论"的概念仍是持续关注的焦点。本综述探讨了心血管疾病、多种癌症 及慢性阻塞性肺疾病等特定疾病中围绕肥胖悖论的争议性问题，以及可能混淆肥胖与死亡率关系的因素。最新发现：当 特定慢性疾病在体重指数（BMI）与临床结局之间呈现有趣的"矛盾性"保护关联时，我们称之为肥胖悖论。然而，这种关 联可能受多重因素驱动，包括BMI本身的局限性、慢性疾病引发的非自愿性体重下降、肥胖的不同表型（如肌少性肥胖 或运动员型肥胖表型），以及纳入患者的心肺适能水平。最新证据强调，既往心脏保护药物使用、肥胖持续时间及吸烟 状态似乎也在肥胖悖论中发挥作用。肥胖悖论已在多种慢性疾病中被描述。必须反复强调，单次BMI测量所获的不完整 信息可能干扰支持肥胖悖论的研究结论。因此，开展不受混杂因素影响的精心设计研究至关重要。

literature.title: Resmetirom: The First DiseaseSpecific Treatment for MASH.
literature.title_chinese: 瑞司美替罗：首个针对MASH的疾病特异性治疗药物

paragraphs.english: In 2023, the medical terminology for Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and NA Steatohepatitis (NASH) was updated to Metabolic DysfunctionAssociated SteatoticLiver Disease (MASLD) and MA Steatohepatitis (MASH). This review highlights the critical epidemiological, pathophysiological, and therapeutic aspects of MASH, focusing on the novel treatment option, resmetirom. Resmetirom, a Thyroid Hormone Receptorbeta (THRbeta) agonist, specifically targets liver function to simulate localized Hyperthyroidism, effectively reducing Lipid Accumulation and Liver Fibrosis without the systemic effects commonly associated with thyroid hormone therapy. Clinical trials, particularly the pivotal MAESTRO- NASH trial, have demonstrated significant improvements in liver health metrics, achieving primary endpoints by resolving MASH without worsening fibrosis and showing a favorable Safety Profile. This paper reviews the mechanism of action, efficacy, and safety of resmetirom, providing insight into its potential to change the therapeutic landscape for patients suffering from MASH.
paragraphs.chinese: 2023年，非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）和非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的医学术语更新为代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性 肝病（MASLD）和代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）。本综述重点阐述了MASH的关键流行病学、病理生理学及 治疗学要点，聚焦于新型治疗药物瑞美替罗。瑞美替罗作为一种甲状腺激素受体β（THR-beta）激动剂，通过特异性靶 向肝脏功能模拟局部甲状腺功能亢进状态，在有效减少脂质蓄积和肝纤维化的同时，避免了甲状腺激素治疗常见的全身 性副作用。关键性MAESTRO-NASH临床试验证实，该药物在改善肝脏健康指标方面取得显著成效，在未加重纤维化的 情况下实现MASH消退的主要终点，并展现出良好的安全性特征。本文系统回顾了瑞美替罗的作用机制、疗效及安全性 数据，揭示了其改变MASH患者治疗格局的潜在价值。

literature.title: Metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease and its link to cancer.
literature.title_chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病及其与癌症的关联。

paragraphs.english: Metabolicdysfunction associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), formerly known as nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), is a growing global health concern with significant implications for oncogenesis. This review synthesizes current evidence on the association between MASLD and cancer risk, highlighting its role as a risk factor for both intrahepatic and extrahepatic malignancies. MASLD is increasingly recognized as a major cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), with its incidence rising in parallel with the prevalence of metabolic dysfunction. Furthermore, MASLD is associated with an elevated risk of various gastrointestinal cancers, including colorectal, esophageal, stomach, and pancreatic cancers. Beyond the digestive tract, evidence suggests that MASLD may also contribute to an increased risk of other cancers such as breast, prostate, thyroid, gynecological, renal and lung cancers. Understanding the mechanisms underlying these associations and the impact of MASLD on cancer risk is crucial for developing targeted screening and prevention strategies.
paragraphs.chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD），原名非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD），是一个日益严重的全球健康问题，对 肿瘤发生具有重要影响。本综述综合了当前关于MASLD与癌症风险关联的证据，强调其作为肝内和肝外恶性肿瘤危险因 素的作用。MASLD日益被认为是肝细胞癌（HCC）的主要原因，其发病率随代谢功能障碍的流行而上升。此外， MASLD与多种胃肠道癌症风险升高相关，包括结直肠癌、食管癌、胃癌和胰腺癌。在消化道以外，证据表明MASLD可 能还增加其他癌症的风险，如乳腺癌、前列腺癌、甲状腺癌、妇科癌症、肾癌和肺癌。理解这些关联背后的机制以及 MASLD对癌症风险的影响，对于制定针对性的筛查和预防策略至关重要。

literature.title: Osteokines in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease.
literature.title_chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病中的骨因子。

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: To critically summarize evidence on the potential role of osteokines in the pathogenesis and progression of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). RECENT FINDINGS: There are emerging data supporting that certain osteokines, which are specific bonederived proteins, may beneficially or adversely affect hepatic metabolism, and their alterations in the setting of osteoporosis or other bone metabolic diseases may possibly contribute to the development and progression of NAFLD. There is evidence showing a potential bidirectional association between NAFLD and bone metabolism, which may imply the existence of a liverbone axis. In this regard, osteocalcin, osteoprotegerin, bone morphogenic protein 4 (BMP4) and BMP6 appear to have a positive impact on the liver, thus possibly alleviating NAFLD, whereas osteopontin, receptor activator of nuclear factor kappa Beta ligand (RANKL), sclerostin, periostin, BMP8B, and fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) appear to have a negative impact on the liver, thus possibly exacerbating NAFLD. The potential implication of osteokines in NAFLD warrants further animal and clinical research in the field that may possibly result in novel therapeutic targets for NAFLD in the future.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：批判性总结骨因子在非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）发病机制及进展中潜在作用的证据。最新发现：新兴数 据表明，某些骨因子（即骨特异性蛋白）可能对肝脏代谢产生有益或不利影响，在骨质疏松或其他骨代谢疾病背景下， 这些骨因子的改变可能促进NAFLD的发生发展。现有证据显示NAFLD与骨代谢之间存在潜在双向关联，提示可能存在 肝骨轴。其中，骨钙素、骨保护素、骨形态发生蛋白4（BMP4）和BMP6对肝脏具有积极影响，可能缓解NAFLD；而 骨桥蛋白、核因子κB受体活化因子配体（RANKL）、硬骨素、骨膜蛋白、BMP8B及成纤维细胞生长因子23（FGF23） 对肝脏具有负面影响，可能加重NAFLD。骨因子在NAFLD中的潜在作用需进一步开展动物及临床研究，未来或可为 NAFLD提供新型治疗靶点。

literature.title: MAFLD: a multisystem disease.
literature.title_chinese: MAFLD：一种多系统疾病
literature.journal: Therapeutic advances in endocrinology and metabolism

paragraphs.english: nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), affecting about 25% of general population and more than 50% of dysmetabolic patients, is an emerging cause of chronic liver disease and its complications. Recently, an international consensus of experts proposed to rename this disease as 'metabolic dysfunctionAssociated Fatty Liver Disease' (MAFLD) to focus on the bidirectional interplay between fatty liver and metabolic alterations and to stress the need of assessing fatty liver independently from alcohol consumption and other coexisting causes of liver disease. The peculiarity of NAFLD/MAFLD lies in the presence of a higher risk of not only - as expected - liverrelated events but also of extrahepatic events, mostly cardiovascular and cancers. Available evidence suggests that these associations are not only the expression of sharing the same risk factors but shed light about the ability of NAFLD/MAFLD and particularly of its progressive form - nonalcoholic/metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatohepatitis - to act as an independent risk factor via promotion of atherogenic dyslipidemia and a proinflammatory, profibrogenic, and procoagulant systemic environment. The present review summarizes available epidemiological and clinical evidence supporting the concept of NAFLD/MAFLD as a multisystemic disease, and highlights potential explanatory mechanisms underlying the association between NAFLD/MAFLD and extrahepatic disorders.
paragraphs.chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）影响约25%的普通人群及超过50%的代谢紊乱患者，已成为慢性肝病及其并发症的新兴 病因。近期国际专家共识建议将该病更名为"代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病"（MAFLD），以强调脂肪肝与代谢异常的双 向相互作用，并突出需独立于饮酒及其他共存肝病病因评估脂肪肝的必要性。NAFLD/MAFLD的特殊性在于其不仅增加 预期的肝脏相关事件风险，更显著提升肝外事件（主要为心血管疾病和恶性肿瘤）的发生风险。现有证据表明，这种关 联不仅源于共同危险因素的表达，更揭示了NAFLD/MAFLD（特别是其进展型——非酒精性/代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝 炎）通过促进致动脉粥样硬化性血脂异常，营造促炎、促纤维化及促凝血系统性环境，从而作为独立危险因素的作用机 制。本综述汇总支持NAFLD/MAFLD作为多系统疾病概念的流行病学与临床证据，并重点阐释NAFLD/MAFLD与肝外疾 病关联的潜在机制。

literature.title: Obesity and Dyslipidemia: A Review of Current Evidence.
literature.title_chinese: 肥胖与血脂异常：当前证据综述。

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: obesity is accompanied by atherogenic dyslipidemia, a specific lipid disorder characterized by both quantitative and qualitative changes of plasma lipoproteins. The main alterations in the lipid profile include hypertriglyceridemia, reduced highdensity lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol level, and elevated small dense lowdensity lipoprotein (LDL) particles. Epidemiological data show that obesity is more common in women and is a frequent risk factor for reproductive disorders, metabolic complications in pregnancy, and cardiometabolic disease later in life. The aim of this narrative review is to discuss recent advances in the research of dyslipidemia in obesity, with an emphasis on femalespecific disorders and cardiometabolic risk. RECENT FINDINGS: The focus of current research on dyslipidemia in obesity is moving toward structurally and functionally modified plasma lipoproteins. Special attention is paid to the proatherogenic role of triglyceriderich lipoproteins and their remnants. Introduction of advanced analytical techniques enabled identification of novel lipid biomarkers with potential clinical applications. In particular, proteomic and lipidomic studies have provided significant progress in the comprehensive research of HDL's alterations in obesity. obesityrelated dyslipidemia is a widespread metabolic disturbance in polycystic ovary syndrome patients and highrisk pregnancies, but is seldom evaluated with respect to its impact on future cardiometabolic health. obesity and associated cardiometabolic diseases require a more depth insight into the quality of lipoprotein particles. Further application of omicsbased techniques would enable a more comprehensive evaluation of dyslipidemia in order to reduce an excessive cardiovascular risk attributable to increased body weight. However, more studies on obesityrelated female reproductive disorders are needed for this approach to be adopted in daily clinical practice. 权
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：肥胖伴随致动脉粥样硬化性血脂异常，这是一种以血浆脂蛋白定量和定性改变为特征的特定脂质紊乱。血脂 谱的主要改变包括高甘油三酯血症、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平降低以及小而密低密度脂蛋白颗粒升高。流行病学数据显 示，肥胖在女性中更为常见，且是生殖障碍、妊娠期代谢并发症及晚年心血管代谢疾病的常见危险因素。本叙述性综述 旨在探讨肥胖相关血脂异常研究的最新进展，重点关注女性特异性疾病及心血管代谢风险。近期发现：当前肥胖相关血 脂异常的研究焦点正转向结构及功能修饰的血浆脂蛋白，尤其关注富含甘油三酯的脂蛋白及其残粒的促动脉粥样硬化作 用。先进分析技术的引入使具有潜在临床应用价值的新型脂质生物标志物得以识别。特别是蛋白质组学和脂质组学研究 在全面探索肥胖中高密度脂蛋白改变方面取得了显著进展。肥胖相关血脂异常是多囊卵巢综合征患者及高危妊娠中普遍 存在的代谢紊乱，但其对未来心血管代谢健康的影响却鲜少被评估。肥胖及其相关心血管代谢疾病需更深入地洞察脂蛋 白颗粒的质量。进一步应用组学技术将有助于更全面地评估血脂异常，以降低因体重增加导致的过度心血管风险。然 而，要使该方法应用于日常临床实践，仍需开展更多关于肥胖相关女性生殖障碍的研究。

literature.title: Semaglutide for the treatment of overweight and obesity: A review.
literature.title_chinese: 司美格鲁肽治疗超重和肥胖的综述。

paragraphs.english: obesity is a chronic, relapsing disease associated with multiple complications and a substantial morbidity, mortality and health care burden. Pharmacological treatments for obesity provide a valuable adjunct to lifestyle intervention, which often achieves only limited weight loss that is difficult to maintain. The Semaglutide Treatment Effect in People with obesity (STEP) clinical trial programme is evaluating onceweekly subcutaneous semaglutide 2.4 mg (a glucagonlike peptide-1 analogue) in people with overweight or obesity. Across STEP 1, 3, 4 and 8, semaglutide 2.4 mg was associated with mean weight losses of 14.9%-17.4% in individuals with overweight or obesity without type 2 diabetes from baseline to week 68; 69%-79% of participants achieved >/=10% weight loss with semaglutide 2.4 mg (vs. 12%-27% with placebo) and 51%-64% achieved >/=15% weight loss (vs. 5%-13% with placebo). In STEP 5, mean weight loss was -15.2% with semaglutide 2.4 mg versus -2.6% with placebo from baseline to week 104. In STEP 2 (individuals with overweight or obesity, and type 2 diabetes), mean weight loss was -9.6% with semaglutide 2.4 mg versus -3.4% with placebo from baseline to week 68. Improvements in cardiometabolic risk factors, including high blood pressure, atherogenic lipids and benefits on physical function and quality of life were seen with semaglutide 2.4 mg. The safety profile of semaglutide 2.4 mg was consistent across trials, primarily gastrointestinal adverse events. The magnitude of weight loss reported in the STEP trials offers the potential for clinically relevant improvement for individuals with obesityrelated diseases.
paragraphs.chinese: 肥胖是一种慢性、复发性疾病，常伴随多种并发症，并带来显著的发病率、死亡率及医疗负担。肥胖的药物治疗为生活 方式干预提供了宝贵的辅助手段，而单纯依靠生活方式干预往往只能实现有限的体重减轻，且难以长期维持。司美格鲁 肽治疗肥胖效果（STEP）临床试验项目正在评估每周一次皮下注射2.4 mg司美格鲁肽（一种胰高血糖素样肽-1类似物） 在超重或肥胖人群中的疗效。在STEP 1、3、4和8试验中，对于无2型糖尿病的超重或肥胖个体，从基线至第68周，2.4 mg司美格鲁肽组平均体重减轻14.9%-17.4%；69%-79%的参与者实现≥10%的体重减轻（安慰剂组为12%-27%）， 51%-64%实现≥15%的体重减轻（安慰剂组为5%-13%）。在STEP 5试验中，从基线至第104周，2.4 mg司美格鲁肽组 平均体重减轻-15.2%，安慰剂组为-2.6%。在STEP 2试验（针对超重或肥胖且患有2型糖尿病的个体）中，从基线至第 68周，2.4 mg司美格鲁肽组平均体重减轻-9.6%，安慰剂组为-3.4%。2.4 mg司美格鲁肽还改善了心血管代谢风险因 素，包括高血压、致动脉粥样硬化性血脂异常，并提升了身体功能和生活质量。各试验中2.4 mg司美格鲁肽的安全性特 征一致，主要为胃肠道不良事件。STEP试验中报告的体重减轻幅度，为肥胖相关疾病患者实现临床意义上的改善提供了 可能。

literature.title: Female fertility and pregnancy in autoimmune Addison's disease - a mini review.
literature.title_chinese: 自身免疫性艾迪生病的女性生育能力与妊娠——小型综述。

paragraphs.english: autoimmune Addison's disease (AAD) is by far the most common cause of primary adrenal insufficiency in developed countries, occurring more commonly in women compared with men. The condition is associated with a spectrum of disorders affecting fertility and reproductive health. premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) is a clinical condition defined by cessation of menstrual cycles and menopausal range gonadotrophins before the age of 40 years. This occurs with a prevalence of 1-2% in the general population, but has been estimated at 6-10% for women with AAD. One registry study demonstrated that one- third of those with AAD who develop POI, do so before the age of thirty. The onset of POI precedes or is contemporaneous with the diagnosis of AAD in the majority. It has also been demonstrated that women with AAD are more likely to use hormone replacement therapy. The pathophysiology of POI in this cohort is thought to be primarily through autoimmune mediated inflammation of the ovarian theca cells. In particular, crossreacting autoantibodies to steroidproducing cells (StCA) have been identified which are present in AAD and POI. That said, when women with POI are excluded, fertility remains significantly reduced. Impaired adrenal androgenesis and resulting sexhormone deficiency have also been implicated in subfertility in AAD. These lead to suboptimal follicular development. This, in turn, may also affect libido. Despite physiological glucocorticoid replacement therapy, patients with AAD consistently report reduced quality of life compared to matched controls. These factors may affect fecundity and likelihood of conception. Other autoimmune conditions such as hypothyroidism and type 1 diabetes occur with increased prevalence in those with AAD. These conditions have been shown to independently affect reproductive health. This review focuses on the current understanding of the factors and mechanisms impacting fertility in women with autoimmune Addison's disease.
paragraphs.chinese: 自身免疫性艾迪生病（AAD）是目前发达国家原发性肾上腺皮质功能不全的最常见病因，女性发病率高于男性。该疾病 与一系列影响生育及生殖健康的病症相关山。早发性卵巢功能不全（POI）是一种临床病症，定义为40岁前出现月经周期 停止及绝经期促性腺激素水平。该病在普通人群中的患病率为1-2%，但在AAD女性中估计达6-10%。一项登记研究显 示，合并POI的AAD患者中，三分之一在30岁前发病。多数患者的POI发病时间早于或与AAD诊断同期。研究还表明， AAD女性更可能使用激素替代疗法。该群体POI的病理生理机制主要被认为通过自身免疫介导的卵巢膜细胞炎症。特别 是，在AAD和POI中已发现针对类固醇生成细胞（StCA）的交叉反应性自身抗体。尽管如此，排除合并POI的女性后， 生育能力仍显著降低。肾上腺雄激素生成障碍及其导致的性激素缺乏也被认为与AAD患者生育力低下相关。这些因素导 致卵泡发育不良，进而可能影响性欲。尽管接受生理性糖皮质激素替代治疗，与匹配对照组相比，AAD患者始终报告生 活质量下降。这些因素可能影响生育能力及受孕概率。其他自身免疫性疾病如甲状腺功能减退症和1型糖尿病在AAD患者 中患病率升高，且已被证实可独立影响生殖健康。本综述聚焦当前对影响自身免疫性艾迪生病女性生育能力的因素及机 制的认识。

literature.topic: 原发性醛固酮增多症 (primary aldosteronism)
literature.title: Primary Aldosteronism: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline.
literature.title_chinese: 原发性醛固酮增多症：美国内分泌学会临床实践指南。
literature.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: Primary aldosteronism (PA), a primary adrenal disorder leading to excessive aldosterone production by one or both adrenal glands, is a common cause of hypertension. It is associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular complications compared with primary hypertension. Despite effective methods for diagnosing and treating PA, it remains markedly underdiagnosed and undertreated. OBJECTIVE: To develop an updated guideline that provides a practical, clinical approach to identifying and managing PA to improve diagnosis rates and encourage targeted treatment. METHODS: The Guideline Development Panel (GDP), composed of a multidisciplinary panel of clinical experts and experts in systemic review methodology, used the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) approach to define 10 questions related to the diagnosis and treatment of PA. Systematic reviews were conducted for each question. The GDP used the GRADE Evidence to Decision (EtD) framework to consider contextual factors, such as stakeholder values and preferences, costs and required resources, costeffectiveness, acceptability, feasibility, and the potential impact on health equity. RESULTS: We suggest that all individuals with hypertension be screened for PA by measuring aldosterone and renin and determining the aldosterone to renin ratio, and that subsequent clinical care be guided by the results. We suggest that individuals with PA receive PAspecific therapy, either medical or surgical. In individuals who screen positive for PA, we suggest (1) commencement of PAspecific medical therapy in individuals who do not desire or are not candidates for surgery and in situations where the probability of lateralizing PA (excess aldosterone produced by one adrenal) is low based on screening results; and (2) aldosterone suppression testing in situations when screening results indicate an intermediate probability for lateralizing PA and individualized decision making confirms a desire to pursue eligibility for surgical therapy. In those who test positive by aldosterone suppression testing, and in those in whom screening results show a high probability of lateralizing PA (obviating the need for aldosterone suppression testing), we suggest adrenal lateralization with computed tomography scanning and adrenal venous sampling prior to deciding the treatment approach (medical vs surgical). In all individuals with PA and an adrenal adenoma, we suggest performing a 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test. We suggest the use of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) over epithelial sodiumchannel (ENaC) inhibitors in the medical treatment of PA. We suggest the use of spironolactone over other MRAs, given its lower cost and greater availability; however, all MRAs, when titrated to equivalent potencies, are anticipated to have similar efficacy in treating PA. Thus, MRAs with greater mineralocorticoid receptor specificity and fewer androgen/progesterone receptormediated side effects may be preferred in some situations. In individuals receiving MRA therapy, we suggest monitoring renin and, in those whose hypertension remains uncontrolled and renin is suppressed, titrating the MRA to increase renin. CONCLUSION: These recommendations provide a practical framework for the diagnosis and treatment of PA. They are based on currently available literature and take into consideration outcomes that are important to key stakeholders. The goal is to increase identification of individuals with PA and, by initiating PAspecific medical or surgical therapy, improve blood pressure control and reduce PAassociated adverse cardiovascular events. The guidelines also highlight important knowledge gaps in PA diagnosis and management.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：原发性醛固酮增多症（PA）是一种导致单侧或双侧肾上腺过度分泌醛固酮的原发性肾上腺疾病，是高血压的常见 病因。与原发性高血压相比，PA患者发生心血管并发症的风险更高。尽管已有有效的诊断和治疗方法，但PA仍存在显著 的漏诊和治疗不足问题。目的：制定更新的临床指南，提供识别和管理PA的实用临床方法，以提高诊断率并促进靶向治 疗。方法：由多学科临床专家和系统评价方法学专家组成的指南制定小组（GDP）采用推荐分级的评估、制定与评价 （GRADE）方法，确定了10个与PA诊断和治疗相关的问题。针对每个问题进行了系统评价。GDP使用GRADE证据到决 策（EtD）框架，考虑了利益相关者的价值观和偏好、成本和所需资源、成本效益、可接受性、可行性以及对健康公平的 潜在影响等背景因素。结果：我们建议所有高血压患者通过测量醛固酮和肾素并计算醛固酮与肾素比值来筛查PA，并根 据结果指导后续临床治疗。我们建议PA患者接受针对PA的特异性治疗，包括药物或手术。对于筛查阳性的PA患者，我们 建议：（1）对于不愿手术或不适合手术的患者，以及根据筛查结果判断单侧PA（单侧肾上腺过度分泌醛固酮）可能性较 低的患者，开始PA特异性药物治疗；（2）当筛查结果显示单侧PA可能性中等，且个体化决策确认有接受手术治疗的意 愿时，进行醛固酮抑制试验。对于醛固酮抑制试验阳性者，以及筛查结果显示单侧PA可能性高（无需进行醛固酮抑制试 验）者，我们建议在决定治疗方案（药物或手术）前，通过计算机断层扫描和肾上腺静脉采血进行肾上腺侧别定位。对 于所有合并肾上腺腺瘤的PA患者，我们建议进行1mg过夜地塞米松抑制试验。在PA的药物治疗中，我们建议优先使用盐 皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA）而非上皮钠通道（ENaC）抑制剂。鉴于螺内酯成本较低且更易获得，我们建议优先使用 螺内酯而非其他MRA；然而，所有MRA在滴定至等效剂量时，预计对PA的治疗效果相似。因此，具有更高盐皮质激素 受体特异性且雄激素/孕激素受体作用较弱的MRA

literature.title: Outcomes after medical treatment for primary aldosteronism: an international consensus and analysis of treatment response in an international cohort.
literature.title_chinese: 原发性醛固酮增多症药物治疗后的结果：一项国际共识及国际队列中治疗反应的分析。

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: primary aldosteronism can be treated medically but there is no standardised method to evaluate treatment outcomes. We aimed to develop criteria for assessing the outcomes of targeted medical treatment of primary aldosteronism, analyse outcomes across an international cohort, and identify factors associated with a complete treatment response. METHODS: An international panel of 31 primary aldosteronism experts used the Delphi method to reach consensus on the definition of complete, partial, or absent biochemical and clinical outcomes of medical treatment of primary aldosteronism. Clinical data at baseline and 6-12 months posttreatment were collected from patients with primary aldosteronism who started targeted medical treatment between 2016 and 2021 at 28 participating centres. FINDINGS: consensus was reached for defining complete, partial, or absent biochemical or clinical response. Of 1258 patients (with a mean age of 52 years [SD 11.5] and of whom 610 [48.5%] were female and 648 [51.5%] were male), 1057 (84.0%) had biochemical outcome data (559 [52.9%] had a complete biochemical response). The median daily dose of spironolactone was significantly higher for those with a complete biochemical response than for those without (40 mg [IQR 25-50] vs 25 究mg [20-50]; p=0.011). Of the 1248 patients with clinical outcome data, 228 [18.3%] had a complete clinical response whereas 227 (18.2%) had an absent response. Patients with a complete clinical response were more likely than those with partial or absent clinical response to be women (OR 2.099, 95% CI 1.485-2.968; p<0.001), require lower doses of antihypertensive drugs at baseline (0.687, 0.603- 0.782; p<0.001), and were less likely to have microalbuminuria or left ventricular hypertrophy (0.584, 0.391-0.873; p=0.009). INTERPRETATION: The primary aldosteronism Medical Treatment outcome (PAMO) criteria represent an internationally developed outcome standard that can guide clinical practice and research into primary aldosteronism. Efforts to optimise treatment intensity and minimise factors associated with an absent treatment response are needed to improve patient outcomes. FUNDING: None. TRANSLATIONS: For the Chinese (simple), Chinese (complex), Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, Swedish, Slovenian, Polish, Italian and Russian translations of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：原发性醛固酮增多症可通过药物治疗，但目前缺乏标准化的疗效评估方法。本研究旨在制定评估原发性醛固酮增 多症靶向药物治疗效果的标准化标准，分析国际队列的治疗结局，并识别与完全治疗应答相关的因素。方法：由31位原 发性醛固酮增多症专家组成的国际专家组采用德尔菲法，就药物治疗后生化与临床结局的完全缓解、部分缓解及无缓解 的定义达成共识。收集2016年至2021年间在28个参与中心启动靶向药物治疗的原发性醛固酮增多症患者基线及治疗后6- 12个月的临床数据。结果：专家组就生化或临床应答的完全、部分及无缓解定义达成共识。在1258例患者（平均年龄52 岁[标准差11.5]，其中女性610例[48.5%]，男性648例[51.5%]）中，1057例（84.0%）具有生化结局数据（其中559例 [52.9%]达到完全生化应答）。完全生化应答组螺内酯中位日剂量显著高于非完全应答组（40 mg [四分位距25-50] vs 25 mg [20-50]；p=0.011）。在1248例具有临床结局数据的患者中，228例（18.3%）达到完全临床应答，而227例 （18.2%）无应答。完全临床应答患者较部分应答或无应答患者更可能为女性（OR 2.099, 95% CI 1.485-2.968; p<0.001），基线时所需降压药剂量更低（0.687, 0.603-0.782; p<0.001），且较少出现微量白蛋白尿或左心室肥厚 （0.584, 0.391-0.873; p=0.009）。结论：原发性醛固酮增多症药物治疗结局（PAMO）标准作为国际开发的结局评估 标准，可指导原发性醛固酮增多症的临床实践与研究。需优化治疗强度并减少与治疗无应答相关的因素，以改善患者预 后。资金：无。翻译：摘要的中文简体、中文繁体、日文、韩文、德文、法文、西班牙文、荷兰文、瑞典文、斯洛文尼 亚文、波兰文、意大利文及俄文翻译见补充材料部分。

literature.title: Pheochromocytoma: an updated scoping review from clinical presentation to management and treatment.
literature.title_chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤：从临床表现到管理与治疗的最新范围综述

paragraphs.english: Pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas (PPGLs) are rare neuroendocrine tumors derived from chromaffin cells, with 80- 85% originating in the adrenal medulla and 15-20% from extraadrenal chromaffin tissues (paragangliomas). Approximately 30-40% of PPGLs have a hereditary component, making them one of the most genetically predisposed tumor types. Recent advances in genetic research have classified PPGLs into three molecular clusters: pseudohypoxiarelated, kinasesignaling, and WNTsignaling pathway variants. Specifically, the detection of SDHBrelated tumors indicates an increased risk of metastatic disease, which may impact decisions regarding functional imaging in patients with high suspicion of metastasis and influence targeted treatment strategies. Diagnosis of PPGLs primarily relies on biochemical testing, measuring catecholamines or their metabolites in plasma or urine. However, molecular testing, functional imaging, and targeted therapies have greatly enhanced diagnostic precision and management. Personalized treatment approaches based on genetic profiling are becoming integral to the clinical management of these tumors. In South American countries like Colombia, functional imaging techniques such as positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) with tracers like 18FDOPA, 18Ffluorodeoxyglucose (18FFDG), and 68GaDOTAconjugated somatostatin receptortargeting peptides (68GaDOTASST) are used to guide followup and treatment strategies. radionuclide therapy with lutetium-177 DOTATATE is employed for patients showing uptake in 68GaDOTASST PET/CT scans, while access to 131-MIBG therapy remains limited due to high costs and availability. Recent clinical trials have shown promise for systemic therapies such as sunitinib and cabozantinib, offering potential new options for patients with slow or moderate progression of PPGLs. These advancements underscore the potential of personalized and targeted therapies to improve outcomes in this challenging patient population.
paragraphs.chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤（PPGLs）是源自嗜铬细胞的罕见神经内分泌肿瘤，其中80-85%起源于肾上腺髓质，15-20% 来源于肾上腺外嗜铬组织（副神经节瘤）。约30-40%的PPGLs具有遗传成分，使其成为遗传易感性最高的肿瘤类型之 一。近年遗传学研究进展将PPGLs分为三种分子簇：假缺氧相关、激酶信号通路和WNT信号通路变异。具体而言， SDHB相关肿瘤的检出提示转移性疾病风险增加，这可能影响对高度怀疑转移患者的显像策略选择，并指导靶向治疗方案 制定。PPGLs诊断主要依赖生化检测，通过测定血浆或尿液中儿茶酚胺及其代谢产物。然而分子检测、功能显像和靶向 治疗已显著提升诊断精准度与管理水平。基于基因分型的个体化治疗策略正逐步成为此类肿瘤临床管理的核心组成部 分。在哥伦比亚等南美国家，采用18F-DOPA、18F-氟代脱氧葡萄糖（18F-FDG）和68Ga-DOTA-生长抑素受体靶向肽 （68Ga-DOTA-SST）等示踪剂的正电子发射断层扫描/计算机断层扫描（PET/CT）功能显像技术，用于指导随访与治疗 决策。对68Ga-DOTA-SST PET/CT显像显示摄取的病例采用镥-177 DOTATATE放射性核素治疗，而131-MIBG治疗因成 本高昂和可及性受限应用有限。近期临床试验显示舒尼替尼和卡博替尼等全身治疗方案前景可期，为缓慢或中度进展的 PPGLs患者提供了潜在新选择。这些进展凸显了个体化靶向治疗改善这一难治性患者群体预后的巨大潜力。

literature.title: Clinical consensus guideline on the management of phaeochromocytoma and paraganglioma in patients harbouring germline SDHD pathogenic variants.
literature.title_chinese: 携带种系SDHD致病性变异患者的嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤管理临床共识指南

paragraphs.english: Patients with germline SDHD pathogenic variants (encoding succinate dehydrogenase subunit D; ie, paraganglioma 1 syndrome) are predominantly affected by head and neck paragangliomas, which, in almost 20% of patients, might coexist with paragangliomas arising from other locations (eg, adrenal medulla, paraaortic, cardiac or thoracic, and pelvic). Given the higher risk of tumour multifocality and bilaterality for phaeochromocytomas and paragangliomas (PPGLs) because of SDHD pathogenic variants than for their sporadic and other genotypic counterparts, the management of patients with SDHD PPGLs is clinically complex in terms of imaging, treatment, and management options. Furthermore, locally aggressive disease can be discovered at a young age or late in the disease course, which presents challenges in balancing surgical intervention with various medical and radiotherapeutic approaches. The axiomfirst, do no harmshould always be considered and an initial period of observation (ie, watchful waiting) is often appropriate to characterise tumour behaviour in patients with these pathogenic variants. These patients should be referred to specialised highvolume medical centres. This consensus guideline aims to help physicians with the clinical decisionmaking process when caring for patients with SDHD PPGLs.
paragraphs.chinese: 携带SDHD胚系致病性变异（编码琥珀酸脱氢酶亚基D；即副神经权节瘤1型综合征）的患者主要罹患头颈部副神经节瘤， 其中近20%的患者可能合并其他部位（如肾上腺髓质、主动脉旁、心脏或胸腔、盆腔）的副神经节瘤。由于SDHD致病 性变异导致的嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤（PPGLs）在肿侵瘤多灶性和双侧性方面的风险高于散发性及其他基因型病例，因 此SDHD PPGLs患者在影像学检查、治疗及管理方案的选择上具有临床复杂性。此外，局部侵袭性疾病可能在年轻时期 或病程晚期被发现，这给平衡手术干预与多种内科及放射治疗手段带来了挑战。应始终遵循"首要原则——不伤害"的准 则，对携带这些致病性变异的患者，初始观察期（即主动监测）通常适用于评估肿瘤行为特征。此类患者应转诊至具备 丰富经验的高容量医疗中心。本共识指南旨在帮助临床医生在管理SDHD PPGLs患者时进行临床决策。

literature.title: Cushing Syndrome, Hypercortisolism, and Glucose Homeostasis: A Review.
literature.title_chinese: 库欣综合征、高皮质醇血症与葡萄糖稳态：综述。

paragraphs.english: Until recently, the prevalence of endogenous Cushing syndrome has been considered to be low. However, improved diagnostic strategies and increased awareness have broadened our understanding of hypercortisolism and its role in the pathophysiology of type 2 diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease. Recent studies from Europe, South America, and the U.S. have demonstrated that a significant percentage of individuals with difficulttocontrol type 2 diabetes, despite treatment with multiple glucoselowering agents, have hypercortisolism as a causative factor in their poorly managed diabetes. In this review, we examine the pathophysiologic mechanisms via which excess cortisol contributes to the impairment in glucose homeostasis and recommend that hypercortisolism be added to the Ominous Octet to form the Noxious Nine as the pathophysiologic foundation for the development of type 2 diabetes. ARTICLE HIGHLIGHTS: hypercortisolism as a causative factor in the development of type 2 diabetes has received scant attention. Studies from Europe, South America, and the U.S. have demonstrated that a significant percentage of individuals with poorly managed type 2 diabetes, despite treatment with multiple glucoselowering agents, have endogenous hypersecretion of cortisol as a causative factor for their hyperglycemia. In vivo and in vitro studies in animals and humans have demonstrated that excess exposure to glucocorticoids can promote insulin resistance in muscle, liver, and adipocytes and impair insulin secretion. We propose a reverberating cycle in which hypercortisolism disrupts the normal circadian rhythm causing insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia, which in turn further disrupts the hypothalamicpituitaryadrenal axis.
paragraphs.chinese: 过去，内源性库欣综合征的患病率一直被认为较低。然侵而，诊断策略的改进和认知度的提升，拓展了我们对皮质醇增多 症及其在2型糖尿病、肥胖、高血压和心血管疾病病理生理学中作用的理解。近期来自欧洲、南美和美国的研究表明，在 尽管使用多种降糖药物治疗但仍难以控制的2型糖尿病患者中，有相当比例的患者存在皮质醇增多症，这是其血糖控制不 佳的致病因素。本综述探讨了过量皮质醇损害葡萄糖稳态的病理生理机制，并建议将皮质醇增多症纳入"致命八重奏"，形 成"有害九重奏"，作为2型糖尿病发展的病理生理基础。文章亮点：皮质醇增多症作为2型糖尿病发展的致病因素一直未 受重视。欧洲、南美和美国的研究表明，在血糖控制不佳的2型糖尿病患者中，尽管使用多种降糖药物治疗，仍有相当比 例的患者存在内源性皮质醇分泌过多，这是其高血糖的致病因素。动物和人类的体内外研究表明，过量接触糖皮质激素 可促进肌肉、肝脏和脂肪细胞的胰岛素抵抗，并损害胰岛素分泌。我们提出一个循环反馈机制：皮质醇增多症破坏正常 昼夜节律，导致胰岛素抵抗和高胰岛素血症，进而进一步扰乱下丘脑垂体肾上腺轴。

literature.title: Update on clinical characteristics in the evaluation of phaeochromocytoma and paraganglioma.
literature.title_chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤和副神经节瘤评估中临床特征的更新
literature.journal: Best practice & research. Clinical endocrinology & metabolism

paragraphs.english: Pheochromocytomas and sympathetic paragangliomas (PPGL) are rare neuroendocrine tumors originating from chromaffin tissue of the adrenal medulla and extraadrenal sympathetic paraganglia. Historically, many of these tumors were diagnosed postmortem, earning pheochromocytomas the moniker "great mimic" due to their diverse clinical manifestations that can resemble various other conditions. Over time, the clinical presentation of PPGL has evolved, with a shift from symptomatic or postmortem diagnoses to more frequent incidental discoveries or diagnoses through screening, with postmortem identification now being rare. The development of a clinical scoring system has improved the identification of patients at increased risk for PPGL. Notably, the proportion of PPGL patients with normal blood pressure ranges from 15 % to 40 %, varying based on the clinical context. Despite the tumor's reputation, PPGL is an exceedingly rare cause of resistant hypertension. Management of a pheochromocytoma crisis has advanced, with several classes of drugs available for treatment. However, PPGL during pregnancy remains a significant concern, associated with substantial maternal and fetal mortality rates. Additionally, PPGL can present as rare disorders, including catecholamineinduced cardiomyopathy, Cushing syndrome, and urinary bladder PGL. Given these varied presentations, heightened awareness and prompt recognition of PPGL are crucial for timely diagnosis and treatment, ultimately improving patient outcomes. In this article, we offer an indepth analysis of the diverse clinical presentations of PPGL, highlighting their complexity and the associated diagnostic and treatment strategies.
paragraphs.chinese: 嗜铬细胞瘤和交感神经副神经节瘤（PPGL）是起源于肾侵上腺髓质及肾上腺外交感神经副神经节嗜铬组织的罕见神经内分 泌肿瘤。历史上，许多此类肿瘤在死后才被确诊，因其临床表现多样且可模拟多种其他疾病，嗜铬细胞瘤曾被称为"伟大 的模仿者"。随着时间推移，PPGL的临床表现模式已发生演变，从症状性诊断或死后诊断转向更常见的偶然发现或筛查 诊断，死后确诊现已罕见。临床评分系统的开发提高了对PPGL高风险患者的识别能力。值得注意的是，PPGL患者中血 压正常者占比为15%至40%，具体比例因临床背景而异。尽管该肿瘤声名显赫，但PPGL作为难治性高血压病因的情况极 为罕见。嗜铬细胞瘤危象的管理已取得进展，现有多种药物可用于治疗。然而，妊娠期PPGL仍是重大隐患，与较高的母 婴死亡率相关。此外，PPGL可表现为罕见疾病，包括儿茶酚胺诱导性心肌病、库欣综合征及膀胱副神经节瘤。鉴于这些 多样化的临床表现，云提高警惕并快速识别PPGL对及时诊断和治疗至关重要，最终可改善患者预后。本文深入分析了 PPGL的多样化临床表现，强调其复杂性及相关的诊断与治疗策略。

literature.title_chinese: 欧洲内分泌学会与内分泌学会联合临床指南：糖皮质激素诱导的肾上腺功能不全的诊断与治疗。
literature.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

paragraphs.english: Glucocorticoids are widely prescribed as antiinflammatory and immunosuppressive agents. This results in at least 1% of the population using chronic glucocorticoid therapy, being at risk for glucocorticoidinduced adrenal insufficiency. This risk is dependent on the dose, duration and potency of the glucocorticoid, route of administration, and individual susceptibility. Once glucocorticoidinduced adrenal insufficiency develops or is suspected, it necessitates careful education and management of affected patients. tapering glucocorticoids can be challenging when symptoms of glucocorticoid withdrawal develop, which overlap with those of adrenal insufficiency. In general, tapering of glucocorticoids can be more rapidly within a supraphysiological range, followed by a slower taper when on physiological glucocorticoid dosing. The degree and persistence of HPA axis suppression after cessation of glucocorticoid therapy are dependent on overall exposure and recovery of adrenal function varies greatly amongst individuals. This first European Society of Endocrinology/endocrine Society joint clinical practice guideline provides guidance on this clinically relevant condition to aid clinicians involved in the care of patients on chronic glucocorticoid therapy. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 糖皮质激素被广泛用作抗炎和免疫抑制剂。这导致至少1%的人群长期接受糖皮质激素治疗，面临糖皮质激素诱导的肾上 腺功能不全的风险。该风险取决于糖皮质激素的剂量、疗程、效力权、给药途径以及个体易感性。一旦发生或怀疑糖皮质 激素诱导的肾上腺功能不全，需对受影响患者进行细致的教育和管理。当出现与肾上腺功能不全症状重叠的糖皮质激素 撤药症状时，逐步减量糖皮质激素可能具有挑战性。通侵常，在超生理剂量范围内可较快减量，而进入生理剂量后需减缓 减量速度。停用糖皮质激素后，下丘脑垂体肾上腺轴抑制的程度和持续时间取决于总体暴露量，且肾上腺功能恢复的个 体差异显著。本首部欧洲内分泌学会/美国内分泌学会联合临床实践指南针对这一临床相关问题提供指导，以协助参与长 期糖皮质激素治疗患者管理的临床医生。山

literature.title: A Contemporary Approach to the Diagnosis and Management of Adrenal Insufficiency.
literature.title_chinese: 肾上腺功能不全诊断与治疗的当代方法

paragraphs.english: adrenal insufficiency (AI) can be classified into three distinct categories based on its underlying causes: primary adrenal disorders, secondary deficiencies in adrenocorticotropin, or hypothalamic suppression from external factors, most commonly glucocorticoid medications used for antiinflammatory therapy. The hallmark clinical features of AI include fatigue, appetite loss, unintentional weight loss, low blood pressure, and hyponatremia. Individuals with primary AI additionally manifest skin hyperpigmentation, hyperkalemia, and salt craving. The diagnosis of AI is frequently delayed due to the nonspecific symptoms and signs early in the disease course, which poses a significant challenge to its early detection prior to an adrenal crisis. Despite the widespread availability of lifesaving glucocorticoid medications for decades, notable challenges persist, particularly in the domains of timely diagnosis while simultaneously avoiding misdiagnosis, patient education for averting adrenal crises, and the determination of optimal replacement therapies. This article reviews recent advancements in the contemporary diagnostic strategy and approaches to optimal treatment for AI.
paragraphs.chinese: 肾上腺功能不全（AI）可根据其根本病因分为三类：原发性肾上腺疾病、继发性促肾上腺皮质激素缺乏，或由外部因素 （最常见的是用于抗炎治疗的糖皮质激素药物）引起的下丘脑抑制。AI的典型临床特征包括疲劳、食欲减退、非自愿性 体重下降、低血压和低钠血症。原发性AI患者还会出现皮肤色素沉着、高钾血症和嗜盐症状。由于疾病早期症状和体征 缺乏特异性，AI的诊断常被延误，这给在肾上腺危象发生前实现早期发现带来了重大挑战。尽管数十年来救命性糖皮质 激素药物已广泛可及，但在及时诊断同时避免误诊、患者教育以预防肾上腺危象、以及确定最佳替代治疗方案等领域仍 存在显著挑战。本文综述了当代AI诊断策略和优化治疗方法的最新进展。

literature.title: Updates on renal phosphate transport.
literature.title_chinese: 肾磷酸盐转运的最新进展。
literature.journal: Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: The kidneys control systemic phosphate balance by regulating phosphate transporters mediating the reabsorption of inorganic phosphate (Pi). At least three different Na + -driven Pi cotransporters are located in the brush border membrane (BBM) of proximal tubule cells, NaPiIIa (SLC34A1), NaPiIIc (SLC34A3) and PiT-2 (SLC20A2). This review will discuss novel aspects of their regulation, pharmacology, and genetics. RECENT FINDINGS: Renal NaPi transporters are not only acutely regulated by the phosphaturic hormones parathyroid hormone (PTH) and Fibroblast Growth Factor 23 (FGF23) but possibly also by further mechanisms. A role of inositol hexakisphosphate (IP6) kinases has been found and their deletion from kidneys causes hypophosphatemia, hyperphosphaturia, and bone demineralization. Inhibitors of NaPis elicit phosphaturia and may reduce levels of PTH and FGF23 in chronic kidney disease (CKD) models. The relevance of renal NaPi transporters is highlighted by lossoffunction mutations in SLC34 transporters and analysis of patients provides new insights into diseases caused by variants. Major manifestations include nephrocalcinosis and -lithiasis, rickets, and variants may predispose to an accelerated decline in kidney function. SUMMARY: Renal Pi transporters are regulated, may provide novel drug targets for prevention or treatment of hyperphosphatemia, and contribute to the genetic risk to develop kidney stones and CKD.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：肾脏通过调节介导无机磷酸盐（Pi）重吸收的磷酸盐转运蛋白来控制全身磷酸盐平衡。近端肾小管细胞刷状缘 膜（BBM）上至少存在三种不同的钠离子驱动型磷酸盐协同转运蛋白：NaPi-IIa（SLC34A1）、NaPi-IIc（SLC34A3） 和PiT-2（SLC20A2）。本综述将讨论其调控、药理学和遗传学的新进展。最新发现：肾脏NaPi转运蛋白不仅受磷酸盐 调节激素甲状旁腺激素（PTH）和成纤维细胞生长因子23（FGF23）的急性调控，还可能受其他机制影响。研究发现肌 醇六磷酸（IP6）激酶的作用，其在肾脏中的缺失会导致低磷血症、高磷尿症和骨脱矿。NaPi抑制剂可引发磷尿症，并可 能降低慢性肾病（CKD）模型中PTH和FGF23的水平。SLC34转运蛋白功能缺失突变凸显了肾脏NaPi转运蛋白的重要 性，对患者的分析为变异引起的疾病提供了新见解。主要表现包括肾钙质沉着症、肾结石、佝偻病，且变异可能增加肾 功能加速下降的风险。总结：肾脏Pi转运蛋白受到调控，可能为预防或治疗高磷血症提供新的药物靶点，并构成肾结石和 CKD遗传风险因素。 梦

literature.title: Update on the Genetics of Osteogenesis Imperfecta.
literature.title_chinese: 成骨不全症遗传学的最新进展

paragraphs.english: osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) is a heterogeneous heritable skeletal dysplasia characterized by bone fragility and deformity, growth deficiency, and other secondary connective tissue defects. OI is now understood as a collagenrelated disorder caused by defects of genes whose protein products interact with collagen for folding, posttranslational modification, processing and trafficking, affecting bone mineralization and osteoblast differentiation. This review provides the latest updates on genetics of OI, including new developments in both dominant and rare OI forms, as well as the signaling pathways involved in OI pathophysiology. There is a special emphasis on discoveries of recessive mutations in TENT5A, MESD, KDELR2 and CCDC134 whose causality of OI types XIX, XX, XXI and XXI, respectively, is now established and expends the complexity of mechanisms underlying OI to overlap LRP5/6 and MAPK/ERK pathways. We also review in detail new discoveries connecting the known OI types to each other, which may underlie an eventual understanding of a final common pathway in OI cellular and bone biology.
paragraphs.chinese: 成骨不全症（OI）是一种异质性遗传性骨骼发育不良，其特征为骨脆性、骨骼畸形、生长迟缓及其他继发性结缔组织缺 陷。目前认为OI是一种胶原相关疾病，由基因缺陷引起，这些基因的蛋白产物通过与胶原蛋白相互作用参与其折叠、翻 译后修饰、加工和转运过程，进而影响骨矿化和成骨细胞分化。本综述提供了OI遗传学的最新进展，包括显性和罕见OI 类型的新发现，以及参与OI病理生理学的信号通路。特别强调了TENT5A、MESD、KDELR2和CCDC134基因隐性突变 的新发现，这些突变分别被证实导致XIX型、XX型、XXI型和XXII型OI，并将OI的机制复杂性扩展至LRP5/6和 MAPK/ERK通路的交叉重叠。我们还详细回顾了将已知OI类型相互关联的新发现，这些发现可能最终揭示OI细胞与骨生 物学中共同终末通路的基础。

literature.title: Impact of osteoporosis and osteoporosis medications on fracture healing: a narrative review.
literature.title_chinese: 骨质疏松症及骨质疏松药物对骨折愈合的影响：一项叙述性综述。

paragraphs.english: antiresorptive medications do not negatively affect fracture healing in humans. teriparatide may decrease time to fracture healing. romosozumab has not shown a beneficial effect on human fracture healing. BACKGROUND: fracture healing is a complex process. Uncertainty exists over the influence of osteoporosis and the medications used to treat it on fracture healing. METHODS: Narrative review authored by the members of the Fracture Working Group of the Committee of Scientific Advisors of the International osteoporosis Foundation (IOF), on behalf of the IOF and the Societe Internationale de Chirurgie Orthopedique et de Traumatologie (SICOT). RESULTS: fracture healing is a multistep process. Most fractures heal through a combination of intramembranous and endochondral ossification. radiographic imaging is important for evaluating fracture healing and for detecting delayed or nonunion. The presence of callus formation, bridging trabeculae, and a decrease in the size of the fracture line over time are indicative of healing. Imaging must be combined with clinical parameters and patientreported outcomes. Animal data support a negative effect of osteoporosis on fracture healing; however, clinical data do not appear to corroborate with this. Evidence does not support a delay in the initiation of antiresorptive therapy following acute fragility fractures. There is no reason for suspension of osteoporosis medication at the time of fracture if the person is already on treatment. teriparatide treatment may shorten fracture healing time at certain sites such as distal radius; however, it does not prevent nonunion or influence union rate. The positive effect on fracture healing that romosozumab has demonstrated in animals has not been observed in humans. CONCLUSION: Overall, there appears to be no deleterious effect of osteoporosis medications on fracture healing. The benefit of treating osteoporosis and the urgent necessity to mitigate imminent refracture risk after a- fracture should be given prime consideration. It is imperative that new radiological and biological markers of fracture healing be identified. It is also important to synthesize clinical and basic science methodologies to assess fracture healing, so that a convergence of the two frameworks can be achieved.
paragraphs.chinese: 抗骨吸收药物不会对人类骨折愈合产生负面影响。特立帕肽可能缩短骨折愈合时间。罗莫索单抗尚未显示出对人类骨折 愈合的有利作用。背景：骨折愈合是一个复杂的过程。骨质疏松症及其治疗药物对骨折愈合的影响尚不确定。方法：由 国际骨质疏松基金会（IOF）科学顾问委员会骨折工作组成员代表IOF和国际骨科与创伤外科学会（SICOT）撰写的叙述 性综述。结果：骨折愈合是一个多步骤过程。大多数骨折通过膜内骨化和软骨内骨化相结合的方式愈合。影像学检查对 于评估骨折愈合以及检测延迟愈合或不愈合至关重要。骨痂形成、骨小梁桥接以及骨折线随时间缩小均表明愈合。影像 学必须与临床参数和患者报告结局相结合。动物数据支持骨质疏松症对骨折愈合有负面影响；然而，临床数据似乎并未 证实这一点。证据不支持在急性脆性骨折后延迟启动抗骨吸收治疗。如果患者已在接受治疗，则没有理由在骨折时停用 骨质疏松症药物。特立帕肽治疗可能缩短某些部位（如桡骨远端）的骨折愈合时间；然而，它不能预防不愈合或影响愈 合率。罗莫索单抗在动物中表现出的对骨折愈合的积极作用尚未在人类中观察到。结论：总体而言，骨质疏松症药物似 乎对骨折愈合没有不利影响。治疗骨质疏松症的益处以及骨折后降低即刻再骨折风险的迫切性应作为首要考虑因素。必 须识别新的骨折愈合放射学和生物学标志物。同时，综合临床和基础科学方法来评估骨折愈合也很重要，以便实现两个 框架的融合。

literature.title: Pharmacologic Treatment of Primary Osteoporosis or Low Bone Mass to Prevent Fractures in Adults: A Living Clinical Guideline From the American College of Physicians.
literature.title_chinese: 成人原发性骨质疏松或低骨量的药物治疗以预防骨折：美国医师学会的活体临床指南

paragraphs.english: DESCRIPTION: This guideline updates the 2017 American College of Physicians (ACP) recommendations on pharmacologic treatment of primary osteoporosis or low bone mass to prevent fractures in adults. METHODS: The ACP Clinical Guidelines Committee based these recommendations on an updated systematic review of evidence and graded them using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) system. AUDIENCE AND PATIENT POPULATION: The audience for this guideline includes all clinicians. The patient population includes adults with primary osteoporosis or low bone mass. RECOMMENDATION 1A: ACP recommends that clinicians use bisphosphonates for initial pharmacologic treatment to reduce the risk of fractures in postmenopausal females diagnosed with primary osteoporosis (strong recommendation; highcertainty evidence). RECOMMENDATION 1B: ACP suggests that clinicians use bisphosphonates for initial pharmacologic treatment to reduce the risk of fractures in males diagnosed with primary osteoporosis (conditional recommendation; lowcertainty evidence). RECOMMENDATION 2A: ACP suggests that clinicians use the RANK ligand inhibitor (denosumab) as a secondline pharmacologic treatment to reduce the risk of fractures in postmenopausal females diagnosed with primary osteoporosis who have contraindications to or experience adverse effects of bisphosphonates (conditional recommendation; moderatecertainty evidence). RECOMMENDATION 2B: ACP suggests that clinicians use the RANK ligand inhibitor (denosumab) as a secondline pharmacologic treatment to reduce the risk of fractures in males diagnosed with primary osteoporosis who have contraindications to or experience adverse effects of bisphosphonates (conditional recommendation; lowcertainty evidence). RECOMMENDATION 3: ACP suggests that clinicians use the sclerostin inhibitor (romosozumab, moderatecertainty evidence) or recombinant PTH (teriparatide, lowcertainty evidence), followed by a bisphosphonate, to reduce the risk of fractures only in females with primary osteoporosis with very high risk of fracture (conditional recommendation). RECOMMENDATION 4: ACP suggests that clinicians take an individualized approach regarding whether to start pharmacologic treatment with a bisphosphonate in females over the age of 65 with low bone mass (osteopenia) to reduce the risk of fractures (conditional recommendation; lowcertainty evidence).
paragraphs.chinese: 描述：本指南更新了2017年美国内科医师学会（ACP）关于原发性骨质疏松症或低骨量成人骨折预防的药物治疗建议。 方法：ACP临床指南委员会基于最新系统证据综述制定建议，并采用GRADE（建议评估、制定与分级系统）进行分级。 受众与患者群体：本指南受众为全体临床医生，患者群体包括原发性骨质疏松症或低骨量成人。建议1A：ACP推荐临床 医生使用双膦酸盐类药物作为初始药物治疗，以降低确诊原发性骨质疏松症的绝经后女性骨折风险（强推荐；高确定性 证据）。建议1B：ACP建议临床医生使用双膦酸盐类药物作为初始药物治疗，以降低确诊原发性骨质疏松症的男性骨折 风险（条件性推荐；低确定性证据）。建议2A：ACP建议临床医生对存在双膦酸盐禁忌症或不良反应的确诊原发性骨质 疏松症绝经后女性，使用RANK配体抑制剂（地舒单抗）作为二线药物治疗以降低骨折风险（条件性推荐；中等确定性证 据）。建议2B：ACP建议临床医生对存在双膦酸盐禁忌症或不良反应的确诊原发性骨质疏松症男性，使用RANK配体抑 制剂（地舒单抗）作为二线药物治疗以降低骨折风险（条件性推荐；低确定性证据）。建议3：ACP建议临床医生仅对骨 折风险极高的原发性骨质疏松症女性，使用硬骨抑素抑制剂（罗莫索单抗，中等确定性证据）或重组甲状旁腺激素（特 立帕肽，低确定性证据）后序贯双膦酸盐治疗以降低骨折风险（条件性推荐）。建议4：ACP建议临床医生对65岁以上低 骨量（骨量减少）女性，采取个体化决策是否启动双膦酸盐药物治疗以降低骨折风险（条件性推荐；低确定性证据）。

literature.title: Recent advances in fibroblast growth factor 23-related hypophosphatemic disorders.
literature.title_chinese: 成纤维细胞生长因子23相关低磷血症疾病的最新进展。
literature.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

paragraphs.english: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) is a hormone to reduce blood phosphate concentration. Excessive actions of FGF23 induce FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders, such as Xlinked hypophosphatemic rickets (XLH) and tumorinduced osteomalacia (TIO). We will summarize recent advances in the diagnosis and treatment of FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders. RECENT FINDINGS: The measurement of blood FGF23 is useful to make a diagnosis of FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders. It was reported that many patients with FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders, especially TIO, were misdiagnosed, therefore, it is necessary to enhance the awareness of these diseases. A novel method to inhibit excessive actions of FGF23 by a human monoclonal antibody for FGF23, burosumab, has been approved in several countries. In more longterm observation than clinical trials, burosumab has also been shown to improve biochemical abnormalities and symptoms of rickets/osteomalacia. Following these advances, several registries and consensus recommendations on FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders, especially XLH, have been established in each country or region. SUMMARY: Further longterm effects of burosumab and the precise mechanism of FGF23 overproduction in patients with FGF23-related hypophosphatemic disorders need to be clarified in the future studies.
paragraphs.chinese: 综述目的：成纤维细胞生长因子23（FGF23）是一种降低血磷浓度的激素。FGF23过度作用可导致FGF23相关性低磷血 症性疾病，如X连锁低磷性佝偻病（XLH）和肿瘤性骨软化症（TIO）。本文将总结FGF23相关性低磷血症性疾病诊断与 治疗的最新进展。最新发现：血液FGF23检测有助于诊断FGF23相关性低磷血症性疾病。研究报道许多FGF23相关性低 磷血症性疾病患者（尤其是TIO患者）曾被误诊，因此需提高对此类疾病的认识。通过人源化FGF23单克隆抗体布洛索单 抗抑制FGF23过度作用的新方法已在多国获批。相较于临床试验，更长期的观察显示布洛索单抗可改善生化异常及佝偻 病/骨软化症症状。基于这些进展，各国或地区已建立针对FGF23相关性低磷血症性疾病（尤其是XLH）的登记系统和共 识建议。总结：布洛索单抗的远期疗效及山FGF23相关性低磷血症性疾病患者FGF23过度产生的精确机制仍需未来研究阐 明。

literature.title: Endotheliumspecific depletion of LRP1 improves glucose homeostasis through inducing osteocalcin
literature.title_chinese: LRP1的内皮特异性缺失通过诱导骨钙素改善葡萄糖稳态

paragraphs.english: AbstractThe vascular endothelium is present within metabolic organs and actively regulates energy metabolism. Here we show osteocalcin, recognized as a bonesecreted metabolic hormone, is expressed in mouse primary endothelial cells isolated from heart, lung and liver. In human osteocalcin promoterdriven green fluorescent protein transgenic mice, green fluorescent protein signals are enriched in endothelial cells lining aorta, small vessels and capillaries and abundant in aorta, skeletal muscle and eye of adult mice. The depletion of lipoprotein receptorrelated protein 1 induces osteocalcin through a Forkhead box O -dependent pathway in endothelial cells. Whereas depletion of osteocalcin abolishes the glucoselowering effect of lowdensity lipoprotein receptorrelated protein 1 depletion, osteocalcin treatment normalizes hyperglycemia in multiple mouse models. Mechanistically, osteocalcin receptorG proteincoupled receptor family C group 6 member A and insulinlikegrowthfactor-1 receptor are in the same complex with osteocalcin and required for osteocalcinpromoted insulin signaling pathway. Therefore, our results reveal an endocrine/paracrine role of endothelial cells in regulating insulin sensitivity, which may have therapeutic implications in treating diabetes and insulin resistance through manipulating vascular endothelium. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要血管内皮存在于代谢器官中，并积极调节能量代谢。本文显示，骨钙素作为一种已知的骨源性代谢激素，在小鼠心 脏、肺和肝脏分离的原代内皮细胞中表达。在人类骨钙素启动子驱动的绿色荧光蛋白转基因小鼠中，绿色荧光蛋白信号 富集于主动脉、小血管和毛细血管的内皮细胞，并在成年小鼠的主动脉、骨骼肌和眼睛中大量存在。脂蛋白受体相关蛋 白1的缺失通过Forkhead box O依赖途径诱导内皮细胞侵中的骨钙素表达。虽然骨钙素的缺失消除了低密度脂蛋白受体相 关蛋白1缺失的降糖效应，但骨钙素处理在多种小鼠模型中使高血糖恢复正常。机制上，骨钙素受体-G蛋白偶联受体家族 C组6成员A和胰岛素样生长因子-1受体与骨钙素处于同一复合物中，并且是骨钙素促进胰岛素信号通路所必需的。因 此，我们的研究结果揭示了内皮细胞在调节胰岛素敏感性中的内分泌/旁分泌作用，这可能为通过调控血管内皮治疗糖尿 病和胰岛素抵抗提供治疗意义。

literature.title: The role of osteocalcin in human glucose metabolism: Marker or mediator?
literature.title_chinese: 骨钙素在人体葡萄糖代谢中的作用：标记物还是中介物？

paragraphs.english: Increasing evidence supports an association between the skeleton and energy metabolism. These interactions are mediated by a variety of hormones, cytokines and nutrients. Here, the evidence for a role of osteocalcin in the regulation of glucose metabolism in humans is reviewed. osteocalcin is a bone matrix protein that regulates hydroxyapatite size and shape through its vitaminKdependent, γ-carboxylated form. The concentration of osteocalcin in the circulation is a measure of bone formation. The undercarboxylated form of osteocalcin is active in glucose metabolism in mice. Total serum osteocalcin concentrations in humans are inversely associated with measures of glucose metabolism; however, human data are inconclusive with regard to the role of uncarboxylated osteocalcin in glucose metabolism because most studies do not account for the influence of vitamin K on the proportion of undercarboxylated osteocalcin or differentiate between the total and uncarboxylated forms of osteocalcin. Furthermore, most human studies do not concomitantly measure other bone turnover markers to isolate the role of osteocalcin as a measure of bone formation from its effect on glucose metabolism. Carefully designed studies are required to define the role of osteocalcin and its carboxylated or undercarboxylated forms in the regulation of glucose metabolism in humans. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 越来越多的证据支持骨骼与能量代谢之间存在关联，这些相互作用由多种激素、细胞因子和营养物质介导。本文综述了 骨钙素在调节人体葡萄糖代谢中作用的证据。骨钙素是一种骨基质蛋白，通过其依赖维生素K的γ-羧化形式调节羟基磷灰 石的大小和形状。循环中骨钙素的浓度是衡量骨形成的指标。在小鼠中，未羧化形式的骨钙素在葡萄糖代谢中具有活 性。人体血清总骨钙素浓度与葡萄糖代谢指标呈负相关侵；然而，关于未羧化骨钙素在葡萄糖代谢中的作用，人类数据尚 无定论，因为大多数研究未考虑维生素K对未羧化骨钙素比例的影响，也未区分骨钙素的总形式和未羧化形式。此外，大 多数人类研究未同时测量其他骨转换标志物，以将骨钙素作为骨形成指标的作用与其对葡萄糖代谢的影响区分开来。需 要精心设计的研究来明确骨钙素及其羧化或未羧化形式在调节人体葡萄糖代谢中的作用。

literature.title: Endocrine toxicities of immune checkpoint inhibitors
literature.title_chinese: 免疫检查点抑制剂的内分泌毒性

paragraphs.english: immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are monoclonal antibodies that target two key signalling pathways related to T cell activation and exhaustion, by binding to and inhibiting cytotoxic T lymphocyte antigen 4 (CTLA4) or PD1 and its ligand PDL1. ICIs, such as nivolumab, pembrolizumab and ipilimumab, are approved for the treatment of numerous and diverse cancer types, in various combination regimens, and are now an established cornerstone of cancer therapeutics. Toxicities induced by ICIs are autoimmune in nature and are referred to as immunerelated adverse events (irAEs); these events can affect any organ system in an unpredictable fashion. Importantly, irAEs can manifest as endocrinopathies involving the thyroid (hypothyroidism or thyrotoxicosis), pituitary (hypophysitis), adrenal glands (adrenal insufficiency) and pancreas (diabetes mellitus). These events are a frequent source of acute and persistent morbidity in patients treated with ICIs and can even be fatal. Over the past few years, there has been a growing understanding of the underlying pathogenesis of irAEs that has led to the development of more effective management strategies. Herein, we review the current understanding of the pathobiology, clinical manifestations and treatment approaches to endocrine toxicities arising from ICIs.
paragraphs.chinese: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）是一类单克隆抗体，通过结合并抑制细胞毒性T淋巴细胞抗原4（CTLA4）或PD1及其配体 PDL1，靶向与T细胞活化和耗竭相关的两个关键信号通路。诸如纳武利尤单抗、帕博利珠单抗和伊匹木单抗等ICIs已获批 用于治疗多种不同类型的癌症，并采用多种联合治疗方案，现已成为癌症治疗的基石。ICIs引发的毒性本质上是自身免疫 性的，被称为免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）；这些事件可能以不可预测的方式影响任何器官系统。重要的是，irAEs可表现 为累及甲状腺（甲状腺功能减退或甲状腺毒症）、垂体（垂体炎）、肾上腺（肾上腺功能不全）和胰腺（糖尿病）的内 分泌疾病。这些事件是接受ICIs治疗患者急性和持续性发病的常见原因，甚至可能致命。过去几年中，人们对irAEs的潜 在发病机制有了越来越深入的了解，从而制定了更有效的管理策略。在此，我们综述了目前对ICIs引起的内分泌毒性的病 理生物学、临床表现和治疗方法的理解。

literature.title: Hypopituitarism
literature.title_chinese: 垂体功能减退症

paragraphs.english: Partial or complete deficiency of anterior or posterior pituitary hormone production leads to central hypoadrenalism, central hypothyroidism, hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, growth hormone deficiency, or arginine vasopressin deficiency depending on the hormones affected. hypopituitarism is rare and likely to be underdiagnosed, with an unknown but rising incidence and prevalence. The most common cause is compressive growth or ablation of a pituitary or hypothalamic mass. Less common causes include genetic mutations, hypophysitis (especially in the context of cancer immunotherapy), infiltrative and infectious disease, and traumatic brain injury. Clinical features vary with timing of onset, cause, and number of pituitary axes disrupted. Diagnosis requires measurement of basal circulating hormone concentrations and confirmatory hormone stimulation testing as needed. Treatment is aimed at replacement of deficient hormones. Increased mortality might persist despite treatment, particularly in younger patients, females, and those with arginine vasopressin deficiency. Patients with complex diagnoses, pregnant patients, and adolescent pituitarydeficient patients transitioning to adulthood should ideally be managed at a pituitary tumour centre of excellence.
paragraphs.chinese: 垂体前叶或后叶激素的部分或完全缺乏，根据受影响激素的不同，可导致中枢性肾上腺功能减退、中枢性甲状腺功能减 退、低促性腺激素性性腺功能减退、生长激素缺乏或精氨酸加压素缺乏。垂体功能减退症较为罕见，且可能存在诊断不 足的情况，其发病率和患病率虽不明确但呈上升趋势。最常见的原因是垂体或下丘脑占位性病变的压迫性生长或切除。 较少见的原因包括基因突变、垂体炎（尤其在癌症免疫治疗背景下）、浸润性和感染性疾病以及创伤性脑损伤。临床表 现因发病时间、病因及受累垂体轴的数量而异。诊断需测量基础循环激素浓度，并根据需要进行激素激发试验确认。治 疗旨在替代缺乏的激素。尽管接受治疗，死亡率仍可能持续升高，尤其是在年轻患者、女性患者及精氨酸加压素缺乏患 者中。对于诊断复杂的患者、妊娠期患者以及从青春期过渡至成年期的垂体功能减退青少年患者，理想情况下应在垂体 肿瘤卓越中心进行管理。

literature.title: Pangenomic classification of pituitary neuroendocrine tumors
literature.title_chinese: 垂体神经内分泌肿瘤的全基因组分类

paragraphs.english: Pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (PitNETs) are common, with five main histological subtypes: lactotroph, somatotroph, and thyrotroph (POU1F1/PIT1 lineage); corticotroph (TBX19/TPIT lineage); and gonadotroph (NR5A1/SF1 lineage). We report a comprehensive pangenomic classification of PitNETs. PitNETs from POU1F1/PIT1 lineage showed an epigenetic signature of diffuse DNA hypomethylation, with transposable elements expression and chromosomal instability (except for GNAS- mutated somatotrophs). In TPIT lineage, corticotrophs were divided into three classes: the USP8-mutated with overt secretion, the USP8-wildtype with increased invasiveness and increased epithelialmesenchymal transition, and the large silent tumors with gonadotroph transdifferentiation. Unexpected expression of gonadotroph markers was also found in GNASwildtype somatotrophs (SF1 expression), challenging the current definition of SF1/gonadotroph lineage. This classification improves our understanding and affects the clinical stratification of patients with PitNETs.
paragraphs.chinese: 垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNETs）较为常见，主要有五种组织学亚型：泌乳素细胞瘤、生长激素细胞瘤和促甲状腺激素细 胞瘤（POU1F1/PIT1谱系）；促肾上腺皮质激素细胞瘤（TBX19/TPIT谱系）；以及促性腺激素细胞瘤（NR5A1/SF1谱 系）。我们报告了PitNETs的全面泛基因组分类。来自POU1F1/PIT1谱系的PitNETs表现出弥漫性DNA低甲基化的表观遗 传特征，伴有转座元件表达和染色体不稳定性（GNAS突变的生长激素细胞瘤除外）。在TPIT谱系中，促肾上腺皮质激 素细胞瘤被分为三类：USP8突变型伴有明显分泌功能，USP8野生型侵袭性增强且上皮间质转化增加，以及大型无功能 肿瘤伴有促性腺激素细胞转分化。在GNAS野生型生长激素细胞瘤中也意外发现了促性腺激素标志物的表达（SF1表 达），这对当前SF1/促性腺激素谱系的定义提出了挑战。这一分类提高了我们对PitNETs的理解，并影响了患者的临床分 层。

literature.title: Singlecell and spatial transcriptome analyses reveal tumor heterogeneity and immune remodeling involved in pituitary neuroendocrine tumor progression
literature.title_chinese: 单细胞与空间转录组分析揭示垂体神经内分泌肿瘤进展中的肿瘤异质性与免疫重塑

paragraphs.english: Pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (PitNETs) can be invasive or aggressive, yet the mechanisms behind these behaviors remain poorly understood, impeding treatment advancements. Here, we integrat singlecell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics, analyzing over 177,000 cells and 35,000 spots across 57 tissue samples. This comprehensive approach facilitates the identification of PitNETs tumor populations and characterizes the reconfiguration of the tumor microenvironment (TME) as PitNETs progress and invade. We trace the trajectory of TPITlineage PitNETs and identify an aggressive tumor cluster marked by elevated p53-mediated proliferation and a higher Trouillas classification, both associated with tumor progression. Additionally, we document the heterogeneity of immune stromal cells within PitNETs, particularly noting the enrichment of SPP1+ tumor associated macrophages (TAMs) in invasive tumors. These TAMs facilitate tumor invasion through the SPP1-ITGAV/ITGB1 signaling pathway. Our indepth singlecell and spatial analysis of PitNETs uncovers the molecular dynamics within the TME, suggesting potential targets for therapeutic intervention.
paragraphs.chinese: 垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNETs）可能具有侵袭性或侵袭性，但这些行为背后必的机制仍知之甚少，阻碍了治疗进展。本研 究整合单细胞RNA测序与空间转录组学技术，分析了57个组织样本中超过17.7万个细胞和3.5万个位点。这种综合方法有 助于识别PitNETs肿瘤群体，并描述肿瘤微环境（TME）在PitNET权s进展和侵袭过程中的重构特征。我们追踪了TPIT谱系 PitNETs的发展轨迹，发现一个以p53介导的增殖增强和更高Trouillas分级为标志的侵袭性肿瘤簇，这两者均与肿瘤进展 相关。此外，我们记录了PitNETs内免疫基质细胞的异侵质性，特别注意到在侵袭性肿瘤中SPP1+肿瘤相关巨噬细胞 （TAMs）的富集。这些TAMs通过SPP1-ITGAV/ITGB1信号通路促进肿瘤侵袭。我们对PitNETs的深入单细胞及空间分析 揭示了TME内的分子动态，为治疗干预提供了潜在靶点。

literature.title: Novel genetic causes of pituitary adenomas
literature.title_chinese: 垂体腺瘤的新遗传原因

paragraphs.english: Recently, a number of novel genetic alterations have been identified that predispose individuals to pituitary adenomas. Clinically relevant pituitary adenomas are relatively common, present in 0.1% of the general population. They are mostly benign monoclonal neoplasms that arise from any of the five hormonesecreting cell types of the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland, and cause disease due to hormonal alterations and local spaceoccupying effects. The pathomechanism of pituitary adenomas includes alterations in cellcycle regulation and growth factor signaling, which are mostly due to epigenetic changes; somatic and especially germline mutations occur more rarely. A significant proportion of growth hormone- and adrenocorticotrophinsecreting adenomas have activating somatic mutations in the GNAS and USP8 genes, respectively. Rarely, germline mutations predispose to pituitary tumorigenesis, often in a familial setting. Classical tumor predisposition syndromes include multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN1) and type 4 (MEN4) syndromes, Carney complex, and McCuneAlbright syndrome. Pituitary tumors have also been described in association with neurofibromatosis type 1, DICER1 syndrome, and SDHx mutations. Pituitary adenomas with no other associated tumors have been described as familial isolated pituitary adenomas. Patients with AIP or GPR101 mutations often present with pituitary gigantism either in a familial or simplex setting. GNAS and GPR101 mutations that arise in early embryonic age can lead to somatic mosaicism involving the pituitary gland and resulting in growth hormone excess. senescence has been suggested as the key mechanism protecting pituitary adenomas turning malignant in the overwhelming majority of cases. Here we briefly summarize the genetic background of pituitary adenomas, with an emphasis on the recent developments in this field. Clin Cancer Res; 22(20); 5030-42. ©2016 AACR SEE ALL ARTICLES IN THIS CCR FOCUS SECTION, "ENDOCRINE CANCERS REVISING PARADIGMS".
paragraphs.chinese: 近期研究发现多种新型基因变异可增加垂体腺瘤的易感性。具有临床意义的垂体腺瘤较为常见，在普通人群中发病率为 0.1%。这类肿瘤多为良性单克隆新生物，山源自垂体前叶五种激素分泌细胞中的任意一种，通过激素异常分泌及局部占位 效应引发疾病。其病理机制涉及细胞周期调控与生长因子信号通路的改变，主要源于表观遗传学变化，体细胞突变尤其 是胚系突变较为罕见。在生长激素和促肾上腺皮质激素分泌型腺瘤中，分别存在较高比例的GNAS和USP8基因激活突 变。胚系突变虽罕见，但常以家族性形式诱发垂体肿瘤发生。经典肿瘤易感综合征包括多发性内分泌腺瘤病1型 （MEN1）和4型（云MEN4）、Carney综合征及McCune-Albright综合征。此外，垂体肿瘤还与神经纤维瘤病1型、 DICER1综合征及SDHx基因突变相关。不伴其他肿瘤的垂体腺瘤被定义为家族性孤立性垂体腺瘤。携带AIP或GPR101基 因突变的患者常表现为家族性或散发性垂体性巨人症。胚胎早期发生的GNAS和GPR101突变可导致累及垂体的体细胞嵌 合体，进而引发生长激素过量。研究提示细胞衰老是绝大多数垂体腺瘤避免恶性转化的关键保护机制。本文简要综述垂 体腺瘤的遗传背景，重点阐述该领域最新研究进展。Clin Cancer Res; 22(20); 5030-42. ©2016 AACR 详见本刊CCR焦 点栏目"内分泌肿瘤：范式重构"全部文章。

literature.title: Diagnosis and management of pituitary adenomas
literature.title_chinese: 垂体腺瘤的诊断与治疗

paragraphs.english: ImportancePituitary adenomas are neoplasms of the pituitary adenohypophyseal cell lineage and include functioning tumors, characterized by the secretion of pituitary hormones, and nonfunctioning tumors. Clinically evident pituitary adenomas occur in approximately 1 in 1100 persons.ObservationsPituitary adenomas are classified as either macroadenomas (≥10 mm) (48% of tumors) or microadenomas (&lt;10 mm). Macroadenomas may cause mass effect, such as visual field defects, headache, and/or hypopituitarism, which occur in about 18% to 78%, 17% to 75%, and 34% to 89% of patients, respectively. Thirty percent of pituitary adenomas are nonfunctioning adenomas, which do not produce hormones. Functioning tumors are those that produce an excess of normally produced hormones and include prolactinomas, somatotropinomas, corticotropinomas, and thyrotropinomas, which produce prolactin, growth hormone, corticotropin, and thyrotropin, respectively. Approximately 53% of pituitary adenomas are prolactinomas, which can cause hypogonadism, infertility, and/or galactorrhea. Twelve percent are somatotropinomas, which cause acromegaly in adults and gigantism in children, and 4% are corticotropinomas, which secrete corticotropin autonomously, resulting in hypercortisolemia and Cushing disease. All patients with pituitary tumors require endocrine evaluation for hormone hypersecretion. Patients with macroadenomas additionally require evaluation for hypopituitarism, and patients with tumors compressing the optic chiasm should be referred to an ophthalmologist for formal visual field testing. For those requiring treatment, firstline therapy is usually transsphenoidal pituitary surgery, except for prolactinomas, for which medical therapy, either bromocriptine or cabergoline, is usually first line.Conclusions and RelevanceClinically manifest pituitary adenomas affect approximately 1 in 1100 people and can be complicated by syndromes of hormone excess as well as 权visual field defects and hypopituitarism from mass effect in larger tumors. Firstline therapy for prolactinomas consists of bromocriptine or cabergoline, and transsphenoidal pituitary surgery is firstline therapy for other pituitary adenomas requiring treatment.
paragraphs.chinese: 重要性：垂体腺瘤是垂体腺垂体细胞谱系的肿瘤，包括功能性肿瘤（以分泌垂体激素为特征）和非功能性肿瘤。临床上 明显的垂体腺瘤发生率约为每1100人中1例。观察结果：垂体腺瘤分为大腺瘤（≥10毫米）（占肿瘤的48%）和微腺瘤 （<10毫米）。大腺瘤可能引起占位效应，如视野缺损、头痛和/或垂体功能减退，这些症状分别出现在约18%至78%、 17%至75%和34%至89%的患者中。30%的垂体腺瘤为非功能性腺瘤，不产生激素。功能性肿瘤则过量分泌正常产生的 激素，包括泌乳素瘤云、生长激素瘤、促肾上腺皮质激素瘤和促甲状腺激素瘤，分别分泌泌乳素、生长激素、促肾上腺皮 质激素和促甲状腺激素。约53%的垂体腺瘤为泌乳素瘤，可能导致性腺功能减退、不孕和/或溢乳。12%为生长激素瘤， 在成人中引起肢端肥大症，在儿童中引起巨人症；4%为促肾上腺皮质激素瘤，自主分泌促肾上腺皮质激素，导致高皮质 醇血症和库欣病。所有垂体肿瘤患者均需进行内分泌评估以检测激素分泌是否过量。大腺瘤患者还需评估垂体功能减退 情况，而肿瘤压迫视交叉的患者应转诊至眼科医生进行正式视野检查。对于需要治疗的患者，除泌乳素瘤外，一线治疗 通常为经蝶垂体手术；泌乳素瘤的一线治疗通常为药物治疗，即溴隐亭或卡麦角林。结论与相关性：临床上明显的垂体 腺瘤影响约每1100人中的1例，可能并发激素过量综合征，以及较大肿瘤占位效应引起的视野缺损和垂体功能减退。泌 乳素瘤的一线治疗包括溴隐亭或卡麦角林，而其他需要治疗的垂体腺瘤的一线治疗为经蝶垂体手术。

literature.title: Current management of cushing's disease
literature.title_chinese: 库欣病的当前管理

paragraphs.english: AbstractCushing's disease (CD) is caused by a pituitary tumour that secretes adrenocorticotropin (ACTH) autonomously, leading to excess cortisol secretion from the adrenal glands. The condition is associated with increased morbidity and mortality that can be mitigated by treatments that result in sustained endocrine remission. transsphenoidal pituitary surgery (TSS) remains the mainstay of treatment for CD but requires considerable neurosurgical expertise and experience in order to optimize patient outcomes. Up to 90% of patients with microadenomas (tumour below 1 cm in largest diameter) and 65% of patients with macroadenomas (tumour at or above 1 cm in greatest diameter) achieve endocrine remission after TSS by an experienced surgeon. Patients who are not in remission postoperatively or those who relapse may benefit from undergoing a second pituitary operation. Alternatively, radiation therapy to the sella with interim medical therapy, or bilateral adrenalectomy, can be effective as definitive treatments of CD. Medical therapy is currently adjunctive in most patients with CD and is generally prescribed to patients who are about to receive radiation therapy and will be awaiting its salutary effects to occur. Available treatment options include steroidogenesis inhibitors, centrally acting agents and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. Several novel agents are in clinical trials and may eventually constitute additional treatment options for this serious condition.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要库欣病（CD）是由垂体肿瘤自主分泌促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）引起，导致肾上腺皮质醇分泌过量。该疾病与发 病率和死亡率增加相关，通过实现持续内分泌缓解的治疗可减轻这些风险。经蝶垂体手术（TSS）仍是CD的主要治疗方 法，但需要丰富的神经外科专业知识和经验以优化患者预后。在经验丰富的外科医生操作下，高达90%的微腺瘤（最大 直径小于1厘米的肿瘤）患者和65%的大腺瘤（最大直径等于或大于1厘米的肿瘤）患者在接受TSS后能达到内分泌缓 解。术后未缓解或复发的患者可能受益于第二次垂体手术。此外，针对蝶鞍区的放射治疗配合过渡期药物治疗，或双侧 肾上腺切除术，均可作为CD的有效根治性治疗方案。目前药物治疗对大多数CD患者而言属于辅助手段，通常适用于即将 接受放射治疗并等待其有益效果显现的患者。现有治疗选择包括类固醇生成抑制剂、中枢作用药物和糖皮质激素受体拮 抗剂。若干新型药物正处于临床试验阶段，未来可能为这一严重疾病提供更多治疗选择。

literature.title: Proteogenomic landscape and clinical characterization of GHproducing pituitary adenomas/somatotroph pituitary neuroendocrine tumors
literature.title_chinese: 生长激素分泌型垂体腺瘤/生长激素垂体神经内分泌肿瘤的蛋白质基因组学图谱与临床特征

paragraphs.english: AbstractThe clinical characteristics of growth hormone (GH)-producing pituitary adenomas/somatotroph pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (GHomas/somatotroph PitNETs) vary across patients. In this study, we aimed to integrate the genetic alterations, protein expression profiles, transcriptomes, and clinical characteristics of GHomas/somatotroph PitNETs to identify molecules associated with acromegaly characteristics. Targeted capture sequencing and copy number analysis of 36 genes and nontargeted proteomics analysis were performed on freshfrozen samples from 121 sporadic GHomas/somatotroph PitNETs. Targeted capture sequencing revealed GNAS as the only driver gene, as previously reported. Classification by consensus clustering using both RNA sequencing and proteomics revealed many similarities between the proteome and the transcriptome. gene ontology analysis was performed for differentially expressed proteins between wild- type and mutant GNAS samples identified by nontargeted proteomics and involved in G protein–coupled receptor (GPCR) pathways. The results suggested that GNAS mutations impact endocrinological features in acromegaly through GPCR pathway induction. ATP2A2 and ARID5B correlated with the GH change rate in the octreotide loading test, and WWC3, SERINC1, and ZFAND3 correlated with the tumor volume change rate after somatostatin analog treatment. These results identified a biological connection between GNAS mutations and the clinical and biochemical characteristics of acromegaly, revealing molecules associated with acromegaly that may affect medical treatment efficacy.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要生长激素（GH）分泌型垂体腺瘤/生长激素细胞垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（GHomas/somatotroph PitNETs）的临床特 征因患者而异。本研究旨在整合GHomas/somatotrop侵h PitNETs的基因变异、蛋白表达谱、转录组及临床特征，以识别 与肢端肥大症特征相关的分子。我们对121例散发性GHomas/somatotroph PitNETs的新鲜冷冻样本进行了36个基因的 靶向捕获测序与拷贝数分析，以及非靶向蛋白质组学分析。靶向捕获测序结果显示，正如先前报道，GNAS是唯一的驱动 基因。通过RNA测序和蛋白质组学的共识聚类分类显示，蛋白质组与转录组之间存在高度相似性。针对非靶向蛋白质组 学鉴定的野生型与突变型GNAS样本间差异表达蛋白进行了基因本体分析，这些蛋白参与G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）通 路。结果表明，GNAS突变通过诱导GPCR通路影响肢端肥大症的内分泌特征。ATP2A2和ARID5B与奥曲肽负荷试验中的 GH变化率相关，而WWC3、SERINC1和ZFAND3与生长抑素类似物治疗后的肿瘤体积变化率相关。这些结果揭示了 GNAS突变与肢端肥大症临床及生化特征之间的生物学联系，并识别出可能影响药物治疗效果的肢端肥大症相关分子。

literature.title: Growth hormone deficiency: Health and longevity
literature.title_chinese: 生长激素缺乏症：健康与长寿

paragraphs.english: AbstractThe important role of GH in the control of mammalian longevity was first deduced from extended longevity of mice with genetic GH deficiency (GHD) or GH resistance. Mice with isolated GHD (IGHD) due to GHRH or GHRH receptor mutations, combined deficiency of GH, prolactin, and TSH, or global deletion of GH receptors live longer than do their normal siblings. They also exhibit multiple features of delayed and/or slower aging, accompanied by extension of healthspan. The unexpected, remarkable longevity benefit of severe endocrine defects in these animals presumably represents evolutionarily conserved tradeoffs among aging, growth, maturation, fecundity, and the underlying anabolic processes. Importantly, the negative association of GH signaling with longevity extends to other mammalian species, apparently including humans. Data obtained in humans with IGHD type 1B, owing to a mutation of the GHRH receptor gene, in the Itabaianinha County, Brazil, provide a unique opportunity to study the impact of severe reduction in GH signaling on agerelated characteristics, health, and functionality. Individuals with IGHD are characterized by proportional short stature, doll facies, highpitched voices, and central obesity. They have delayed puberty but are fertile and generally healthy. Moreover, these IGHD individuals are partially protected from cancer and some of the common effects of aging and can attain extreme longevity, 103 years of age in one case. We think that low, but detectable, residual GH secretion combined with lifelong reduction of circulating IGF-1 and with some tissue levels of IGF-1 and/or IGF-2 preserved may account for the normal longevity and apparent extension of healthspan in these individuals.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要：生长激素（GH）在调控哺乳动物寿命中的重要作用，最初是从遗传性GH缺乏（GHD）或GH抵抗小鼠寿命延长现 象中推断出来的。由于GHRH或GHRH受体突变导致孤立性GHD（IGHD）、GH/催乳素/TSH联合缺乏或GH受体整体缺 失的小鼠，其寿命均超过正常同窝小鼠。这些小鼠还表现出多种衰老延迟和/或减缓的特征，并伴随着健康寿命的延长。 这些动物因严重内分泌缺陷带来的意外显著长寿效应，可能反映了进化过程中衰老、生长、成熟、繁殖力及合成代谢过 程之间的权衡机制。重要的是，GH信号与寿命的负相关关系在其他哺乳动物乃至人类中同样存在。巴西伊塔巴亚尼尼亚 县因GHRH受体基因突变导致的1B型IGHD人群，为研究GH信号严重减弱对年龄相关特征、健康状况及功能的影响提供 了独特样本。IGHD个体具有比例匀称的矮小身材、娃娃面容、高频嗓音和中心性肥胖特征。他们青春期延迟但具备生育 能力且总体健康。值得注意的是，这些IGHD人群对癌症和某些常见衰老效应具有部分抵抗力，其中一例甚至达到103岁 极端长寿。我们认为云，持续可检测的低水平残余GH分泌、伴随终生的循环IGF-1水平降低，以及部分组织中保留的IGF-1 和/或IGF-2水平，可能共同促成了这些个体的正常寿命及显著延长的健康生存期。

literature.title: Acromegaly: Pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management
literature.title_chinese: 肢端肥大症：发病机制、诊断与治疗

paragraphs.english: growth hormonesecreting pituitary adenomas that cause acromegaly arise as monoclonal expansions of differentiated somatotroph cells and are usually sporadic. They are almost invariably benign, yet they can be locally invasive and show progressive growth despite treatment. Persistent excess of both growth hormone and its target hormone insulinlike growth factor 1 (IGF-1) results in a wide array of cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, musculoskeletal, neurological, and neoplastic comorbidities that might not be reversible with disease control. Normalisation of IGF-1 and growth hormone are the primary therapeutic aims; additional treatment goals include tumour shrinkage, relieving symptoms, managing complications, reducing excess morbidity, and improving quality of life. A multimodal approach with surgery, medical therapy, and (more rarely) radiation therapy is required to achieve these goals. In this Review, we examine the epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, complications, and treatment of acromegaly, with an emphasis on the importance of tailoring management strategies to each patient to optimise outcomes.
paragraphs.chinese: 导致肢端肥大症的生长激素分泌型垂体腺瘤源于分化型生长激素细胞的单克隆扩增，通常为散发性。这类肿瘤几乎总是 良性的，但可能具有局部侵袭性，并在治疗后仍可能持续生长。生长激素及其靶激素胰岛素样生长因子1（IGF-1）的持 续过量会导致广泛的心血管、呼吸系统、代谢、骨骼肌肉、神经系统及肿瘤性共病，这些病症在疾病控制后可能无法逆 转。治疗的主要目标是使IGF-1和生长激素水平恢复正常；其他治疗目标包括缩小肿瘤体积、缓解症状、处理并发症、降 低过度发病率以及提高生活质量。为实现这些目标，需要采用手术、药物治疗和（较少使用的）放射治疗相结合的多模 式方法。在本综述中，我们探讨了肢端肥大症的流行病学、发病机制、诊断、并发症及治疗，重点强调了个体化管理策 略对优化治疗效果的重要性。
