literature.title: Combining glucagonlike peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and sodiumglucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)
literature.title_chinese: 联合应用胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）与钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2is）治疗2型 糖尿病（T2DM）患者

paragraphs.english: AbstractDue to their cardiovascular protective effect, glucagonlike peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and sodium- glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) represent breakthrough therapies for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). In this review article, we discuss the mechanistic and clinical synergies that make the combined use of GLP-1RAs and SGLT2is appealing in patients with T2DM. Overall, the presented cumulative evidence supports the benefits of GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy on metaboliccardiovascularrenal disease in patients with T2DM, with a low hypoglycemia risk. Accordingly, we encourage the adoption of GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy in patients with T2DM and established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or multiple risk factors for ASCVD (i.e., age ≥ 55 years, overweight/obesity, dyslipidemia, hypertension, current tobacco use, left ventricular hypertrophy, and/or proteinuria). Regarding renal effects, the evidence of SGLT2is in preventing kidney failure is more abundant than for GLP-1RAs, which showed a beneficial effect on albuminuria but not on hard kidney endpoints. Hence, in case of persistent albuminuria and/or uncontrolled metabolic risks (i.e., inadequate glycemic control, hypertension, overweight/obesity) on SGLT2i therapy, GLP- 1RAs should be considered as the preferential addon therapy in T2DM patients with chronic kidney disease. Despite the potential clinical benefits of GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy in patients with T2DM, several factors may delay this combination to become a common practice soon, such as reimbursement and costs associated with polypharmacy. Altogether, when administering GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy, it is important to adopt an individualized approach to therapy taking into account individual preferences, costs and coverage, toxicity profile, consideration of kidney function and glucoselowering efficacy, desire for weight loss, and comorbidities.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要：胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）和钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2is）因其心血管保护作 用，已成为2型糖尿病（T2DM）治疗领域的突破性疗法。本文综述了GLP-1RAs与SGLT2is联合应用的机制协同性与临床 优势。现有证据表明，GLP-1RA与SGLT2i联合治疗对T2DM患者的代谢心血管肾脏疾病具有显著获益，且低血糖风险 较低。因此，我们建议对已确诊动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）或具有多重ASCVD危险因素（即年龄≥55岁、超 重/肥胖、血脂异常、高血压、当前吸烟、左心室肥厚和/或蛋白尿）的T2DM患者采用GLP-1RA与SGLT2i联合治疗方 案。在肾脏保护方面，SGLT2is预防肾衰竭的证据较GLP-1RAs更为充分，后者虽对蛋白尿有改善作用，但对硬性肾脏终 点事件的影响尚未明确。因此，对于接受SGLT2i治疗后仍存在持续性蛋白尿和/或代谢风险控制不佳（即血糖控制不达 标、高血压、超重/肥胖）的慢性肾脏病T2DM患者，应优先考虑加用GLP-1RAs。尽管GLP-1RA与SGLT2i联合治疗对 T2DM患者具有潜在临床获益，但报销政策及多药治疗成本等因素可能延缓该联合方案的普及。总体而言，实施GLP- 1RA与SGLT2i联合治疗时，需综合考虑患者个体偏好、治疗成本与医保覆盖、药物毒性特征、肾功能状况、降糖疗效、 减重需求及合并症等因素，采取个体化治疗策略。

literature.title: Glucagonlike peptide 1 receptor agonists: Cardiovascular benefits and mechanisms of action
literature.title_chinese: 胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂：心血管益处与作用机制

paragraphs.english: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity are metabolic disorders characterized by excess cardiovascular risk. Glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP1) receptor (GLP1R) agonists reduce body weight, glycaemia, blood pressure, postprandial lipaemia and inflammation - actions that could contribute to the reduction of cardiovascular events. cardiovascular outcome trials (CVOTs) have demonstrated that GLP1R agonists reduce the rates of major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with T2DM. Separate phase III CVOTs of GLP1R agonists are currently being conducted in people living with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and in those with obesity. Mechanistically, GLP1R is expressed at low levels in the heart and vasculature, raising the possibility that GLP1 might have both direct and indirect actions on the cardiovascular system. In this Review, we summarize the data from CVOTs of GLP1R agonists in patients with T2DM and describe the actions of GLP1R agonists on the heart and blood vessels. We also assess the potential mechanisms that contribute to the reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events in individuals treated with GLP1R agonists and highlight the emerging cardiovascular biology of novel GLP1-based multiagonists currently in development. Understanding how GLP1R signalling protects the heart and blood vessels will optimize the therapeutic use and development of nextgeneration GLP1-based therapies with improved cardiovascular safety.
paragraphs.chinese: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）与肥胖症是以心血管风险增高为特征的代谢权性疾病。胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP1）受体（GLP1R） 激动剂能够降低体重、血糖、血压、餐后血脂及炎症水平——这些作用可能有助于减少心血管事件的发生。心血管结局 试验（CVOTs）已证实，GLP1R激动剂可降低T2DM患侵者主要不良心血管事件的发生率。目前，针对射血分数保留型心 力衰竭患者及肥胖人群的GLP1R激动剂独立三期心血管结局试验正在进行中。从机制上看，GLP1R在心脏及血管系统中 表达水平较低，这提示GLP1可能对心血管系统同时具有直接与间接作用。本文综述了GLP1R激动剂在T2DM患者中的心 血管结局试验数据，阐述了其对心脏和血管的作用机制，评估了该类药物降低主要不良心血管事件的潜在机理，并重点 探讨了基于GLP1的新型多靶点激动剂在研发中展现的心血管生物学新进展。深入理解GLP1R信号通路如何保护心脏与血 管系统，将有助于优化现有疗法的临床应用，并推动具有更佳心血管安全性的新一代GLP1靶向疗法的研发进程。

literature.title: Pharmacological treatment of hyperglycemia in type 2 diabetes
literature.title_chinese: 2型糖尿病高血糖的药物治疗

paragraphs.english: diabetes mellitus is a major public health problem, affecting about 10% of the population. pharmacotherapy aims to protect against microvascular complications, including blindness, endstage kidney disease, and amputations. Landmark clinical trials have demonstrated that intensive glycemic control slows progression of microvascular complications (retinopathy, nephropathy, and neuropathy). Longterm followup has demonstrated that intensive glycemic control also decreases risk of macrovascular disease, albeit rigorous evidence of macrovascular benefit did not emerge for over a decade. The US FDA's recent requirement for dedicated cardiovascular outcome trials ushered in a golden age for understanding the clinical profiles of new type 2 diabetes drugs. Some clinical trials with sodiumglucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP1) receptor agonists reported data demonstrating cardiovascular benefit (decreased risk of major adverse cardiovascular events and hospitalization for heart failure) and slower progression of diabetic kidney disease. This Review discusses current guidelines for use of the 12 classes of drugs approved to promote glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes. The Review also anticipates future developments with potential to improve the standard of care: availability of generic dipeptidylpeptidase-4 (DPP4) inhibitors and SGLT2 inhibitors; precision medicine to identify the best drugs for individual patients; and new therapies to protect against chronic complications of diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病是一个重大的公共卫生问题，影响约10%的人口。药物治疗旨在预防微血管并发症，包括失明、终末期肾病和截 肢。具有里程碑意义的临床试验表明，强化血糖控制可延缓微血管并发症（视网膜病变、肾病和神经病变）的进展。长 期随访显示，强化血糖控制也能降低大血管疾病的风险，尽管大血管获益的严格证据在十多年后才出现。美国FDA最近 要求进行专门的心血管结局试验，这为理解新型2型糖尿病药物的临床特征开启了一个黄金时代。一些关于钠葡萄糖协 同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂和胰高血糖素样肽1（GLP1）受体激动剂的临床试验报告了显示心血管获益（降低主要不 良心血管事件和心力衰竭住院风险）以及延缓糖尿病肾病进展的数据。本综述讨论了目前用于2型糖尿病患者血糖控制的 12类药物使用指南。综述还展望了未来可能改善护理标准的发展：通用型二肽基肽酶-4（DPP4）抑制剂和SGLT2抑制剂 的可用性；精准医学以确定个体患者的最佳药物；以及预防糖尿病慢性并发症的新疗法。

literature.title: Monogenic diabetes
literature.title_chinese: 单基因糖尿病

paragraphs.english: monogenic diabetes includes several clinical conditions generally characterized by earlyonset diabetes, such as neonatal diabetes, maturityonset diabetes of the young (MODY) and various diabetesassociated syndromes. However, patients with apparent type 2 diabetes mellitus may actually have monogenic diabetes. Indeed, the same monogenic diabetes gene can contribute to different forms of diabetes with early or late onset, depending on the functional impact of the variant, and the same pathogenic variant can produce variable diabetes phenotypes, even in the same family. monogenic diabetes is mostly caused by impaired function or development of pancreatic islets, with defective insulin secretion in the absence of obesity. The most prevalent form of monogenic diabetes is MODY, which may account for 0.5-5% of patients diagnosed with non- autoimmune diabetes but is probably underdiagnosed owing to insufficient genetic testing. Most patients with neonatal diabetes or MODY have autosomal dominant diabetes. More than 40 subtypes of monogenic diabetes have been identified to date, the most prevalent being deficiencies of GCK and HNF1A. precision medicine approaches (including specific treatments for hyperglycaemia, monitoring associated extrapancreatic phenotypes and/or following up clinical trajectories, especially during pregnancy) are available for some forms of monogenic diabetes (including GCK- and HNF1Adiabetes) and increase patients' quality of life. Nextgeneration sequencing has made genetic diagnosis affordable, enabling effective genomic medicine in monogenic diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 单基因糖尿病包括多种临床状况，通常以早发糖尿病为特征，如新生儿糖尿病、青年成熟期发病型糖尿病（MODY）以 及各种与糖尿病相关的综合征。然而，表面上患有2型糖尿病的患者实际上可能患有单基因糖尿病。事实上，同一单基因 糖尿病基因可导致早发或晚发的不同形式糖尿病，这取决于变异的功能影响，而同一致病性变异可能产生不同的糖尿病 表型，即使在同一个家庭中也是如此。单基因糖尿病主要由胰岛功能或发育受损引起，在无肥胖情况下胰岛素分泌缺 陷。最常见的单基因糖尿病形式是MODY，可能占诊断为非自身免疫性糖尿病患者的0.5-5%，但由于基因检测不足，可 能被低估诊断。大多数新生儿糖尿病或M山ODY患者患有常染色体显性糖尿病。迄今为止，已发现超过40种单基因糖尿病 亚型，最常见的是GCK和HNF1A缺陷。针对某些形式的单基因糖尿病（包括GCK和HNF1A糖尿病），精准医学方法 （包括针对高血糖的特定治疗、梦监测相关的胰腺外表型和/或跟踪临床轨迹，特别是在妊娠期间）是可用的，并能提高患 者的生活质量。下一代测序技术使基因诊断变得经济实惠，从而在单基因糖尿病中实现了有效的基因组医学。

literature.title: Pancreas regeneration
literature.title_chinese: 胰腺再生

paragraphs.english: The pancreas is made from two distinct components: the exocrine pancreas, a reservoir of digestive enzymes, and the endocrine islets, the source of the vital metabolic hormone insulin. Human islets possess limited regenerative ability; loss of islet β-cells in diseases such as type 1 diabetes requires therapeutic intervention. The leading strategy for restoration of β-cell mass is through the generation and transplantation of new β-cells derived from human pluripotent stem cells. Other approaches include stimulating endogenous β-cell proliferation, reprogramming non-β-cells to β-like cells, and harvesting islets from genetically engineered animals. Together these approaches form a rich pipeline of therapeutic development for pancreatic regeneration.
paragraphs.chinese: 胰腺由两个不同的部分组成：外分泌胰腺，作为消化酶的储存库；以及内分泌胰岛，是至关重要的代谢激素胰岛素的来 源。人类胰岛的再生能力有限；在诸如1型糖尿病等疾病中，胰岛β细胞的丧失需要治疗干预。恢复β细胞质量的主要策略 是通过从人类多能干细胞中生成并移植新的β细胞。其他方法包括刺激内源性β细胞增殖、将非β细胞重编程为β样细胞， 以及从基因工程动物中获取胰岛。这些方法共同构成了胰腺再生治疗发展的丰富渠道。

literature.title: Pancreatic β cell regeneration as a possible therapy for diabetes
literature.title_chinese: 胰腺β细胞再生作为糖尿病的潜在疗法

paragraphs.english: diabetes is the result of having inadequate supply of functional insulinproducing β cells. Two possible approaches for replenishing the β cells are: (1) replacement by transplanting cadaveric islets or β cells derived from human embryonic stem cells/induced pluripotent stem cells and (2) induction of endogenous regeneration. This review focuses on endogenous regeneration, which can follow two pathways: enhanced replication of existing β cells and formation of new β cells from cells not expressing insulin, either by conversion from a differentiated cell type (transdifferentiation) or differentiation from progenitors (neogenesis). Exciting progress on both pathways suggest that regeneration may have therapeutic promise.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病是由于功能性胰岛素分泌β细胞供应不足所致。补充β细胞有两种可能途径：一是通过移植尸体胰岛或源自人类胚 胎干细胞/诱导多能干细胞分化的β细胞进行替代；二是诱导内源性再生。本综述聚焦于内源性再生途径，该途径可通过 两种方式实现：一是促进现有β细胞的增殖复制，二是通过分化细胞类型的转化（转分化）或祖细胞分化（新生）途径， 使非胰岛素表达细胞形成新的β细胞。两条路径取得的突破性进展均表明，再生疗法具有潜在的治疗前景。

literature.title: The clinical consequences of heterogeneity within and between different diabetes types
literature.title_chinese: 不同糖尿病类型内部及之间的异质性临床后果

paragraphs.english: Advances in molecular methods and the ability to share large populationbased datasets are uncovering heterogeneity within diabetes types, and some commonalities between types. Within type 1 diabetes, endotypes have been discovered based on demographic (e.g. age at diagnosis, race/ethnicity), genetic, immunological, histopathological, metabolic and/or clinical course characteristics, with implications for disease prediction, prevention, diagnosis and treatment. In type 2 diabetes, the relative contributions of insulin resistance and beta cell dysfunction are heterogeneous and relate to demographics, genetics and clinical characteristics, with substantial interaction from environmental exposures. Investigators have proposed approaches that vary from simple to complex in combining these data to identify type 2 diabetes clusters relevant to prognosis and treatment. Advances in pharmacogenetics and pharmacodynamics are also improving treatment. monogenic diabetes is a prime example of how understanding heterogeneity within diabetes types can lead to precision medicine, since phenotype and treatment are affected by which gene is mutated. Heterogeneity also blurs the classic distinctions between diabetes types, and has led to the definition of additional categories, such as latent autoimmune diabetes in adults, type 1.5 diabetes and ketosisprone diabetes. Furthermore, monogenic diabetes shares many 究features with type 1 and type 2 diabetes, which make diagnosis difficult. These challenges to the current classification framework in adult and paediatric diabetes require new approaches. The 'palette model' and the 'threshold hypothesis' can be combined to help explain the heterogeneity within and between diabetes types. Leveraging such approaches for therapeutic benefit will be an important next step for precision medicine in diabetes. Graphical abstract.
paragraphs.chinese: 分子方法的进步以及共享大规模人群数据集的能力正在揭示糖尿病类型内部的异质性以及不同类型之间的某些共性。在1 型糖尿病中，基于人口统计学（如诊断年龄、种族/-民族）、遗传学、免疫学、组织病理学、代谢和/或临床病程特征，已 发现不同的内型，这对疾病的预测、预防山、诊断和治疗具有重要意义。在2型糖尿病中，胰岛素抵抗和β细胞功能障碍的 相对贡献存在异质性，并与人口统计学、遗传学和临床特征相关，同时受到环境暴露的显著影响。研究人员提出了从简 单到复杂的不同方法，结合这些数据来识别与预后和治疗相关的2型糖尿病聚类。药物遗传学和药效学的进展也在改善治 疗。单基因糖尿病是理解糖尿病类型内部异质性如何推动精准医疗的典型例子，因为表型和治疗受突变基因的影响。异 质性也模糊了糖尿病类型之间的经典区别，并导致了新类别的定义，如成人隐匿性自身免疫性糖尿病、1.5型糖尿病和酮 症倾向糖尿病。此外，单基因糖尿病与1型和2型糖尿病有许多共同特征，这使得诊断变得困难。这些对当前成人和儿童 糖尿病分类框架的挑战需要新的方法。“调色板模型”和“阈值假说”可以结合起来，帮助解释糖尿病类型内部和之间 的异质性。利用这些方法实现治疗获益将是糖尿病精准医疗下一步的重要方向。图形摘要。

literature.title: Singlecell atlas of human pancreatic islet and acinar endothelial cells in health and diabetes
literature.title_chinese: 健康与糖尿病状态下人类胰岛及腺泡内皮细胞的单细胞图谱

paragraphs.english: Characterization of the vascular heterogeneity within the pancreas has previously been lacking. Here, we develop strategies to enrich isletspecific endothelial cells (ISECs) and acinarspecific endothelial cells (ASECs) from three human pancreases and corroborate these findings with three published pancreatic datasets. Singlecell RNA sequencing reveals the unique molecular signatures of ISECs, including structural genes COL13A1, ESM1, PLVAP, UNC5B, and LAMA4, angiocrine genes KDR, THBS1, BMPs and CXCR4, and metabolic genes ACE, PASK and F2RL3. ASECs display distinct signatures including GPIHBP1, CCL14, CD74, AQP1, KLF4, and KLF2, which may manage the inflammatory and metabolic needs of the exocrine pancreas. ligandreceptor analysis suggests ISECs and ASECs interact with LUM(+) fibroblasts and RGS5(+) pericytes and smooth muscle cells via VEGFA:VEGFR2, CXCL12:CXCR4, and LIF:LIFR pathways. Comparative expression and immunohistochemistry indicate disruption of endothelialexpressed CD74, ESM1, PLVAP, THBD, VWA1, and VEGFA crosstalk among vascular and other cell types in diabetes. Thus, our data provide a singlecell vascular atlas of human pancreas, enabling deeper understanding of pancreatic pathophysiology in health and disease.
paragraphs.chinese: 此前，胰腺内血管异质性的特征尚未明确。本研究从三例人类胰腺中富集胰岛特异性内皮细胞（ISECs）和腺泡特异性内 皮细胞（ASECs），并结合三个已发表的胰腺数据集验证结果。单细胞RNA测序揭示了ISECs的独特分子特征，包括结构 基因COL13A1、ESM1、PLVAP、UNC5B和LAMA4，血管分泌因子基因KDR、THBS1、BMPs和CXCR4，以及代谢基 因ACE、PASK和F2RL3。ASECs则呈现独特特征，包括GPIHBP1、CCL14、CD74、AQP1、KLF4和KLF2，这些可能调 控外分泌胰腺的炎症与代谢需求。配体受体分析表明，ISECs和ASECs通过VEGF-A:VEGFR2、CXCL12:CXCR4和 LIF:LIFR通路与LUM(+)成纤维细胞及RGS5(+)周细胞、平滑肌细胞相互作用。比较表达与免疫组化结果显示，糖尿病中 血管内皮表达的CD74、ESM1、PLVAP、THBD、-VWA1及VEGF-A在血管与其他细胞类型间的信号串扰发生紊乱。因 此，本研究绘制了人类胰腺单细胞血管图谱，为深入理解健康与疾病状态下的胰腺病理生理学提供了依据。

literature.title: Fam3amediated prohormone convertase switch in α-cells regulates pancreatic GLP-1 production in an Nr4a2-Foxa2-dependent manner
literature.title_chinese: Fam3a介导的α细胞中激素原转换酶切换以Nr4a2-Foxa2依赖性方式调节胰腺GLP-1生成

paragraphs.english: BACKGROUND: Fam3a has been demonstrated to regulate pancreatic β-cell function and glucose homeostasis. However, the role and mechanism of Fam3a in regulating α-cell function remain unexplored. METHODS: glucagon and glucagonlike peptide-1 (GLP-1) levels in pancreas and plasma were measured in global Fam3a knockout (Fam3a RESULTS: Compared with wildtype mice, pancreatic and plasma active GLP-1 levels were increased in Fam3a CONCLUSIONS: Fam3a deficiency in α-cells enhances pancreatic GLP-1 production to improve β-cell function via paracrine signaling in an Nr4a2- Foxa2-PC1/3-dependent manner. Our study unveils a novel strategy for reprogramming α-cell proglucagon processing output from glucagon to GLP-1 and deepen the understanding of crosstalk between α-cells and β-cells.
paragraphs.chinese: 背景：Fam3a已被证实能调节胰腺β细胞功能和葡萄糖稳态。然而，Fam3a在调节α细胞功能中的作用和机制尚未被探 索。方法：在全基因组Fam3a敲除（Fam3a-/-）小鼠中测量胰腺和血浆中的胰高血糖素和胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1） 水平。结果：与野生型小鼠相比，Fam3a-/-小鼠的胰腺和血浆活性GLP-1水平升高，而胰高血糖素水平降低。结论：α 细胞中Fam3a的缺乏通过旁分泌信号以Nr4a2-Foxa2-PC1/3依赖的方式增强胰腺GLP-1的产生，从而改善β细胞功能。 我们的研究揭示了一种将α细胞前胰高血糖素处理输出从胰高血糖素重编程为GLP-1的新策略，并加深了对α细胞和β细胞 之间相互作用的理解。

literature.title: Diabetes mellitus and the key role of endoplasmic reticulum stress in pancreatic β cells
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病与内质网应激在胰腺β细胞中的关键作用

paragraphs.english: Insufficient insulin secretion by pancreatic β cells is central to the pathogenesis of diabetes mellitus. As insulin is synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), perturbations in ER homeostasis lead to ER stress and activate the ER stress response. Over the past two decades, considerable data have accumulated on the role of β cell ER stress in diabetes mellitus. Several monogenic forms of diabetes mellitus are caused by excessive ER stress, perturbed ER stress response signalling or impaired ERGolgi protein trafficking. These pathways are now recognized to contribute to β cell failure in both type 1 and type 2 diabetes mellitus. This Review considers the role of β cell ER stress in common forms of diabetes mellitus and examines whether it is a cause or a consequence of these diseases. The strong genetic evidence for a causal role of ER stress in 15 monogenic forms of diabetes mellitus is summarized, and the effects of ER stress on human β cell differentiation, function and survival are described. Although definitive proof is lacking that ER stress responses can be therapeutically targeted to improve β cell function in diabetes mellitus, existing and novel treatments that aim to restore ER homeostasis are also outlined.
paragraphs.chinese: 胰腺β细胞胰岛素分泌不足是糖尿病发病机制的核心。由于胰岛素在内质网（ER）中合成，内质网稳态的扰动会导致内质 网应激并激活内质网应激反应。过去二十年间，关于β细胞内质网应激在糖尿病中的作用已积累了相当多的数据。多种单 基因型糖尿病是由过度内质网应激、内质网应激反应信号通路紊乱或内质网高尔基体蛋白质运输受损引起的。目前认为 这些通路在1型和2型糖尿病中均导致β细胞功能衰竭。本综述探讨了β细胞内质网应激在常见类型糖尿病中的作用，并审 视其是这些疾病的病因还是后果。文章总结了内质网应激在15种单基因型糖尿病中因果作用的强有力遗传学证据，描述 了内质网应激对人类β细胞分化、功能和存活的影响。尽管目前缺乏确凿证据表明通过靶向内质网应激反应可改善糖尿病 中的β细胞功能，但仍概述了旨在恢复内质网稳态的现有及新型治疗方法。

literature.title: Inceptor binds to and directs insulin towards lysosomal degradation in β cells
literature.title_chinese: Inceptor结合并引导胰岛素在β细胞中向溶酶体降解

paragraphs.english: AbstractBlunted firstphase insulin secretion and insulin deficiency are indicators of β cell dysfunction and diabetes manifestation. Therefore, insights into molecular mechanisms that regulate insulin homeostasis might provide entry sites to replenish insulin content and restore β cell function. Here, we identify the insulin inhibitory receptor (inceptor; encoded by the gene IIR/ELAPOR1) as an insulinbinding receptor that regulates insulin stores by lysosomal degradation. Using human induced pluripotent stem cell (SC)-derived islets, we show that IIR knockout (KO) results in enhanced SC β cell differentiation and survival. Strikingly, extended in vitro culture of IIR KO SC β cells leads to greatly increased insulin content and glucosestimulated insulin secretion (GSIS). We find that inceptor localizes to clathrincoated vesicles close to the plasma membrane and in the transGolgi network as well as in secretory granules, where it acts as a sorting receptor to direct proinsulin and insulin towards lysosomal degradation. Targeting inceptor using a monoclonal antibody increases proinsulin and insulin content and improves SC β cell GSIS. Altogether, our findings reveal the basic mechanisms of β cell insulin turnover and identify inceptor as an insulin degradation receptor.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要 胰岛素分泌第一相钝化和胰岛素缺乏是β细胞功能障碍和糖尿病表现的重要指标。因此，深入探究调控胰岛素稳态 的分子机制，可能为补充胰岛素储备、恢复β细胞功能提供切入点。本研究首次鉴定出胰岛素抑制受体（inceptor，由 IIR/ELAPOR1基因编码）作为胰岛素结合受体，通过溶酶体降解途径调控胰岛素储存。利用人诱导多能干细胞（SC）分 化的胰岛类器官，我们发现IIR基因敲除（KO）能显著促进SC β细胞的分化与存活。值得注意的是，IIR KO SC β细胞经 过体外长期培养后，其胰岛素含量和葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌（GSIS）能力均大幅提升。研究显示，inceptor定位于质 膜附近的网格蛋白包被囊泡、高尔基体反面膜囊以及分泌颗粒中，作为分选受体将胰岛素原和胰岛素导向溶酶体降解途 径。使用单克隆抗体靶向抑制inceptor功能，可有效增加胰岛素原和胰岛素含量，并显著改善SC β细胞的GSIS能力。综 上所述，本研究揭示了β细胞胰岛素周转的基本机制，并确立inceptor作为胰岛素降解受体的关键作用。

literature.title: Pancreatic β-cell development and regeneration
literature.title_chinese: 胰腺β细胞发育与再生
literature.journal: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Biology

paragraphs.english: The pancreatic β-cells are essential for regulating glucose homeostasis through the coordinated release of the insulin hormone. dysfunction of the highly specialized β-cells results in diabetes mellitus, a growing global health epidemic. In this review, we describe the development and function of β-cells the emerging concept of heterogeneity within insulinproducing cells, and the potential of other cell types to assume β-cell functionality via transdifferentiation. We also discuss emerging routes to design cells with minimal β-cell properties and human stem cell differentiation efforts that carry the promise to restore normoglycemia in patients suffering from diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 胰腺β细胞通过协调释放胰岛素激素对调节葡萄糖稳态至关重要。高度特化的β细胞功能失调会导致糖尿病，这一全球健 康流行病正日益加剧。本综述阐述了β细胞的发育与功能、胰岛素产生细胞异质性的新兴概念，以及其他细胞类型通过转 分化获得β细胞功能的潜力。我们还讨论了设计具有基本β细胞特性细胞的新兴途径，以及人类干细胞分化研究——这些 努力有望为糖尿病患者恢复正常血糖水平。

literature.title: Glucagon acting at the GLP-1 receptor contributes to β-cell regeneration induced by glucagon receptor antagonism in diabetic mice
literature.title_chinese: 胰高血糖素作用于GLP-1受体促进糖尿病小鼠中胰高血糖素受体拮抗作用诱导的β细胞再生

paragraphs.english: Dysfunction of glucagonsecreting α-cells participates in the progression of diabetes, and glucagon receptor (GCGR) antagonism is regarded as a novel strategy for diabetes therapy. GCGR antagonism upregulates glucagon and glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP-1) secretion and, notably, promotes β-cell regeneration in diabetic mice. Here, we aimed to clarify the role of GLP-1 receptor (GLP-1R) activated by glucagon and/or GLP-1 in the GCGR antagonism–induced β-cell regeneration. We showed that in db/db mice and type 1 diabetic wildtype or Flox/cre mice, GCGR monoclonal antibody (mAb) improved glucose control, upregulated plasma insulin level, and increased β-cell area. Notably, blockage of systemic or pancreatic GLP-1R signaling by exendin 9-39 (Ex9) or Glp1r knockout diminished the above effects of GCGR mAb. Furthermore, glucagonneutralizing antibody (nAb), which prevents activation of GLP-1R by glucagon, also attenuated the GCGR mAb– induced insulinotropic effect and β-cell regeneration. In cultured primary mouse islets isolated from normal mice and db/db mice, GCGR mAb action to increase insulin release and to upregulate β-cell–specific marker expression was reduced by a glucagon nAb, by the GLP-1R antagonist Ex9, or by a pancreasspecific Glp1r knockout. These findings suggest that activation of GLP-1R by glucagon participates in β-cell regeneration induced by GCGR antagonism in diabetic mice. Article Highlights glucagon receptor (GCGR) antagonism promotes β-cell regeneration in type 1 and type 2 diabetic mice and in euglycemic nonhuman primates. glucagon and glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP-1必) can activate the GLP-1 receptor (GLP-1R), and their levels are upregulated following GCGR antagonism. We investigated whether GLP-1R activated by glucagon and/or GLP-1 contributed to β-cell regeneration induced by GCGR antagonism. We found that blockage of glucagon–GLP- 1R signaling attenuated the GCGR monoclonal antibody–induced insulinotropic effect and β-cell regeneration in diabetic mice. Our study reveals a novel mechanism of β-cell regeneration and uncovers the communication between α-cells and β- cells in regulating β-cell mass.
paragraphs.chinese: 分泌胰高血糖素的α细胞功能障碍参与糖尿病的进展，而胰高血糖素受体（GCGR）拮抗被视为糖尿病治疗的新策略。 GCGR拮抗可上调胰高血糖素和胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）的分泌，并显著促进糖尿病小鼠的β细胞再生。本研究旨在 阐明由胰高血糖素和/或GLP-1激活的GLP-1受体（GLP-1R）在GCGR拮抗诱导的β细胞再生中的作用。我们在db/db小 鼠及1型糖尿病野生型或Flox/cre小鼠中发现，GCGR单克隆抗体（mAb）能改善血糖控制、提升血浆胰岛素水平并增加 β细胞面积。值得注意的是，通过exendin 9-39（Ex9）或Glp1r基因敲除阻断全身或胰腺GLP-1R信号通路，会削弱 GCGR mAb的上述效应。此外，能阻止胰高血糖素激活GLP-1R的胰高血糖素中和抗体（nAb）也减弱了GCGR mAb诱 导的促胰岛素效应和β细胞再生。在从正常小鼠和db/db小鼠分离培养的原代胰岛中，GCGR mAb增加胰岛素释放和上 调β细胞特异性标志物表达的作用，可被胰高血糖素nAb、GLP-1R拮抗剂Ex9或胰腺特异性Glp1r敲除所减弱。这些发现 表明，胰高血糖素激活GLP-1R参与了糖尿病小鼠中GCGR拮抗诱导的β细胞再生过程。文章要点：胰高血糖素受体 （GCGR）拮抗能促进1型和2型糖尿病小鼠以及血糖正常的非人灵长类动物的β细胞再生。胰高血糖素和胰高血糖素样 肽-1（GLP-1）均可激活GLP-1受体（GLP-1R），且GCGR拮抗后两者水平均上调。我们探究了由胰高血糖素和/或GLP- 1激活的GLP-1R是否参与GCGR拮抗诱导的β细胞再生。研究发现，阻断胰高血糖素-GLP-1R信号通路可减弱GCGR单克 隆抗体在糖尿病小鼠中诱导的促胰岛素效应和β细胞再生。本研究揭示了β细胞再生的新机制，并阐明了α细胞与β细胞在 调控β细胞数量中的交互作用。

literature.title: Gut microbiota−tryptophan metabolism−GLP-1 axis participates in β-cell regeneration induced by dapagliflozin
literature.title_chinese: 肠道微生物群-色氨酸代谢-GLP-1轴参与达格列净诱导的β细胞再生

paragraphs.english: Sodiumglucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors, efficacious antidiabetic agents that have cardiovascular and renal benefits, can promote pancreatic β-cell regeneration in type 2 diabetic mice. However, the underlying mechanism remains unclear. In this study, we aimed to use multiomics to identify the mediators involved in β-cell regeneration induced by dapagliflozin. We showed that dapagliflozin lowered blood glucose level, upregulated plasma insulin level, and increased islet area in db/db mice. Dapagliflozin reshaped gut microbiota and modulated microbiotic and plasmatic metabolites related to tryptophan metabolism, especially ltryptophan, in the diabetic mice. Notably, ltryptophan upregulated the mRNA level of glucagon- like peptide 1 (GLP-1) productionrelated gene (Gcg and Pcsk1) expression and promoted GLP-1 secretion in cultured mouse intestinal L cells, and it increased the supernatant insulin level in primary human islets, which was eliminated by GPR142 antagonist. Transplant of fecal microbiota from dapagliflozintreated mice, supplementation of ltryptophan, or treatment with dapagliflozin upregulated ltryptophan, GLP-1, and insulin or Cpeptide levels and promoted β-cell regeneration in db/db mice. Addition of exendin 9-39, a GLP-1 receptor (GLP-1R) antagonist, or pancreatic Glp1r knockout diminished these beneficial effects. In summary, treatment with dapagliflozin in type 2 diabetic mice promotes β-cell regeneration by upregulating GLP-1 production, which is mediated via gut microbiota and tryptophan metabolism.
paragraphs.chinese: 钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂作为具有心血管和肾脏保护作用的权有效抗糖尿病药物，可促进2型糖尿病小鼠的胰腺β细 胞再生，但其潜在机制尚不明确。本研究旨在通过多组学方法鉴定达格列净诱导β细胞再生的关键介质。结果显示，达格 列净可降低db/db小鼠血糖水平、上调血浆胰岛素水平侵并增加胰岛面积。该药物重塑了糖尿病小鼠的肠道菌群，并调节 了与色氨酸代谢相关的微生物及血浆代谢物（尤其是L-色氨酸）。值得注意的是，L-色氨酸可上调培养的小鼠肠道L细胞 中胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）生成相关基因（Gc-g和Pcsk1）的mRNA表达并促进GLP-1分泌，同时增加原代人胰岛的 上清胰岛素水平，而这一效应可被GPR14山2拮抗剂消除。移植达格列净处理小鼠的粪便菌群、补充L-色氨酸或使用达格列 净治疗，均可上调db/db小鼠的L-色氨酸、GLP-1及胰岛素/C肽水平，并促进β细胞再生。而添加GLP-1受体（GLP- 1R）拮抗剂exendin 9-39或敲除胰腺Glp1r基因则会消除这些有益效应。综上，达格列净通过肠道菌群和色氨酸代谢介 导的GLP-1生成上调，促进2型糖尿病小鼠的β细胞再生。

literature.title: A novel hydrogel loaded with plant exosomes and stem cell exosomes as a new strategy for treating diabetic wounds
literature.title_chinese: 一种装载植物外泌体和干细胞外泌体的新型水凝胶作为治疗糖尿病伤口的新策略

paragraphs.english: diabetic wound healing is constrained by various factors, including chronic inflammation, sustained oxidative stress, impaired angiogenesis, and abnormal wound microenvironments. Exosomes derived from mesenchymal stem cells (MSC- exo) contain a wealth of bioactive substances that play a positive role in promoting diabetic wound healing. Plantderived exosomes, as a novel therapeutic approach, are continuously being explored. Momordica charantia (MC) has been shown to possess blood glucoselowering effects, and its exosomes are of significant relevance for treating diabetic wounds. However, direct application of exosomes to wounds faces challenges such as poor stability and short retention time, limiting their therapeutic effectiveness and clinical applicability. Encapsulating exosomes in hydrogels is an effective strategy to preserve their bioactivity. In this study, we fabricated a hydrogel loaded with MSCexo and MC exosomes (MCexo) by photopolymerization of methacrylated gelatin (GelMA) and dopamine (MEMCGel). The resulting MEMCGel exhibited favorable mechanical properties, adhesion, degradability, absorbency, and biocompatibility. In vitro, MEMCGel demonstrated the ability to resist inflammation, counter oxidative stress, promote fibroblast migration, support endothelial cell angiogenesis, and regulate macrophage polarization. In a diabetic mouse wound model, MEMCGel accelerated wound healing by inhibiting inflammation and oxidative stress, modulating macrophage immune responses and hyperglycemia within the microenvironment, promoting angiogenesis, and enhancing epithelialization. In conclusion, MEMCGel is an outstanding hydrogel dressing that synergistically promotes repair by loading MSCexo and MCexo, significantly accelerating diabetic wound healing through multiple mechanisms. This multifunctional hydrogel, based on exosomes from two different sources, provides an innovative therapeutic strategy for diabetic wound repair with broad clinical application potential.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病伤口愈合受到多种因素制约，包括慢性炎症、持续氧化应激、血管生成受损及伤口微环境异常。间充质干细胞来 源的外泌体（MSC-exo）富含生物活性物质，对促进糖尿病伤口愈合具有积极作用。植物源性外泌体作为一种新型治疗 手段正被持续探索，苦瓜已被证实具有降血糖功效，其外泌体对糖尿病伤口治疗具有重要意义。然而外泌体直接应用于 伤口面临稳定性差、滞留时间短等挑战，限制了其治疗效果和临床应用潜力。将外泌体封装于水凝胶中是保持其生物活 性的有效策略。本研究通过光聚合甲基丙烯酰化明胶（GelMA）与多巴胺，构建了负载MSC-exo与苦瓜外泌体（MC- exo）的水凝胶（MEMC-Gel）。所得MEMC-Gel展现出良好的机械性能、粘附性、可降解性、吸液性与生物相容性。 体外实验表明，MEMC-Gel具有抗炎、抗氧化、促进成纤维细胞迁移、支持内皮细胞血管生成及调控巨噬细胞极化的能 力。在糖尿病小鼠伤口模型中，MEMC-Gel通过抑制炎症与氧化应激、调控巨噬细胞免疫应答及微环境内高血糖状态、 促进血管生成和增强上皮化进程，加速了伤口愈合进程。综上所述，MEMC-Gel是一种通过负载MSC-exo与MC-exo协 同促进修复的优异水凝胶敷料，能通过多重机制显著加速糖尿病伤口愈合。这种基于两种不同来源外泌体的多功能水凝 胶为糖尿病伤口修复提供了创新治疗策略，具有广阔的临床应用前景。

literature.title: Bioinspired nanovesicles released from injectable hydrogels facilitate diabetic wound healing by regulating macrophage polarization and endothelial cell dysfunction
literature.title_chinese: 生物启发纳米囊泡从可注射水凝胶中释放通过调节巨噬细胞极化和内皮细胞功能障碍促进糖尿病伤口愈合

paragraphs.english: AbstractWound healing is one of the major global health concerns in diabetic patients. Overactivation of proinflammatory M1 macrophages could lead to delayed wound healing in diabetes. 4-octyl itaconate (4OI), a derivative of the metabolite itaconate, has aroused growing interest recently on account of its excellent antiinflammatory properties. Cell membrane coating is widely regarded as a novel biomimetic strategy to deliver drugs and inherit properties derived from source cells for biomedical applications. Herein, we fused induced pluripotent stem cellderived endothelial cell (iEC) membrane together with M1 type macrophage membrane to construct a hybrid membrane (iECM) camouflaged 4OI nanovesicles (4OI@iEC- M). Furthermore, bioinspired nanovesicles 4OI@iECM are incorporated into the injectable, multifunctional gelatin methacryloyl hydrogels for diabetic wound repair and regeneration. In our study, bioinspired nanovesicles could achieve dualtargeted deliver of 4OI into both M1 macrophages and endothelial cells, thereby promoting macrophage polarization and protecting endothelial cells. With the synergistically antiinflammatory and immunoregulative effects, the bioinspired nanovesiclesloaded hydrogels could facilitate neovascularization and exhibit superior diabetic wound repair and regeneration. Taken together, this study might provide a novel strategy to facilitate diabetic wound healing, thereby reducing limb amputation and mortality of diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要伤口愈合是糖尿病患者全球主要健康问题之一。促炎性M1巨噬细胞的过度激活可能导致糖尿病伤口愈合延迟。4-辛 基衣康酸酯（4OI）作为代谢物衣康酸的衍生物，因其卓侵越的抗炎特性近来引起了广泛关注。细胞膜包覆技术被广泛视为 一种新型仿生策略，用于药物递送并继承源细胞特性，适用于生物医学应用。本研究将诱导多能干细胞来源的内皮细胞 （iEC）膜与M1型巨噬细胞膜融合，构建了仿生混合膜（iEC-M）包覆的4OI纳米囊泡（4OI@iEC-M）。进一步地，将 这种仿生纳米囊泡4OI@iEC-M整合至可注射的多功能甲基丙烯酰化明胶水凝胶中，用于糖尿病伤口修复与再生。研究表 明，仿生纳米囊泡能够实现4OI对M1巨噬细胞和内皮细胞的双重靶向递送，从而促进巨噬细胞极化并保护内皮细胞。凭 借协同的抗炎与免疫调节作用，负载仿生纳米囊泡的水凝胶能够促进新生血管形成，并展现出优异的糖尿病伤口修复与 再生效果。综上所述，本研究可能为促进糖尿病伤口愈合提供新策略，从而降低糖尿病患者的截肢风险与死亡率。

literature.title: Diabetic emergencies - ketoacidosis, hyperglycaemic hyperosmolar state and hypoglycaemia
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病急症——酮症酸中毒、高血糖高渗状态与低血糖

paragraphs.english: diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA), hyperglycaemic hyperosmolar state (HHS) and hypoglycaemia are serious complications of diabetes mellitus that require prompt recognition, diagnosis and treatment. DKA and HHS are characterized by insulinopaenia and severe hyperglycaemia; clinically, these two conditions differ only by the degree of dehydration and the severity of metabolic acidosis. The overall mortality recorded among children and adults with DKA is <1%. mortality among patients with HHS is ~10-fold higher than that associated with DKA. The prognosis and outcome of patients with DKA or HHS are determined by the severity of dehydration, the presence of comorbidities and age >60 years. The estimated annual cost of hospital treatment for patients experiencing hyperglycaemic crises in the USA exceeds US$2 billion. hypoglycaemia is a frequent and serious adverse effect of antidiabetic therapy that is associated with both immediate and delayed adverse clinical outcomes, as well as increased economic costs. Inpatients who develop hypoglycaemia are likely to experience a long duration of hospital stay and increased mortality. This Review describes the clinical presentation, precipitating causes, diagnosis and acute management of these diabetic emergencies, including a discussion of practical strategies for their prevention. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒（DKA）、高血糖高渗状态（HHS）和低血糖是糖尿病的严重并发症，需要及时识别、诊断和治疗。 DKA和HHS以胰岛素缺乏和严重高血糖为特征；临床上，这两种情况的区别仅在于脱水程度和代谢性酸中毒的严重性。 儿童和成人DKA的总体死亡率记录低于1%。HHS患者的死亡率比DKA相关死亡率高出约10倍。DKA或HHS患者的预后 和结果取决于脱水严重程度、合并症的存在以及年龄是否超过60岁。在美国，高血糖危象患者住院治疗的年度估计费用 超过20亿美元。低血糖是抗糖尿病治疗中常见且严重的不良反应，与即时和延迟的不良临床结果以及经济成本增加相 关。发生低血糖的住院患者可能经历较长的住院时间和增加的死亡率。本综述描述了这些糖尿病急症的临床表现、诱发 原因、诊断和急性管理，包括讨论其预防的实际策略。

literature.title: Management of diabetic neuropathy
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病神经病变的管理

paragraphs.english: diabetic neuropathy is a neurodegenerative disorder that may alter both the somatic and autonomic peripheral nervous systems in the context of diabetes mellitus (DM). It is a prevalent and burdensome chronic complication of DM, that requires timely management. Optimized glycemic control (mainly for type 1 DM), multifactorial intervention (mainly for type 2 DM), with lifestyle intervention/physical exercise, and weight loss represent the basis of management for diabetic distal symmetrical polyneuropathy, and should be implemented early in the disease course. Despite better understanding of the pathogenetic mechanisms of diabetic peripheral neuropathy, there is still a stringent need for more pathogeneticbased agents that would significantly modify the natural history of the disease. The paper reviews the available drugs and current recommendations for the management of distal symmetrical polyneuropathy, including pain management, and for diabetic autonomic neuropathy. Evaluation of drug combinations that would perhaps be more efficient in slowing the progression of the disease or even reversing it, and that would provide a better pain management is still needed.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病神经病变是一种神经退行性疾病，在糖尿病背景下可能影响体感和自主外周神经系统。作为糖尿病常见且负担沉 重的慢性并发症，其需要及时管理。优化血糖控制（主要针对1型糖尿病）、多因素干预（主要针对2型糖尿病），结合 生活方式干预/体育锻炼及减重，构成了糖尿病远端对称性多发性神经病变管理的基础，应在病程早期实施。尽管对糖尿 病周围神经病变的发病机制有了更深入的理解，但仍迫切需要更多基于发病机制的药物，以显著改变疾病的自然进程。 本文综述了可用于远端对称性多发性神经病变（包括疼痛管理）及糖尿病自主神经病变的现有药物及当前治疗建议。仍 需评估可能更有效延缓甚至逆转疾病进展，并提供更好疼痛管理的药物组合方案。

literature.title: Stomachderived human insulinsecreting organoids restore glucose homeostasis
literature.title_chinese: 胃源性人胰岛素分泌类器官恢复葡萄糖稳态

paragraphs.english: Gut stem cells are accessible by biopsy and propagate robustly in culture, offering an invaluable resource for autologous cell therapies. insulinproducing cells can be induced in mouse gut, but it has not been possible to generate abundant and durable insulinsecreting cells from human gut tissues to evaluate their potential as a cell therapy for diabetes. Here we describe a protocol to differentiate cultured human gastric stem cells into pancreatic isletlike organoids containing gastric insulin- secreting (GINS) cells that resemble betacells in molecular hallmarks and function. Sequential activation of the inducing factors NGN3 and PDX1-MAFA led human gastric stem cells onto a distinctive differentiation path, including a SOX4(High) endocrine and Galanin(High) GINS precursor, before adopting betacell identity, at efficiencies close to 70%. GINS organoids acquired glucosestimulated insulin secretion in 10 days and restored glucose homeostasis for over 100 days in diabetic mice after transplantation, providing proof of concept for a promising approach to treat diabetes.
paragraphs.chinese: 肠道干细胞可通过活检获取，并在培养中稳定增殖，为自体细胞疗法提供了宝贵资源。小鼠肠道中可诱导产生胰岛素分 泌细胞，但尚未能从人类肠道组织中生成充足且持久的胰岛素分泌细胞，以评估其作为糖尿病细胞疗法的潜力。本文描 述了一种将培养的人胃干细胞分化为含胃胰岛素分泌（GINS）细胞的胰岛样类器官的方案，这些细胞在分子特征和功能 上均类似β细胞。通过依次激活诱导因子NGN3和PDX1-MAFA，人胃干细胞进入独特的分化路径，包括形成SOX4高表 达的内分泌前体细胞和Galanin高表达的GINS前体细胞，最终获得β细胞特性，分化效率接近70%。GINS类器官在10天 内获得葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌能力，并在移植至糖尿病小鼠后恢复血糖稳态超过100天，为治疗糖尿病提供了有前景的 方法的概念验证。

literature.title: Diabetic kidney disease
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病肾病

paragraphs.english: The kidney is arguably the most important target of microvascular damage in diabetes. A substantial proportion of individuals with diabetes will develop kidney disease owing to their disease and/or other comorbidity, including hypertension and ageingrelated nephron loss. The presence and severity of chronic kidney disease (CKD) identify individuals who are at increased risk of adverse health outcomes and premature mortality. Consequently, preventing and managing CKD in patients with diabetes is now a key aim of their overall management. Intensive management of patients with diabetes includes controlling blood glucose levels and blood pressure as well as blockade of the reninangiotensin- aldosterone system; these approaches will reduce the incidence of diabetic kidney disease and slow its progression. Indeed, the major decline in the incidence of diabetic kidney disease (DKD) over the past 30 years and improved patient prognosis are largely attributable to improved diabetes care. However, there remains an unmet need for innovative treatment strategies to prevent, arrest, treat and reverse DKD. In this Primer, we summarize what is now known about the molecular pathogenesis of CKD in patients with diabetes and the key pathways and targets implicated in its progression. In addition, we discuss the current evidence for the prevention and management of DKD as well as the many controversies. Finally, we explore the opportunities to develop new interventions through urgently needed investment in dedicated and focused research. For an illustrated summary of this Primer, visit: http://go.nature.com/NKHDzg.
paragraphs.chinese: 肾脏无疑是糖尿病微血管损伤最重要的靶器官。相当一部分糖尿病患者会因其疾病和/或其他合并症（包括高血压和与年 龄相关的肾单位丧失）而发展为肾脏疾病。慢性肾脏病（CKD）的存在及其严重程度，标志着患者面临更高的不良健康 结局和过早死亡风险。因此，预防和管理糖尿病患者的CKD已成为其整体治疗的关键目标。对糖尿病患者的强化管理包 括控制血糖和血压，以及阻断肾素血管紧张素醛固酮系统；这些措施将降低糖尿病肾病的发病率并延缓其进展。事实 上，过去30年间糖尿病肾病（DKD）发病率的大幅下降和患者预后的改善，很大程度上归功于糖尿病护理的进步。然 而，在预防、阻止、治疗和逆转DKD方面山，创新治疗策略的需求仍未得到满足。在本篇《基础指南》中，我们总结了目 前对糖尿病患者CKD分子发病机制的认识，以及与其进展相关的关键通路和靶点。此外，我们讨论了当前关于DKD预防 和管理的证据以及诸多争议。梦最后，我们探讨了通过对专门和重点研究的急需投资来开发新干预措施的机会。如需查看 本指南的图解摘要，请访问：http://go.nature.com/NKHDzg。

literature.title: Lowdose metformin targets the lysosomal AMPK pathway through PEN2
literature.title_chinese: 低剂量二甲双胍通过PEN2靶向溶酶体AMPK通路

paragraphs.english: AbstractMetformin, the most prescribed antidiabetic medicine, has shown other benefits such as antiageing and anticancer effects1–4. For clinical doses of metformin, AMPactivated protein kinase (AMPK) has a major role in its mechanism of action4,5; however, the direct molecular target of metformin remains unknown. Here we show that clinically relevant concentrations of metformin inhibit the lysosomal proton pump vATPase, which is a central node for AMPK activation following glucose starvation6. We synthesize a photoactive metformin probe and identify PEN2, a subunit of γ-secretase7, as a binding partner of metformin with a dissociation constant at micromolar levels. metforminbound PEN2 forms a complex with ATP6AP1, a subunit of the vATPase8, which leads to the inhibition of vATPase and the activation of AMPK without effects on cellular AMP levels. knockout of PEN2 or reintroduction of a PEN2 mutant that does not bind ATP6AP1 blunts AMPK activation. In vivo, liverspecific knockout of Pen2 abolishes metforminmediated reduction of hepatic fat content, whereas intestinespecific knockout of Pen2 impairs its glucoselowering effects. Furthermore, knockdown of pen-2 in Caenorhabditis elegans abrogates metformininduced extension of lifespan. Together, these findings reveal that metformin binds PEN2 and initiates a signalling route that intersects, through ATP6AP1, the lysosomal glucosesensing pathway for AMPK activation. This ensures that metformin exerts its therapeutic benefits in patients without substantial adverse effects.
paragraphs.chinese: 摘要二甲双胍是最常用的抗糖尿病药物，并显示出抗衰老和抗癌等其他益处1-4。对于临床剂量的二甲双胍，AMP激活 的蛋白激酶（AMPK）在其作用机制中起主要作用4,5；然而，二甲双胍的直接分子靶点仍然未知。本文表明，临床相关 浓度的二甲双胍可抑制溶酶体质子泵v-ATPase，这是葡萄糖饥饿后激活AMPK的核心节点6。我们合成了一种光活性二甲 双胍探针，并鉴定出γ-分泌酶7的亚基PEN2作为二甲双胍的结合伴侣，其解离常数在微摩尔水平。与二甲双胍结合的 PEN2与v-ATPase8的亚基ATP6AP1形成复合物，从而抑制v-ATPase并激活AMPK，而不影响细胞AMP水平。敲除PEN2 或重新引入不结合ATP6AP1的PEN2突变体会削弱AMPK的激活。在体内，肝脏特异性敲除Pen2消除了二甲双胍介导的 肝脏脂肪含量降低，而肠道特异性敲除Pen2则损害了其降血糖效果。此外，在秀丽隐杆线虫中敲低pen-2会消除二甲双 胍诱导的寿命延长。总之，这些发现揭示了二甲双胍结合PEN2并启动一条信号通路，该通路通过ATP6AP1与溶酶体葡萄 糖感应途径相交，从而激活AMPK。这确保了二甲双胍在患者中发挥其治疗益处而不会产生显著的不良反应。

literature.title: Metformin: Update on mechanisms of action and repurposing potential
literature.title_chinese: 二甲双胍：作用机制与再利用潜力的最新进展

paragraphs.english: Currently, metformin is the firstline medication to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in most guidelines and is used daily by >200 million patients. Surprisingly, the mechanisms underlying its therapeutic action are complex and are still not fully understood. Early evidence highlighted the liver as the major organ involved in the effect of metformin on reducing blood levels of glucose. However, increasing evidence points towards other sites of action that might also have an important role, including the gastrointestinal tract, the gut microbial communities and the tissueresident immune cells. At the molecular level, it seems that the mechanisms of action vary depending on the dose of metformin used and duration of treatment. Initial studies have shown that metformin targets hepatic mitochondria; however, the identification of a novel target at low concentrations of metformin at the lysosome surface might reveal a new mechanism of action. Based on the efficacy and safety records in T2DM, attention has been given to the repurposing of metformin as part of adjunct therapy for the treatment of cancer, agerelated diseases, inflammatory diseases and COVID-19. In this Review, we highlight the latest advances in our understanding of the mechanisms of action of metformin and discuss potential emerging novel therapeutic uses.
paragraphs.chinese: 目前，在大多数指南中，二甲双胍是治疗2型糖尿病的一线药物，每日使用患者超过2亿。令人惊讶的是，其治疗作用的 机制复杂且尚未完全明了。早期证据强调肝脏是二甲双胍降低血糖水平的主要作用器官。然而，越来越多的证据指向其 他可能也起重要作用的作用部位，包括胃肠道、肠道微生物群落和组织驻留免疫细胞。在分子水平上，其作用机制似乎 因二甲双胍的剂量和治疗持续时间而异。初步研究表明，二甲双胍靶向肝线粒体；然而，在低浓度二甲双胍作用下，溶 酶体表面新靶点的发现可能揭示了一种新的作用机制。基于其在2型糖尿病中的疗效和安全性记录，人们开始关注将二甲 双胍重新用作癌症、年龄相关疾病、炎症性疾病和COVID-19辅助治疗的一部分。在本综述中，我们重点介绍了对二甲双 胍作用机制理解的最新进展，并讨论了其潜在的新兴治疗用途。

literature.title: Endothelial AGGF1 promotes retinal angiogenesis by coordinating TNFSF12/FN14 signalling
literature.title_chinese: 内皮AGGF1通过协调TNFSF12/FN14信号促进视网膜血管生成

paragraphs.english: Abnormal angiogenesis is a key process associated with ischaemic retinopathies such as diabetic retinopathy, for which the underlying pathological mechanisms are still poorly understood. Here, we confirm that angiogenic factor 1 with a G patch and FHA domain (AGGF1) is elevated in the diabetics and induces retinal angiogenesis. Mechanistic investigations demonstrate that HIF-1α directly regulates AGGF1 expression. AGGF1 upregulates the expression of cell cycle proteins by increasing the binding of tumour necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 12 (TNFSF12) to fibroblast -growth -factor- inducible 14 (FN14, TNFRSF12A). Furthermore, targeting AGGF1 attenuates pathological neovascularisation in ischaemic retinopathy. Additionally, we discover that sodiumglucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) could inhibit the AGGF1 signalling pathway early to achieve therapeutic effects. Overall, we elucidate the mechanism underlying pathological retinal angiogenesis involved in endothelial AGGF1-dependent events and highlight a therapy for the effective treatment of ischaemic retinopathy.
paragraphs.chinese: 异常血管生成是与缺血性视网膜病变（如糖尿病视网膜病变）相关的关键过程，其潜在的病理机制尚不清楚。本文证 实，具有G斑块和FHA结构域的血管生成因子1（AGGF1）在糖尿病患者中升高并诱导视网膜血管生成。机制研究表明， HIF-1α直接调控AGGF1的表达。AGGF1通过增加肿瘤坏死因子配体超家族成员12（TNFSF12）与成纤维细胞生长因子 诱导型14（FN14，TNFRSF12A）的结合，上调细胞周期蛋白的表达。此外，靶向AGGF1可减轻缺血性视网膜病变中的 病理性新生血管形成。另外，我们发现钠葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）可早期抑制AGGF1信号通路，从而达 到治疗效果。总之，我们阐明了涉及内皮AGGF1依赖性事件的病理性视网膜血管生成的机制，并强调了一种有效治疗缺 血性视网膜病变的方法。

literature.title: Diabetic retinopathy
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病视网膜病变

paragraphs.english: diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a common complication of diabetes mellitus and is a major cause of vision loss in middleaged and elderly people. Onethird of people with diabetes have DR. Severe stages of DR include proliferative DR, caused by the abnormal growth of new retinal blood vessels, and diabetic macular oedema, in which there is exudation and oedema in the central part of the retina. DR is strongly associated with a prolonged duration of diabetes, hyperglycaemia and hypertension. It is traditionally regarded as a microvascular disease, but retinal neurodegeneration is also involved. Complex interrelated pathophysiological mechanisms triggered by hyperglycaemia underlie the development of DR. These mechanisms include genetic and epigenetic factors, increased production of free radicals, advanced glycosylation end products, inflammatory factors and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF). Optimal control of blood glucose and blood pressure in individuals with diabetes remains the cornerstone for preventing the development and arresting the progression of DR. AntiVEGF therapy is currently indicated for diabetic macular oedema associated with vision loss, whereas laser photocoagulation prevents severe vision loss in eyes with proliferative DR. These measures, together with increasing public awareness and access to regular screening for DR with retinal photography, and the development of new treatments to address early disease stages, will lead to better outcomes and prevent blindness for patients with DR.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）是糖尿病的常见并发症，也是中老年人视力丧失的主要原因。三分之一的糖尿病患者患有DR。 DR的严重阶段包括由视网膜新生血管异常生长引起的增殖性DR，以及糖尿病性黄斑水肿，即视网膜中央部分出现渗出和 水肿。DR与糖尿病病程延长、高血糖和高血压密切相关。传统上，DR被视为一种微血管疾病，但视网膜神经退行性变也 参与其中。高血糖引发的复杂且相互关联的病理生理机制是DR发展的基础。这些机制包括遗传和表观遗传因素、自由基 产生增加、晚期糖基化终末产物、炎症因子和血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）。对糖尿病患者血糖和血压的最佳控制仍然是 预防DR发生和阻止其进展的基石。目前，抗VEGF疗法适用于与视力丧失相关的糖尿病性黄斑水肿，而激光光凝术可预 防增殖性DR患者的严重视力丧失。这些措施，加上提高公众意识、通过视网膜摄影进行定期筛查的普及，以及针对疾病 早期阶段的新疗法的开发，将为DR患者带来更好的预后并预防失明。

literature.title: Diabetic ketoacidosis
literature.title_chinese: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒

paragraphs.english: diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) is the most common acute hyperglycaemic emergency in people with diabetes mellitus. A diagnosis of DKA is confirmed when all of the three criteria are present - 'D', either elevated blood glucose levels or a family history of diabetes mellitus; 'K', the presence of high urinary or blood ketoacids; and 'A', a high anion gap metabolic acidosis. Early diagnosis and management are paramount to improve patient outcomes. The mainstays of treatment include restoration of circulating volume, insulin therapy, electrolyte replacement and treatment of any underlying precipitating event. Without optimal treatment, DKA remains a condition with appreciable, although largely preventable, morbidity and mortality. In this Primer, we discuss the epidemiology, pathogenesis, risk factors and diagnosis of DKA and provide practical recommendations for the management of DKA in adults and children.
paragraphs.chinese: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒（DKA）是糖尿病患者中最常见的急性高血糖急症。当以下三个标准同时满足时即可确诊DKA ——"D"指血糖水平升高或糖尿病家族史；"K"指尿液或血液中酮酸水平升高；"A"指高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒。早期诊 断和处理对改善患者预后至关重要。治疗核心包括恢复循环血量、胰岛素治疗、电解质补充以及处理任何潜在的诱发事 件。若未获得最佳治疗，DKA仍会带来显著（但基本可预防）的发病率和死亡率。本入究门指南将探讨DKA的流行病学、 发病机制、危险因素和诊断方法，并为成人和儿童DKA的管理提供实用建议。

literature.title: Hepatic krüppellike factor 16 (KLF16) targets PPARα to improve steatohepatitis and insulin resistance
literature.title_chinese: 肝Krüppel样因子16（KLF16）靶向PPARα改善脂肪性肝炎和胰岛素抵抗

paragraphs.english: ObjectiveImpaired hepatic fatty acids oxidation results in lipid accumulation and redox imbalance, promoting the development of fatty liver diseases and insulin resistance. However, the underlying pathogenic mechanism is poorly understood. Krüppellike factor 16 (KLF16) is a transcription factor that abounds in liver. We explored whether and by what mechanisms KLF16 affects hepatic lipid catabolism to improve hepatosteatosis and insulin resistance.DesignKLF16 expression was determined in patients with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and mice models. The role of KLF16 in the regulation of lipid metabolism was investigated using hepatocytespecific KLF16-deficient mice fed a highfat diet (HFD) or using an adenovirus/adenoassociated virus to alter KLF16 expression in mouse primary hepatocytes (MPHs) and in vivo livers. RNAseq, luciferase reporter gene assay and ChIP analysis served to explore the molecular mechanisms involved.ResultsKLF16 expression was decreased in patients with NAFLD, mice models and oleic acid and palmitic acid (OA and PA) cochallenged hepatocytes. Hepatic KLF16 knockout impaired fatty acid oxidation, aggravated mitochondrial stress, ROS burden, advancing hepatic steatosis and insulin resistance. Conversely, KLF16 overexpression reduced lipid deposition and improved insulin resistance via directly binding the promoter of peroxisome proliferatoractivated receptor α (PPARα) to accelerate fatty acids oxidation and attenuate mitochondrial stress, oxidative stress indb/dband HFD mice. PPARα deficiency diminished the KLF16-evoked protective effects against lipid deposition in MPHs. Hepaticspecific PPARα overexpression effectively rescued KLF16 deficiencyinduced hepatic steatosis, altered redox balance and insulin resistance.ConclusionsThese findings prove that a direct KLF16–PPARα pathway closely links hepatic lipid homeostasis and redox balance, whose dysfunction promotes insulin resistance and hepatic steatosis.
paragraphs.chinese: 目的肝脏脂肪酸氧化受损导致脂质积累和氧化还原失衡，促进脂肪肝疾病和胰岛素抵抗的发展。然而，其潜在的致病机 制尚不清楚。Krüppel样因子16（KLF16山）是一种在肝脏中丰富的转录因子。我们探讨了KLF16是否以及通过何种机制影 响肝脏脂质分解代谢，以改善肝脂肪变性和胰岛素抵抗。设计在非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）患者和小鼠模型中测定 KLF16的表达。通过使用高脂饮食（HFD）喂养的肝细胞特异性KLF16缺陷小鼠，或使用腺病毒/腺相关病毒改变小鼠原 代肝细胞（MPHs）和体内肝脏中KLF16的表达，研究KLF16在脂质代谢调控中的作用。RNA测序、荧光素酶报告基因检 测和ChIP分析用于探索相关分子机制。结果在NAFLD患者、小鼠模型以及油酸和棕榈酸（OA和PA）共刺激的肝细胞 中，KLF16表达降低。肝脏KLF16敲除损害了脂肪酸氧化，加剧了线粒体应激和ROS负担，促进了肝脏脂肪变性和胰岛素 抵抗。相反，KLF16过表达通过直接结合过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（PPARα）的启动子，加速脂肪酸氧化并减轻线 粒体应激和氧化应激，从而减少脂质沉积并改善胰岛素抵抗，这在db/db和HFD小鼠中得到验证。PPARα缺失削弱了 KLF16在MPHs中对脂质沉积的保护作用。肝脏特异性PPARα过表达有效挽救了KLF16缺失引起的肝脏脂肪变性、氧化还 原平衡改变和胰岛素抵抗。结论这些发现证明，KLF16–PPARα直接通路紧密连接肝脏脂质稳态和氧化还原平衡，其功能 障碍促进胰岛素抵抗和肝脏脂肪变性。

literature.title: Steatotic liver disease
literature.title_chinese: 脂肪肝病

paragraphs.english: steatotic liver disease is the overarching term for conditions characterised by abnormal lipid accumulation in the liver (liver or hepatic steatosis). steatotic liver disease encompasses what was previously termed nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is now called metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Additionally, steatotic liver disease includes alcoholrelated liver disease (ALD) and MetALD, the new classification for the overlap between MASLD and ALD, and rare causes of liver steatosis. cirrhosis is globally the 11th leading cause of death, and steatotic liver disease has become the leading cause of cirrhosis in the EU and USA. steatotic liver disease affects around 30% of the global population and is mainly driven by obesity, type 2 diabetes, and alcohol intake, but only a minor proportion with steatotic liver disease progress to cirrhosis. The presence and progression of liver fibrosis led by hepatic inflammation is the main predictor of liverrelated death across the entire spectrum of steatotic liver diseases. A combination of recent advancements of widely available biomarkers for early detection of liver fibrosis together with considerable advancements in therapeutic interventions offer the possibility to reduce morbidity and mortality in patients with steatotic liver disease. This Seminar covers the recent reclassification of steatotic liver disease and how it reflects clinical practice and prognosis. For early detection of liver fibrosis, we propose a collaborative diagnostic framework between primary care and liver specialists. Lastly, we discuss current best practices for managing steatotic liver disease, we explore therapeutic targets across the spectrum of steatotic liver diseases, and we review the pipeline of drugs in development for MASLD.
paragraphs.chinese: 脂肪性肝病是描述肝脏异常脂质积聚（肝脏或肝脂肪变性）相关疾病的总称。脂肪性肝病涵盖了先前被称为非酒精性脂 肪性肝病（NAFLD）的疾病，现称为代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）。此外，脂肪性肝病还包括酒精相关性肝 病（ALD）以及MetALD（MASLD与ALD重叠的新分类）和罕见的肝脂肪变性病因。肝硬化在全球范围内是第11大死 因，而脂肪性肝病已成为欧盟和美国肝硬化的主要原因。全球约30%的人口受脂肪性肝病影响，其主要驱动因素为肥 胖、2型糖尿病和酒精摄入，但仅有少数脂肪性肝病患者会进展为肝硬化。由肝脏炎症引发的肝纤维化的存在和进展是预 测所有类型脂肪性肝病相关死亡的主要指标。近期广泛可用的生物标志物在早期检测肝纤维化方面的进展，结合治疗干 预手段的显著进步，为降低脂肪性肝病患者的发病率和死亡率提供了可能。本次研讨会涵盖了脂肪性肝病的最新重新分 类及其如何反映临床实践和预后。为早期检测肝纤维化，我们提出了初级保健与肝脏专科医生之间的协作诊断框架。最 后，我们讨论了当前管理脂肪性肝病的最佳实践，探索了脂肪性肝病谱系中的治疗靶点，并回顾了针对MASLD正在研发 的药物管线。

literature.title: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease
literature.title_chinese: 非酒精性脂肪肝病

paragraphs.english: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) has a global prevalence of 25% and is a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. NAFLD encompasses a disease continuum from steatosis with or without mild inflammation (nonalcoholic fatty liver), to nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), which is characterised by necroinflammation and faster fibrosis progression than nonalcoholic fatty liver. NAFLD has a bidirectional association with components of the metabolic syndrome, and type 2 diabetes increases the risk of cirrhosis and related complications. Although the leading causes of death in people with NAFLD are cardiovascular disease and extrahepatic malignancy, advanced liver fibrosis is a key prognostic marker for liverrelated outcomes and overall mortality, and can be assessed with combinations of noninvasive tests. Patients with cirrhosis should be screened for hepatocellular carcinoma and oesophageal varices. There is currently no approved therapy for NAFLD, although several drugs are in advanced stages of development. Because of the complex pathophysiology and substantial heterogeneity of disease phenotypes, combination treatment is likely to be required for many patients with NAFLD. Healthy lifestyle and weight reduction remain crucial to the prevention and treatment of NAFLD.
paragraphs.chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）全球患病率为25%，是导致肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要原因。NAFLD涵盖从伴有或不伴有 轻度炎症的脂肪变性（非酒精性脂肪肝）到非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的疾病连续谱，后者以坏死性炎症和比非酒精 性脂肪肝更快的纤维化进展为特征。NAFLD与代谢综合征各组分存在双向关联，2型糖尿病会增加肝硬化及相关并发症 的风险。尽管NAFLD患者的主要死因是心血管疾病和肝外恶性肿瘤，但晚期肝纤维化是肝脏相关结局和总体死亡率的关 键预后标志，可通过非侵入性检测组合进行评估。肝硬化患者应筛查肝细胞癌和食管静脉曲张。目前尚无获批的NAFLD 治疗方法，尽管有几种药物处于研发后期阶段。由于复杂的病理生理学和疾病表型的显著异质性，许多NAFLD患者可能 需要联合治疗。健康的生活方式和减重对于NAFLD的预防和治疗仍然至关重要。

literature.title: MAFLD: How is it different from NAFLD?
literature.title_chinese: MAFLD：与NAFLD有何不同？

paragraphs.english: “metabolic dysfunctionassociated fatty liver disease (MAFLD)” is the term suggested in 2020 to refer to fatty liver disease related to systemic metabolic dysregulation. The name change from nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) to MAFLD comes with a simple set of criteria to enable easy diagnosis at the bedside for the general medical community, including primary care physicians. Since the introduction of the term, there have been key areas in which the superiority of MAFLD over the traditional NAFLD terminology has been demonstrated, including for the risk of liver and extrahepatic mortality, disease associations, and for identifying highrisk individuals. Additionally, MAFLD has been adopted by a number of leading pannational and national societies due to its concise diagnostic criterion, removal of the requirement to exclude concomitant liver diseases, and reduction in the stigma associated with this condition. The current article explores the differences between MAFLD and NAFLD diagnosis, areas of benefit, some potential limitations, and how the MAFLD terminology has opened up new fields of research.
paragraphs.chinese: “代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MAFLD）”是2020年提出的术语，用于指代与全身代谢失调相关的脂肪性肝病。从非 酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）更名为MAFLD，附带了一套简单的诊断标准，便于包括初级保健医生在内的广大医学界在 床边进行诊断。自该术语引入以来，MAFLD在多个关键领域显示出优于传统NAFLD术语的特点，包括肝脏及肝外死亡风 险、疾病关联性以及高风险人群识别等方面。此外，由于其诊断标准简洁、无需排除伴随性肝病，并减少了与此病症相 关的污名化，MAFLD已被多个领先的跨国及国家级学会采纳。本文探讨了MAFLD与NAFLD诊断的差异、受益领域、一 些潜在局限性，以及MAFLD术语如何开辟了新的研究领域。

literature.title: Hepatic selective insulin resistance at the intersection of insulin signaling and metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease
literature.title_chinese: 肝脏选择性胰岛素抵抗在胰岛素信号传导与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病的交汇点

paragraphs.english: insulin resistance (IR) is a major pathogenic factor in the progression of MASLD. In the liver, insulin suppresses gluconeogenesis and enhances de novo lipogenesis (DNL). During IR, there is a defect in insulinmediated suppression of gluconeogenesis, but an unrestrained increase in hepatic lipogenesis persists. The mechanism of increased hepatic steatosis in IR is unclear and remains controversial. The key discrepancy is whether insulin retains its ability to directly regulate hepatic lipogenesis. Blocking insulin/IRS/AKT signaling reduces liver lipid deposition in IR, suggesting insulin can still regulate lipid metabolism; hepatic glucose metabolism that bypasses insulin's action may contribute to lipogenesis; and due to peripheral IR, other tissues are likely to impact liver lipid deposition. We here review the current understanding of insulin's action in governing different aspects of hepatic lipid metabolism under normal and IR states, with the purpose of highlighting the essential issues that remain unsettled.
paragraphs.chinese: 胰岛素抵抗（IR）是MASLD进展中的一个主要致病因素。在肝脏中，胰岛素抑制糖异生并促进新生脂肪生成（DNL）。 在IR状态下，胰岛素介导的糖异生抑制存在缺陷，但肝脏脂肪生成却不受控制地持续增加。IR状态下肝脏脂肪变性增加 的机制尚不明确，且存在争议。关键分歧在于胰岛素是否仍保留直接调控肝脏脂肪生成的能力。阻断胰岛素/IRS/AKT信 号通路可减少IR状态下的肝脏脂质沉积，表明胰岛素仍能调控脂质代谢；绕过胰岛素作用的肝脏葡萄糖代谢可能促进脂 肪生成；由于外周IR，其他组织也可能影响肝脏脂质沉积。本文综述了目前对正常及IR状态下胰岛素调控肝脏脂质代谢 不同方面的理解，旨在强调尚未解决的核心问题。

literature.title: Pathogenesis and treatment of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis and its fibrosis
literature.title_chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝炎及其纤维化的发病机制与治疗

paragraphs.english: The initial presentation of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) is hepatic steatosis. The dysfunction of lipid metabolism within hepatocytes caused by genetic factors, diet, and insulin resistance causes lipid accumulation. lipotoxicity, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and endoplasmic reticulum stress would further contribute to hepatocyte injury and death, leading to inflammation and immune dysfunction in the liver. During the healing process, the accumulation of an excessive amount of fibrosis might occur while healing. During the development of NASH and liver fibrosis, the gutliver axis, adiposeliver axis, and reninangiotensin system (RAS) may be dysregulated and impaired. Translocation of bacteria or its endproducts entering the liver could activate hepatocytes, Kupffer cells, and hepatic stellate cells, exacerbating hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis. bile acids regulate glucose and lipid metabolism through Farnesoid X receptors in the liver and intestine. Increased adipose tissuederived nonesterified fatty acids would aggravate hepatic steatosis. Increased leptin also plays a role in hepatic fibrogenesis, and decreased adiponectin may contribute to hepatic insulin resistance. Moreover, dysregulation of peroxisome proliferatoractivated receptors in the liver, adipose, and muscle tissues may impair lipid metabolism. In addition, the RAS may contribute to hepatic fatty acid metabolism究, inflammation, and fibrosis. The treatment includes lifestyle modification, pharmacological therapy, and nonpharmacological therapy. Currently, weight reduction by lifestyle modification or surgery is the most effective therapy. However, vitamin E, pioglitazone, and obeticholic acid have also been suggested. In this review, we will introduce some new clinical trials and experimental therapies for the treatment of NASH and related fibrosis.
paragraphs.chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的初始表现为肝脏脂肪变性。由遗传因素、饮食和胰岛素抵抗引起的肝细胞内脂质代谢功 能障碍导致脂质积累。脂毒性、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和内质网应激会进一步导致肝细胞损伤和死亡，引发肝脏炎 症和免疫功能紊乱。在愈合过程中，可能会出现过量的纤维化积累。在NASH和肝纤维化的发展过程中，肠肝轴、脂肪- 肝轴和肾素血管紧张素系统（RAS）可能出现失调和损伤。细菌或其终产物易位进入肝脏可能激活肝细胞、库普弗细胞 和肝星状细胞，加剧肝脏脂肪变性、炎症和纤维化。胆汁酸通过肝脏和肠道中的法尼醇X受体调节葡萄糖和脂质代谢。脂 肪组织来源的非酯化脂肪酸增加会加重肝脏脂肪变性。瘦素增加也在肝纤维化中发挥作用，而脂联素减少可能导致肝脏 胰岛素抵抗。此外，肝脏、脂肪和肌肉组织中过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体的失调可能损害脂质代谢。另外，RAS可能 影响肝脏脂肪酸代谢、炎症和纤维化。治疗包括生活方式调整、药物治疗和非药物治疗。目前，通过生活方式调整或手 术减轻体重是最有效的治疗方法。然而，维生素E、吡格列酮和奥贝胆酸也被建议使用。在本综述中，我们将介绍一些治 疗NASH及相关纤维化的新临床试验和实验性疗法。

literature.title: Metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease: Heterogeneous pathomechanisms and effectiveness of metabolismbased treatment
literature.title_chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病：异质性病理机制及基于代谢治疗的有效性

paragraphs.english: The global epidemic of metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is increasing worldwide. People with MASLD can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma and are at increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and extrahepatic cancers. Most people with MASLD die from cardiacrelated causes. This outcome is attributed to the shared pathogenesis of MASLD and cardiometabolic diseases, involving unhealthy dietary habits, dysfunctional adipose tissue, insulin resistance, and subclinical inflammation. In addition, the steatotic and inflamed liver affects the vasculature and heart via increased glucose production and release of procoagulant factors, dyslipidaemia, and dysregulated release of hepatokines and microRNAs. However, there is substantial heterogeneity in the contributors to the pathophysiology of MASLD, which might influence its rate of progression, its relationship with cardiometabolic diseases, and the response to therapy. The most effective nonpharmacological treatment approaches for people with MASLD include weight loss. Paradoxically, some effective pharmacological approaches to improve liver health in people with MASLD are associated with no change in bodyweight or even with weight gain, and similar response heterogeneity has been observed for changes in cardiometabolic risk factors. In this Review, we address the heterogeneity of MASLD with respect to its pathogenesis, outcomes, and metabolismbased treatment responses. Although there is currently insufficient evidence for the implementation of precision medicine for risk prediction, prevention, and treatment of MASLD, we discuss whether knowledge about this heterogeneity might help achieving this goal in the future.
paragraphs.chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的全球流行率侵正在世界范围内上升。MASLD患者可能进展为肝硬化和肝细胞 癌，并面临更高的2型糖尿病、心血管疾病、慢性肾病及肝外癌症风险。多数MASLD患者最终死于心脏相关病因，这一 结果归因于MASLD与心脏代谢疾病共有的发病机制-，涉及不健康的饮食习惯、脂肪组织功能障碍、胰岛素抵抗及亚临床 炎症。此外，脂肪变性且存在炎症的肝脏通过增加葡萄糖生成、释放促凝血因子、血脂异常以及肝因子和微小RNA的失 调释放，影响血管系统和心脏。然而，MASLD病理生理学的驱动因素存在显著异质性，这可能影响其进展速度、与心脏 代谢疾病的关系以及对治疗的反应。对MASLD患者最有效的非药物治疗方法包括减重。矛盾的是，某些改善MASLD患 者肝脏健康的有效药物治疗方法并未伴随体重变化甚至可能导致体重增加，心脏代谢风险因素的变化也观察到类似的反 应异质性。本综述探讨了MASLD在发病机制、临床结局及基于代谢的治疗反应方面的异质性。尽管目前实施精准医学进 行MASLD风险预测、预防和治疗尚缺乏充分证据，但我们讨论了关于这种异质性的认识是否有助于未来实现这一目标。

literature.title: Sexual dimorphism of metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease
literature.title_chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病的性别二态性

paragraphs.english: Metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common chronic liver condition. MASLD is a sexually dimorphic condition, with its development and progression influenced by sex chromosomes and hormones. estrogens typically protect against, whereas androgens promote, MASLD. Therapeutic approaches for a sexspecific personalized medicine include estrogen replacement, androgen blockers, and novel drugs targeting hormonal pathways. However, the interactions between hormonal factors and inherited genetic variation impacts MASLD risk, necessitating more tailored therapies. Understanding sex disparities and the role of estrogens could improve MASLD interventions and management, whereas clinical trials addressing sex differences are crucial for advancing personalized treatment. This review explores the underappreciated impact of sexual dimorphism in MASLD and discusses the potential therapeutic application of sexrelated hormones.
paragraphs.chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是最常见的慢性肝脏疾病。MASLD具有性别二态性，其发生和发展受性染色 体和激素的影响。雌激素通常对MASLD具有保护作用，而雄激素则促进其发展。针对性别特异性个体化医疗的治疗方法 包括雌激素替代疗法、雄激素阻断剂以及靶向激素通路的新型药物。然而，激素因素与遗传变异之间的相互作用影响 MASLD风险，因此需要更精准的治疗方案。理解性别差异及雌激素的作用有助于改进MASLD的干预与管理，而针对性 别差异的临床试验对于推进个体化治疗至关重要。本综述探讨了性别二态性在MASLD中未被充分认识的影响，并讨论了 性激素潜在的治疗应用。

literature.title: Current and future pharmacological therapies for NAFLD/NASH
literature.title_chinese: 当前及未来针对NAFLD/NASH的药理疗法

paragraphs.english: nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is the most prevalent liver disease worldwide, and there is no approved pharmacotherapy. The efficacy of vitamin E and pioglitazone has been established in nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), a progressive form of NAFLD. GLP-1RA and SGLT2 inhibitors, which are currently approved for use in diabetes, have shown early efficacy in NASH, and also have beneficial cardiovascular or renal effects. Innovative NASH therapies include four main pathways. The first approach is targeting hepatic fat accumulation. Medications in this approach include modulation of peroxisome proliferatoractivator receptors (e.g., pemafibrate, elafibranor), medications targeting farnesoid X receptor axis [obeticholic acid; OCA)], inhibitors of de novo lipogenesis (aramchol, ACC inhibitor), and fibroblast growth factor-21 analogues. A second target is oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis. This class of drug includes apoptosis signaling kinase 1 (ASK1) inhibitor and emricasan (an irreversible caspase inhibitor). A third target is intestinal microbiomes and metabolic endotoxemia. Several agents are in ongoing trials, including IMMe124, TLR4 antagonist, and solithromycin (macrolide antibiotics). The final target is hepatic fibrosis, which is strongly associated with allcause or liverrelated mortality in NASH. Antifibrotic agents are a cysteinecysteine motif chemokine receptor-2/5 antagonist (cenicriviroc; CVC) and galectin 3 antagonist. Among a variety of medications in development, four agents such as OCA, elafibranor, ASK1 inhibitor, and CVC are currently being evaluated in an international phase 3 trial for the treatment of NASH. Within the next few years, the availability of therapeutic options for NASH will hopefully curb 必the rising trend of NASHrelated diseases.
paragraphs.chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）是全球范围内最普遍的肝脏疾病，目前尚无获批的药物治疗方案。维生素E和吡格列酮在 非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH，NAFLD的一种进展形式）中的疗效已得到证实。目前获批用于糖尿病的GLP-1RA和 SGLT2抑制剂在NASH中显示出早期疗效，并对心血管或肾脏具有有益影响。创新的NASH疗法主要包括四种途径。第一 种方法是针对肝脏脂肪积累。此类药物包括调节过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（如培马贝特、埃拉贝特）、靶向法尼醇X 受体轴的药物（奥贝胆酸；OCA）、抑制新生脂肪生成的药物（阿拉姆科尔、ACC抑制剂）以及成纤维细胞生长因子-21 类似物。第二个靶点是氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。这类药物包括凋亡信号调节激酶1（ASK1）抑制剂和埃米卡桑（一 种不可逆的caspase抑制剂）梦。第三个靶点是肠道微生物群和代谢性内毒素血症。目前正在进行试验的药物包括 IMMe124、TLR4拮抗剂和索利霉素（大环内酯类抗生素）。最后一个靶点是肝纤维化，这与NASH患者的全因死亡率或 肝脏相关死亡率密切相关。抗纤维化药物包括半胱氨酸半胱氨酸基序趋化因子受体-2/5拮抗剂（塞尼克里韦罗克； CVC）和半乳糖凝集素3拮抗剂。在众多研发药物中，OCA、埃拉贝特、ASK1抑制剂和CVC等四种药物目前正在国际三 期试验中评估其治疗NASH的效果。未来几年内，NASH治疗方案的推出有望遏制NASH相关疾病的上升趋势。

literature.title: Emerging therapeutic approaches for the treatment of NAFLD and type 2 diabetes mellitus
literature.title_chinese: 非酒精性脂肪肝病与2型糖尿病治疗的新兴疗法

paragraphs.english: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) has emerged as the most prevalent liver disease in the world, yet there are still no approved pharmacological therapies to prevent or treat this condition. NAFLD encompasses a spectrum of severity, ranging from simple steatosis to nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH). Although NASH is linked to an increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma and cirrhosis and has now become the leading cause of liver failurerelated transplantation, the majority of patients with NASH will ultimately die as a result of complications of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and cardiometabolic diseases. Importantly, NAFLD is closely linked to obesity and tightly interrelated with insulin resistance and T2DM. Thus, targeting these interconnected conditions and taking a holistic attitude to the treatment of metabolic disease could prove to be a very beneficial approach. This Review will explore the latest relevant literature and discuss the ongoing therapeutic options for NAFLD focused on targeting intermediary metabolism, insulin resistance and T2DM to remedy the global health burden of these diseases.
paragraphs.chinese: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）已成为全球最常见的肝脏疾病，但目前尚无获批的药物疗法来预防或治疗此病。NAFLD 涵盖了一系列严重程度，从简单的脂肪变性到非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）。尽管NASH与肝细胞癌和肝硬化的风险增 加有关，并已成为肝衰竭相关移植的主要原因，但大多数NASH患者最终将死于2型糖尿病（T2DM）和心脏代谢疾病的 并发症。重要的是，NAFLD与肥胖密切相关，并与胰岛素抵抗和T2DM紧密相关。因此，针对这些相互关联的疾病，并 采取整体态度治疗代谢性疾病，可能被证明是一种非常有益的方法。本综述将探讨最新的相关文献，并讨论针对NAFLD 的持续治疗选择，重点关注靶向中间代谢、胰岛素抵抗和T2DM，以减轻这些疾病的全球健康负担。

literature.title: Circadian rhythms in the pathogenesis and treatment of fatty liver disease
literature.title_chinese: 昼夜节律在脂肪肝疾病发病机制与治疗中的作用

paragraphs.english: circadian clock proteins are endogenous timing mechanisms that control the transcription of hundreds of genes. Their integral role in coordinating metabolism has led to their scrutiny in a number of diseases, including nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). Discoordination between central and peripheral circadian rhythms is a core feature of nearly every genetic, dietary, or environmental model of metabolic syndrome and NAFLD. Restricting feeding to a defined daily interval (timerestricted feeding) can synchronize the central and peripheral circadian rhythms, which in turn can prevent or even treat the metabolic syndrome and hepatic steatosis. Importantly, a number of proteins currently under study as drug targets in NAFLD (sterol regulatory elementbinding protein [SREBP], acetylCoA carboxylase [ACC], peroxisome proliferator- activator receptors [PPARs], and incretins) are modulated by circadian proteins. Thus, the clock can be used to maximize the benefits and minimize the adverse effects of pharmaceutical agents for NAFLD. The circadian clock itself has the potential for use as a target for the treatment of NAFLD.
paragraphs.chinese: 昼夜节律钟蛋白是控制数百个基因转录的内源性计时机制。它们在协调新陈代谢中的核心作用使其在包括非酒精性脂肪 肝病（NAFLD）在内的多种疾病中受到关注。中枢与外周昼夜节律失调是几乎所有遗传性、饮食性或环境性代谢综合征 及NAFLD模型的核心特征。将进食限制在每日特定时段（限时进食）可使中枢与外周昼夜节律同步化，从而预防甚至治 疗代谢综合征及肝脏脂肪变性。值得注意的是，当前作为NAFLD药物靶点研究的多种蛋白（甾醇调节元件结合蛋白 [SREBP]、乙酰辅酶A羧化酶[ACC]、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体[PPARs]及肠促胰岛素）均受昼夜节律蛋白调控。因 此，可利用生物钟机制最大化NAFLD药物的疗效并最小化其不良反应。昼夜节律钟本身亦具备成为NAFLD治疗靶点的潜 力。

literature.topic: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病
literature.title: Gut microbiotaderived indole compounds attenuate metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease by improving fat metabolism and inflammation
literature.title_chinese: 肠道微生物群衍生的吲哚化合物通过改善脂肪代谢和炎症减轻代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病

paragraphs.english: Metabolic dysfunctionassociated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common chronic liver disease, and its prevalence has increased worldwide in recent years. Additionally, there is a close relationship between MASLD and gut microbiotaderived metabolites. However, the mechanisms of MASLD and its metabolites are still unclear. We demonstrated decreased indole-3-propionic acid (IPA) and indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) in the feces of patients with hepatic steatosis compared to healthy controls. Here, IPA and IAA administration ameliorated hepatic steatosis and inflammation in an animal model of WDinduced MASLD by suppressing the NF-κB signaling pathway through a reduction in endotoxin levels and inactivation of macrophages.
paragraphs.chinese: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是最常见的慢性肝病，近年来其患病率在全球范围内持续上升。此外， MASLD与肠道菌群衍生代谢物之间存在密切关联，但其具体作用机制尚不明确。研究发现，与健康对照组相比，肝脂肪 变性患者粪便中的吲哚-3-丙酸（IPA）和吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）水平显著降低。在西方饮食诱导的MASLD动物模型中，补 充IPA和IAA通过降低内毒素水平、抑制巨噬细胞活化，进而阻断NF-κB信号通路，有效改善了肝脏脂肪变性和炎症反 应。

literature.title: Adaptations in gastrointestinal physiology after sleeve gastrectomy and rouxenY gastric bypass
literature.title_chinese: 袖状胃切除术与Roux-en-Y胃旁路术后胃肠生理适应性变化

paragraphs.english: Linked to the growing obesity epidemic, demand for bariatric and metabolic surgery has increased, the most common procedures being sleeve gastrectomy and RouxenY gastric bypass. Originally, bariatric procedures were described as purely restrictive, malabsorptive, or combined restrictivemalabsorptive procedures limiting food intake, nutrient absorption, or both. Nowadays, anatomical alterations are known to affect gastrointestinal physiology, which in turn affects the digestion and absorption of nutrients and drugs. Therefore, understanding gastrointestinal physiology is crucial to prevent postoperative nutritional deficiencies and to optimise postoperative drug therapy. Preclinical and clinical research indicates that sleeve gastrectomy accelerates liquid and solid gastric emptying and small intestinal transit, and increases bile acid serum levels, whereas its effects on gastrointestinal acidity, gastric and pancreatic secretions, surface area, and colonic transit remain largely unknown. RouxenY gastric bypass diminishes gastric acid secretion, accelerates liquid gastric emptying, and increases bile acid serum levels, but its effects on intestinal pH, solid gastric emptying, intestinal transit time, gastric enzyme secretions, and surface area remain largely unknown. In this Review, we summarise current knowledge of the effects of these two procedures on gastrointestinal physiology and assess the knowledge gaps. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 随着肥胖症的日益流行，对减重与代谢手术的需求也随之增加，其中最常见的术式是袖状胃切除术和Roux-en-Y胃旁路 术。最初，减重手术被描述为纯粹的限制性、吸收不良性或两者结合的手术，旨在限制食物摄入、营养吸收或两者兼 有。如今，人们认识到解剖结构的改变会影响胃肠道生理，进而影响营养物质和药物的消化与吸收。因此，了解胃肠道 生理对于预防术后营养缺乏和优化术后药物治疗至关重要。临床前和临床研究表明，袖状胃切除术会加速液体和固体胃 排空以及小肠转运，并增加胆汁酸血清水平，而其对胃肠道酸度、胃和胰腺分泌、表面积以及结肠转运的影响在很大程 度上仍未知。Roux-en-Y胃旁路术会减少胃酸分泌，-加速液体胃排空，并增加胆汁酸血清水平，但其对肠道pH值、固体 胃排空、肠道转运时间、胃酶分泌和表面积的影响在很大程度上仍未知。在本综述中，我们总结了目前关于这两种手术 对胃肠道生理影响的知识，并评估了知识空白。

literature.title: Post sleeve gastrectomyenriched gut commensal clostridia promotes secondary bile acid increase and weight loss
literature.title_chinese: 袖状胃切除术后富集的肠道共生梭菌促进次级胆汁酸增加与体重减轻

paragraphs.english: The gut microbiome is altered after bariatric surgery and is associated with weight loss. However, the commensal bacteria involved and the underlying mechanism remain to be determined. We performed shotgun metagenomic sequencing in obese subjects before and longitudinally after sleeve gastrectomy (SG), and found a significant enrichment in microbial species in Clostridia and bile acid metabolizing genes after SG treatment. bile acid profiling further revealed decreased primary bile acids (PBAs) and increased conjugated secondary bile acids (CSBAs) after SG. Specifically, glycodeoxycholic acid (GDCA) and taurodeoxycholic acid (TDCA) were increased at different followups after SG, and were associated with the increased abundance of Clostridia and body weight reduction. fecal microbiome transplantation with postSG feces increased SBA levels, and alleviated body weight gain in the recipient mice. Furthermore, both Clostridiaenriched sporeforming bacteria and GDCA supplementation increased the expression of genes responsible for lipolysis and fatty acid oxidation in adipose tissue and reduced adiposity via Takeda Gproteincoupled receptor 5 (TGR5) signaling. Our findings reveal post- SG gut microbiome and CSBAs as contributory to SGinduced weight loss, in part via TGR5 signaling, and suggest SBA- producing gut microbes as a potential therapeutic target for obesity intervention. 究
paragraphs.chinese: 肠道微生物群在减重手术后发生改变，并与体重减轻相关。然而，所涉及的共生细菌及其潜在机制仍有待确定。我们对 肥胖受试者在袖状胃切除术（SG）前后进行了纵向的鸟枪法宏基因组测序，发现SG治疗后梭菌属微生物种类和胆汁酸代 谢基因显著富集。胆汁酸谱进一步显示SG后初级胆汁酸（PBAs）减少，而结合次级胆汁酸（C-SBAs）增加。具体而 言，甘氨脱氧胆酸（GDCA）和牛磺脱氧胆酸（TDCA）侵在SG后的不同随访时间点均有所增加，并与梭菌属丰度的增加 和体重减轻相关。使用SG后粪便进行粪便微生物移植可提高SBA水平，并减轻受体小鼠的体重增加。此外，富含梭菌的 孢子形成细菌和GDCA补充剂均能增加脂肪组织中负责脂肪分解和脂肪酸氧化的基因表达，并通过Takeda G蛋白偶联受 体5（TGR5）信号通路减少脂肪堆积。我们的研究揭示了SG后肠道微生物群和C-SBAs对SG诱导的体重减轻具有促进作 用，部分通过TGR5信号通路实现，并提示产生SBA的肠道微生物可能成为肥胖干预的潜在治疗靶点。

literature.title: A microbial metabolite remodels the gutliver axis following bariatric surgery
literature.title_chinese: 微生物代谢物重塑减肥手术后的肠肝轴

paragraphs.english: bariatric surgery is the most effective treatment for type 2 diabetes and is associated with changes in gut metabolites. Previous work uncovered a gutrestricted TGR5 agonist with antidiabetic propertiescholic acid-7-sulfate (CA7S)-that is elevated following sleeve gastrectomy (SG). Here, we elucidate a microbiomedependent pathway by which SG increases CA7S production. We show that a microbial metabolite, lithocholic acid (LCA), is increased in murine portal veins postSG and by activating the vitamin D receptor, induces hepatic mSult2A1/hSULT2A expression to drive CA7S production. An SGinduced shift in the microbiome increases gut expression of the bile acid transporters Asbt and Ostα, which in turn facilitate selective transport of LCA across the gut epithelium. Cecal microbiota transplant from SG animals is sufficient to recreate the pathway in germfree (GF) animals. Activation of this gutliver pathway leads to CA7S synthesis and GLP-1 secretion, causally connecting a microbial metabolite with the improvement of diabetic phenotypes.
paragraphs.chinese: 减肥手术是治疗2型糖尿病最有效的方法，并与肠道代谢物的变化相关。先前的研究发现了一种具有抗糖尿病特性的肠道 限制性TGR5激动剂——胆酸-7-硫酸盐（CA7S），其在袖状胃切除术后升高。本文揭示了一条微生物组依赖的途径，通 过该途径袖状胃切除术增加了CA7S的产生。我们展示了在袖状胃切除术后，小鼠门静脉中的微生物代谢物石胆酸 （LCA）增加，并通过激活维生素D受体，诱导肝脏mSult2A1/hSULT2A表达，从而驱动CA7S的产生。袖状胃切除术引 起的微生物组变化增加了肠道胆汁酸转运蛋白Asbt和Ostα的表达，进而促进了LCA选择性穿过肠道上皮的运输。从袖状 胃切除动物移植盲肠微生物组足以在无菌动物中重建这一途径。激活这一肠肝途径导致CA7S合成和GLP-1分泌，从而将 微生物代谢物与糖尿病表型的改善因果联系起来。
